data.name: Satisfactory.StartFirst

data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Qedela ukusetha kokuqala ku-Satisfactory ̇s Server Manager bese ugcina iseva isebenza nge--NewConsole.
Chofoza ngezansi. I-Synix ithumela umyalo, ifundwe ithokheni elisha, iqinisekiswe futhi igcinwe ngokuphepha. Akukho ukukopisha nokunamathisela.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.AmbiguousToken
data.value: I-console yabuyisela amathokheni ahlukahlukene. Ayikho inhlanganisela egcinwe.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleUnavailable
data.value: I-Synix ayikwazi ukufinyelela kule nkonzo ye-Unreal console. Qala nge--NewConsole bese usebenzisa izimvume ezifanayo ze-Windows ze-Synix nesiphakeli.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Umyalo wathunyelwa, kodwa i-Synix ayizange ikwazi ukufunda ithokheni elisha eliphelele kusuka kulokhu kuphuma kweseva. Hlola ukuthi i-server iyaphendula yini futhi ilogo yayo ibhaliwe. Noma yikuphi ukuxhumeka okugciniwe kwagcinwa; Umyalo awuzange uphinde uzame.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy
data.value: Ikhonsoli ayisabeli noma uxhumano seluvele luqhubeka. Linda, bese uzama futhi. Umyalo awuzange uphinde uzame ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: Satisfactory.TokenSafety
data.value: Lokhu kunikeza ukufinyelela kumqondisi we-Synix. I-token ibethelwe ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Windows futhi ayikaze yengezwe ekuhlanganisweni komdlalo noma ezingxabanweni zokuqalisa. I-Satisfactory iyibonisa ekhonsoli yayo kanye ne-log yayo; Gcina lezo ziyimfihlo. Ukususa uxhumano olulondoloziwe akusho ukuhoxisa ithokheni.

data.name: Satisfactory.SecurityHelp
data.value: Ngemuva kokumisa ku-Satisfactory, qala iseva nge--NewConsole. Ku-Synix: Izinketho Zeseva → Isikhungo Sokulawula se-Satisfactory → Xhuma i-API → Xhuma ngokuzenzakalelayo. Lolu xhumano olungakhethwa aluzange luvimbele ukulawula okujwayelekile kweseva.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Qala Ngokushesha 1. Faka igama eliqondile lomdlalo ne-Steam Server AppID. 2. Faka indlela yesiphakeli esebenzayo maqondana nefolda yesiphakeli efakiwe. 3. Faka kuphela umbhalo womyalo ozayo ngemva kwe-executable. Sebenzisa amathegi asekelwe ngezansi lapho i-Synix kufanele ifake khona isethingi somsebenzisi. 4. Khetha indlela umdlalo uthola ngayo ifayela layo lokulungisa. Imodi elawulwayo idinga ifayela eliphelele, elisebenzayo lokumisa, hhayi isibonelo esiyingxenye. 5. Khetha i- Validate & Preview. Lungisa zonke izinkinga ezibikiwe ngaphambi kokulondoloza. 6. Gcina, phinda kabusha i-Synix, yenza ukuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo, bese uhlola ukufakwa / ukuqala / ukumisa / ukuqapha umdlalo.
Izinkambu Ezidingekayo • Igama lomdlalo: igama abasebenzisi abalibona ku-Synix. • I-ID yencazelo: i-ID encane engavamile; I-Synix iyakha ngegama lomdlalo kuwe. • I-Steam AppID: i-AppID yesiphakeli esinikezelwe, hhayi njalo i-AppID yomdlalo weklayenti. • Ukwakheka kohlelo lokusebenza lwe-SteamCMD: ngokuvamile akunakwenzeka. Imidlalo eyabelwe i-GoldSrc AppID 90 isebenzisa ifomu eliqinisekisiwe elithi "90 mod folder", njengokuthi "90 mod cstrike". I-Synix yamukela kuphela leli fomu eliphephile. • Iyenziwa: isibonelo Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Ungafaki ifolda yokufaka. • Izibuko: izibuko zomdlalo nezombuzo eziqinisekisiwe. • Amamephu nemodi yomdlalo: faka inani elilodwa lomdlalo eliqondile ngomugqa ngamunye. Lezi zigcwalisa izinketho eziboniswe ngenkathi udala noma uhlela iseva.
Izingxabano Zokwethula Ungangeni ku-executable uqobo. Gcina amafulegi omdlalo njengombhalo ojwayelekile futhi ufake amathegi kuphela amanani alawulwa yi-Synix. Isibonelo: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
IZINTO ZENDABA EZisekelwayo [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
I-RCON RECIPE Faka i-{rcon} ezingxoxweni zokuqalisa lapho kungena khona umyalo ongakhethwa we-RCON. Ku-RCON syntax, sebenzisa: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Isibonelo RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
INDLELA Yokuziphatha • Akukaqinisekiswa okwamanje: I-Synix ayiphathi ifayela lokuhlela. • Umdlalo uyadala ngemuva kokuqala: sebenzisa ukuhlelwa okuphelele okuthathwe njengethempulethi yokuhlela nokulungisa. • I-Synix iyakha kusuka kusampula: I-Synix ibeka ukucushwa okugcwele ngaphambi kokuqala. • Qalisa izimpikiswano kuphela: umdlalo awudingi ukucushwa okuphathwayo kulezi zilungiselelo.
I-TEMPLATE TAGS yokwakheka {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} I-{HasPassword} ibhala inani langempela lencazelo lapho iphasiwedi yesiphakeli ikhona kanye nenani layo elingelona iqiniso lapho iphasiwedi ingenalutho. Sebenzisa Engeza amafayela wokulungisa uma iseva idinga amafayela angaphezu kweyodwa. Khetha ifayela ngalinye eligcwele lomthombo, bese uhlela indawo yalo efakwe etafuleni ukuze indlela ibhekane nefolda yesiphakeli. I-Synix iqinisekisa, ifake, ibhale, ilungise futhi ithuthukise wonke amafayela abhalwe phansi ndawonye.
Amafayela adingekayo anikezwe umsebenzisi Faka indlela eyodwa ephephile ngomugqa ngamunye, maqondana nefolda yesiphakeli efakiwe. Amafayela adingekayo ukuvimbela ukuqala kuze kube manje; amafayela okuzikhethela angeniswa lapho etholakala kodwa angalokothi avimbele ukuqala. Lapho amafayela adingekayo evela kumdlalo ojwayelekile, chaza zonke izinyathelo zomsebenzisi emiyalweni yokusetha. I-Synix ayilandeli, ayidluli ubunikazi, noma ihambise kabusha amafayela omdlali onelayisense. Ifolda yedatha yangaphandle yigama lefolda uSynix angalikhangela ngaphansi kwamafolda amadokhumenti womsebenzisi. Yishiye ingenalutho lapho umsebenzisi edinga ukukopisha amafayela ngesandla.
Isixwayiso Sokuqala Nesifanekiselo Vumela isixwayiso lapho abasebenzisi kufanele bagcwalise ukusetha ngaphambi kokwethulwa kokuqala. Bhala izinyathelo eziqondile bese ukhomba noma yini umsebenzisi okumelwe ayithole ekufakweni komdlalo. I-URL ye-icon iyisinqumo futhi kufanele isebenzise i-HTTPS. I-Synix ibuyela kusithonjana se-server esifakiwe lapho singenalutho.
Ukubuyekezwa Nokuphepha Qalisa izincazelo ezintsha namathempulethi ekubuyekezweni kwe-1. Ukwandisa ukubuyekezwa kwencazelo noma nini lapho incazelo yomdlalo ishintsha. Yandisa ukubuyekezwa kwesampula kuphela uma ukuhlelwa kokulungiswa okuphathwayo kushintsha. I-Synix yenqaba ukubhala ngaphezulu ngaphandle kokubuyekezwa okuphezulu futhi igcina izipele zokuthuthukisa.
Inketho YOKUFUNDA Vumela ukukopisha isikhathi sokusebenza se-Steam kuphela uma iseva iqinisekisiwe ukuthi iyakufuna. Inhloso kufanele ibe ifolda ehlobene ngaphakathi kwalokho kufakwa kweseva. I-Synix ikopisha kuphela ama-DLL ayo amathathu avunyelwe we-Steam runtime.
Izidingo Zesikhathi Setha isimiso esiphansi RAM ukuba 0 uma umdlalo akanayo ubuncane obuqinisekisiwe. Ukuhlolwa kwe-Hardware ne-Windows-runtime kuchaza izidingo ezingekho ngaphambi kokufakwa futhi kuvimbele ukuqaliswa okungaphephile; azishintshi izilungiselelo ze-Windows. Khetha i-.NET Framework noma i-Visual C ++ runtime kuphela uma izidingo zomthetho zomdlalo ziyibona. I-Synix ihlola irekhodi le-Windows kodwa ayikaze ifake noma idlulise izidingo zangaphambilini buthule. I-Hyper-V idinga i-Windows Professional noma ngaphezulu, ngakho ukukhetha i-Hyper-V kukhetha nemfuneko ye-Windows.
Ukuziphatha kokuqalisa Sebenzisa ukulandelela okujwayelekile kwenqubo kumaseva anikezelwe avamile. Ukuthuthukiswa kwangaphandle kwenzelwa kuphela i-launcher, umshini obonakalayo, noma okunye ukuthunyelwa okungumnikazi womjikelezo wokuphila wesiphakeli; ivimbela ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuqapha imibuzo. Vumela i- Required Visible Manager yemidlalo okumele ihlale ivulekile. Lokhu kuvimbela izintandokazi zomsebenzisi zomhlaba wonke zesikhombisi sokufihla kuphela kule ncazelo. Ukuqalisa okuphakeme kusekelwa kuphela kumafayela wokuqalisa we-.exe, .bat, ne-.cmd. Vumela ukuthekelisa ifayela lokuqalisa kuphela uma umsebenzisi engadala futhi asebenzise ngokuphepha ifayela lokuqalisa elibuyekeziwe ngaphandle kwe-Synix. Umyalezo olungile uboniswa ngemva kokuhlolwa okukhethekile kokulungela komdlalo. Lezi zinkambu zikhetha ukuziphatha kwe-Synix okufakiwe, okuvunyelweyo futhi azikwazi ukusebenzisa imibhalo yeskripthi noma ama-plugins.
I-LOG DISCOVERY Faka izindlela eziphephile maqondana nefolda yesiphakeli efakwe. Sebenzisa * ingxenye eyodwa yomzila noma igama lefayela kanye ** amafolda ahlanganisiwe. Abaphathi bezindawo abasekelwa yi-{Identity}, i-{ServerName}, i-{WorldName}, i-{Port} ne-{QueryPort}. Izibonelo: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix usesha lezi zindlela kuphela lapho umsebenzisi ecela ukuvula ilogi yomdlalo yakamuva.

data.value: 2 ADD A SERVER Khetha umdlalo, faka izilungiselelo zobungane, bese uvumela i-Synix uyifake. I-Steam yokungena ngemvume iyacelwa kuphela uma lowo mdlalo uyidinga.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: 3 Qala, Misa, FUTHA I-Synix ibonisa izimpikiswano eziqondile zokuqalisa, iqinisekisa ukuqala, isebenzisa ukuziphatha kokumisa okuphephile lapho kusekelwa khona, futhi igcina amarekhodi wakamuva atholakalayo.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: Ukufinyelela kwenethiwekhi ye-4 Imvume ye-Windows Firewall nokudluliselwa kwezibuko lomzila kuhlukile. I-Synix ihlola izingxabano zendawo, kodwa ayishintshi i-router yakho.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: I-5 Yokubuyiselwa Kwezimali Nokusekelayo Sebenzisa izilungiselelo > I-Advanced > Troubleshooter ukuze uhlole impilo ngokuphepha futhi ulungise. Sebenzisa ama-Backups ngaphambi kokuhambisa i- Synix noma ukwenza izinguquko ezinkulu.

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Igama le-akhawunti, hhayi igama lokubonisa lakho le-Steam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Engeza zonke ezinye izifanekiso eziphelele umdlalo udinga. Hlela Indawo efakiwe ukuze indlela ngayinye ihlobene nefolda yesiphakeli efakiwe.

data.name: Text.8F2ED817BE8BBE23D64C
data.value: Ubufakazi obuzenzakalelayo buvela ezenzweni ze-Synix; izimpikiswano zidinga ukuhlolwa kwe-server yangempela.

data.name: Text.BC489FF2DAD82D69C258
data.value: Uhlu oluzenzakalelayo lokuhlola ukuphepha nezinyathelo ezilandelayo

data.name: Text.A8BC53DE427A5E93DAED
data.value: Yakha ngokuzenzakalelayo ifolda yomdlalo / iseva ephephile ngaphansi kwendlela yemidlalo ehleliwe.

data.name: Text.1232008495CAD0B69745
data.value: Amabhulokhi aqala ukulayisha ngokuqondiswa okucacile kwe-Microsoft lapho isikhathi sokuqalisa singekho.

data.name: Text.AAFE71EF1584DE2CA4E2
data.value: Ivimbela ukusetha ngomyalezo ocacile lapho i-processor ingasekeli i-AVX2.

data.name: Text.95E3AA6BFFB7545B20EF
data.value: Hlola izikhathi zokusebenza ezabiwe, amafayela wesiphakeli, ukucushwa, izimbobo, i-Windows Firewall, isikhala sediski, izinqubo eziphazamisekile, amarekhodi wakamuva, kanye nezimo zokuvuselela ze-Synix kusuka endaweni eyodwa.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Hlola i-SteamCMD ukuze uthole izibuyekezo ngaphambi kokuqalisa iseva.

data.name: Text.6B1DD744008E1B4658A6
data.value: Hlola i-SteamCMD, izikhathi zokusebenza, amafayela wesiphakeli, ukucushwa, amachweba, i-Windows Firewall, isikhala sediski, izinqubo eziphazamisekile, amarekhodi wakamuva, kanye nezimo zokuvuselela.

data.name: Text.1DF3BE2046D08A780F73
data.value: Kuhlola okukhipha kokushicilela kwangempela ngaphandle kokwakha kabusha i-Synix, ukuqala ukukhululwa, noma ukufinyelela ku-C:\Synix.

data.name: Text.52A32013E2D94B00DBF7
data.value: Hlola ukukhululwa kwe-Windows .NET Framework efakwe ngaphambi kokuqala kweseva.

data.name: Text.445F89C824FEC1E5E372
data.value: Ihlolisisa ukuthi ngabe ukusekelwa kwe-virtualization kunikwe amandla yini futhi kuyatholakala ku-Windows.

data.name: Text.B28F2358A90FE65BFCC8
data.value: Khetha umugqa ukuze uvule ukulawula kweseva

data.name: Text.58ECD5D931201294DE1E
data.value: Khetha uhlobo lwe-server ukubonisa umlando walo wokuqinisekisa wendawo.

data.name: Text.C9F72F8A6A3B6CC20F72
data.value: Khetha kuphela ukuziphatha okufakiwe kokuqalisa okuqinisekisiwe kwale seva enikezelwe.

data.name: Text.22FCE0291808752AD7BC
data.value: Khetha isipele okufanele sithathe indawo yamafayela wamanje wesiphakeli.

data.name: Text.30F3BBCB43AC48EBFD1C
data.value: Khetha ulimi olusetshenziswa yi-Synix. Izilungiselelo zomdlalo namagugu wokwakheka azohlala ngesiNgisi.

data.name: Text.54FE09AF7E87A247A21A
data.value: Khetha ukuthi i-Synix kufanele yenze nini ukuqala kabusha kweseva okuhleliwe.

data.name: Text.B09F5332EE858BE57F71
data.value: Imiyalo ihlala kule khompyutha ngaphandle kokuthi uqondise uJava RCON ukufinyelela okukude.

data.name: Text.82A8EB3A96D059596D55
data.value: Qedela ukucushwa kwefayela okudingekayo ngaphambi kokuqala kwesiphakeli esizinikezele.

data.name: Text.F0CDBB393CA93D39DF05
data.value: Indlela yokulungiswa maqondana nefolda yesiphakeli efakwe

data.name: Text.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Qhubeka kuphela ngemva kokubuyekeza izinyathelo ezidingekayo zokusetha.

data.name: Text.07754DEE7F94A6CA31B1
data.value: Kopisha amafayela wesikhathi sokusebenza we-Steam avunyelwe ngemuva kokufakwa

data.name: Text.DA14A0D982E06E70BB06
data.value: Kopisha amafayela wesikhathi sokusebenza we-Steam avunyelwe ngemuva kokufakwa

data.name: Text.A388F0CE16C067DFA8C5
data.value: Ihlanganisa isikhathi sokusebenza esihlanganisiwe se-Microsoft esisetshenziswa ngamaseva wamanje we-2015, 2017, 2019, ne-2022.

data.name: Text.2196E21E8E2F8ABE522B
data.value: Yenza isipele sesiphakeli esivikelwe ngaphambi kokuqalisa ngakunye.

data.name: Text.5D45286D0F2A822299E8
data.value: Dala incazelo yomdlalo eyakhelwe ngaphakathi eqinisekisiwe ngaphandle kwama-plugins noma izikripthi. Izincazelo zigcinwa kulo msebenzi futhi zitholakala kuphela ngemva kokwakhiwa kabusha kweSynix.

data.name: Text.9F67BB0F58790841820E
data.value: Ukukhubaza umsebenzi ohleliwe usebenza kuphela ngenkathi i-Synix ivuliwe.

data.name: Text.84A9F83EFC6F8A9F3401
data.value: I-Discord ivuliwe. Khetha i-New Post engxoxweni yokubika izimbungulu bese unamathisela umbiko okopishiwe.

data.name: Text.0BB9D8B879FB1885FD71
data.value: Unganamathiseli amaphasiwedi, ama-webhooks, amakheli e-IP, ukucushwa kwangasese noma imiyalo yokuqalisa ephelele. I-Synix isusa izimfihlo ezivamile ngaphambi kokuthumela.

data.name: Text.89BF7052C30A2A455D98
data.value: Umthetho ngamunye ukhomba ku-executable ngaphansi kwe-C:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], kepha leyo folda yeseva ngayinye ayisekho futhi ayikho iseva ye-Synix efakiwe ephethe indlela.

data.name: Text.46D0E2FA44635045064B
data.value: Hlela i-serverconfig.xml ngokuphepha ngaphandle kokushintsha isakhiwo sayo se-XML.

data.name: Text.947BC568AF81FE33EC61
data.value: Vumela kuphela uma ukufakwa kwe-SteamCMD okungaziwa kwehluleka futhi kudingeka i-akhawunti ye-Steam.

data.name: Text.2F7C7C280CF67E40627A
data.value: Vumela kuphela uma iseva ingasebenzi kahle ngaphandle kokuphakama kwe-Windows.

data.name: Text.615A691F61191EE9C393
data.value: Vumela i-RCON kuphela kumathempulethi womdlalo asekela imiyalo ekude ephephile.

data.name: Text.59AD73A66B0E19C3759F
data.value: Vumela uma iseva inemibuzo eqinisekisiwe noma i-sonde yenethiwekhi engakwazi ukuqapha i-Synix.

data.name: Text.518F7A1D974E46AED149
data.value: Faka izitifiketi ngendlela okufanele zilayishwe ngayo. Sebenzisa ama-comma, izikhala noma i-ID eyodwa ngomugqa. I-Synix ayidingi i-database yamagama ezimodeli.

data.name: Text.E486E8326F69B31FB7D5
data.value: Faka ulwazi lomdlalo, bese uqinisekisa ngaphambi kokulondoloza.

data.name: Text.E83F8984B15353372DF8
data.value: Isibonelo: Iseva ivala imizuzwana embalwa ngemuva kokuqala

data.name: Text.6F9406E668F812A49DBB
data.value: Ukusetshenziswa kwangaphandle kusetshenziselwa iziqhumisi noma imishini ebonakalayo futhi kukhubaze ukuqapha imibuzo.

data.name: Text.0078A1C33BF28B41D89B
data.value: Ithola imithetho okuyinto executable kwaba ngaphansi C:\Synix\Games\ [Game]\[Server], kodwa ukuthi iseva ethize ayisekho igcinwe futhi ifolda yayo iseva isukile. Izimbobo namafolda okufaka ngokwezifiso awahlolwa.

data.name: Text.88ED3B522C4F0A8BD740
data.value: I-GitHub ayixhunyiwe. Ukukopisha nokukhetha kwe-Discord kusasebenza.

data.name: Text.9942D957346A0E83C15C
data.value: I-GitHub ithumela ngokuqondile ngaphandle kokuvula isiphequluli ngemuva kokuthi i-akhawunti ixhunywe.

data.name: Text.4E4DEFAC10984CADF571
data.value: Fihla amakheli e-IP, amaphasiwedi nolunye ulwazi olubucayi ngenkathi wabelana ngesikrini.

data.name: Text.A8578B710044B649B2CD
data.value: Indlela umsebenzisi athola futhi afake ngayo amafayela emidlalo adingekayo

data.name: Text.4E469076738CB74F0877
data.value: Ngiqinisekisile igama leseva elibonisiwe, iziteshi, umkhawulo womdlali, nazo zonke ezinye izindinganiso ezisetshenziswe yile ncazelo, kufaka phakathi amaphasiwedi, i-RCON, imodi, nebalazwe/umhlaba lapho kufanele khona.

data.name: Text.13F02AECB00BE9833629
data.value: Ulwazi lomuntu siqu, izwe, umdlali kanye nenethiwekhi

data.name: Text.5D385B4C5044DA97B77C
data.value: UKUFUNDA Ayikho iphakethe elikhethiwe Khetha iphakethe ukuze ubale isikhala nesikhathi.

data.name: Text.44D7882A1ADBECC9092C
data.value: Faka lo mdlalo ku-Synix ngaphambi kokuhlola izizathu zawo zangempela zokuqalisa.

data.name: Text.70CAC3F03884A4946236
data.value: Ukufakwa, ukuqala, ukumisa nokuqapha kuhlolwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ukuqinisekiswa kwezingxabano kusebenzisa iseva yangempela efakwe kanye nokuhlolwa komyalo okuhlanzekile; ukuhlelwa kuhlala kuwuhlolo lwefayela ngesandla.

data.name: Text.D3F2BA487FAA0A74E4A4
data.value: Ivumela umsebenzisi ukudala ifayela lokuqalisa elibuyekeziwe. Vimbela imiyalo yokuthumela okufanele ihlale ngaphakathi kwe-Synix.

data.name: Text.2FD27154D5938042C2FF
data.value: Nciphisa inani lama-backup agcinwe kuseva ngayinye.

data.name: Text.E749931070B84A1593D2
data.value: Ukusebenza okubukhoma kuzo zonke izinqubo ze-server yomdlalo ezilawulwayo.

data.name: Text.9E611113ECA35A604A41
data.value: Ukulayisha umugqa wokuqinisekisa umdlalo owakhelwe ngaphakathi...

data.name: Text.F31BBCEE0082BEEE372A
data.value: Izinketho zemephu nezindlela zivela ngqo kusampula yomdlalo okhethiwe.

data.name: Text.FDA8F741D724B426C343
data.value: Amamephu noma izimo (inani elilodwa eliqondile ngomugqa)

data.name: Text.A5C1D46A9B2A472DF537
data.value: Umlayezo oboniswe ngemuva kokudlula kokuhlolwa kokulungela okukhethekile (ngokuzithandela)

data.name: Text.71F9139AF2A58247E590
data.value: Uhlelo oluncane RAM ku-GB (i-0 isho ukuthi ayikho ubuncane)

data.name: Text.0F38AC5E2C273A4B6642
data.value: Qaphela iziteshi ezisebenzayo zesiphakeli ukuze ubone ukuthi kunezikhukhula zamaphakeji angenayo futhi ubike ukuqhuma komgwaqo okungajwayelekile.

data.name: Text.1C310A469AD1721A3E91
data.value: Hlola futhi uphathe wonke amaseva womdlalo kusuka endaweni eyodwa yokusebenza.

data.name: Text.A6D637EAA965641CEB00
data.value: Yisho igama lale ndawo, unamathisele i-webhook yayo ye-Discord, bese ukhetha kahle ukuthi yimiphi imicimbi ye-Synix etholayo.

data.name: Text.8DDA097844BB6EDCFA10
data.value: Ayishintshiwe: amafayela womdlalo, amaseva agciniwe, imithetho yesiteshi kuphela, amafolda wokufaka ngokwezifiso nemithetho ye-firewall ngaphandle kwe-C:\Synix\Games.

data.name: Text.4DC50DE227F1D75CFF26
data.value: Kuboniswa kuphela isibonakaliso se-webhook esifihlakele. Vula Izilungiselelo Zeseva ukuze ubuke noma uhlele indawo okubhalwe kuyo.

data.name: Text.A8796566765C1117B49C
data.value: Inani oyishintshayo kuphela elizothathelwa indawo; amazwana, izigaba, ukuhlelwa, izingcaphuno, ukuhlukaniswa kanye nokuhleleka kokhiye kuhlala kungalinyazwa.

data.name: Text.8736DCB51A77046719F5
data.value: Vula i-native console lapho iserver yomdlalo iqala. Vimbela lokhu ukuze kusebenze amaseva ngesizotha ngemuva.

data.name: Text.C8CF5C841F7BF2F1E0F3
data.value: Vula umshini wokuxazulula izinkinga we- Synix

data.name: Text.8E7F4674A03B5A87853B
data.value: Amafulegi okukhethwa kukho kuphela isibonelo: -log, -nosteamclient, noma -forceupdate

data.name: Text.656F6C1DD0569874658F
data.value: Amafayela wokungenisa angenamkhawulo (izindlela ezihlobene, eyodwa ngomugqa)

data.name: Text.CB904327966ABA4B8621
data.value: I-RCON syntax engenamkhawulo ?? izimpikiswano zokuqalisa kumele ziqukethe i-{rcon}

data.name: Text.36B18A6020F2CE06DF28
data.value: Isusa izintandokazi ze-Synix zokufihla i-console kumaseva aphethwe ngewindi lawo.

data.name: Text.F2492B6E06AE47BEB928
data.value: Ukutholakala kwezibuko kuhlolwa ngokuzenzakalela ngokumelene nezinqubo ezisebenzayo kanye namanye amaseva e-Synix.

data.name: Text.F13396A9BD6FFF26191D
data.value: Imodi yobumfihlo ifihla lesi siqinisekiso sokufinyelela. Faka ikhodi eyenziwe ngezifiso, noma uyishiye ingenalutho ekufakweni kokuqala ukuze i-Windrose ikhiqize eyodwa.

data.name: Text.82F665628E2402225B0F
data.value: Ukuhlonza inqubo nokusetshenziswa kwemithombo ebukhoma kuwo wonke amaseva womdlalo asebenzayo.

data.name: Text.517D0391800FC8C55AD3
data.value: Ivikelwe ku-Synix futhi ifihliwe emibhalweni yayo. Amafayela e-batch akhiqizwayo aqukethe ithokheni elingasetshenziswa kumbhalo ofundekayo.

data.name: Text.49CDA0DED2FDB6421A49
data.value: Khetha ifolda yokushicilela. Hlola lapho usukulungele.

data.name: Text.EC423125FB2CAF05C95B
data.value: Imiyalo Esheshayo ?? khetha eyodwa ukuyilungisa, bese uyibuyekeza bese uyithumela

data.name: Text.15599B0016F3C3591CF5
data.value: Amanani afundekayo kuphela angakhethwa futhi akopishwe ukuze kuhlolwe

data.name: Text.69EDD9A74D913D8F77D6
data.value: Ukuqinisekiswa kokufunda kuphela kwesakhiwo sethempulethi, ukubuyekezwa, kanye namagugu agcinwe ku-Server Settings. Amanani ephasiwedi awaboniswa.

data.name: Text.D4BEB0C27C58D53CCFA7
data.value: Ukufunda nokuhlola umtapo wezincazelo zomdlalo wephrojekthi...

data.name: Text.54C8BBF4B91A6012A87B
data.value: Ready ?? I-Windows icela imvume yomlawuli kuphela uma imithetho idinga ukususwa.

data.name: Text.2B2FF7B1710C1AE35612
data.value: Ukulungele ukuhlola amafayela ashicilelwe kanye ne-test receipt eyenziwe ngesikhathi sokushicilelwa.

data.name: Text.FD866259C3EE73E57510
data.value: Ilungele ukuhlola umtapo wezincazelo zomdlalo owakhelwe ngaphakathi.

data.name: Text.C0BAAF3EA26A1A69CE63
data.value: Ngikulungele. Kunconywa ukugijima ngomzuzu we-30 nge-30 amasampula wesibili ukuze kuhlolwe ngokushesha.

data.name: Text.0C10BD130731730DDC5C
data.value: Vuselela ukulayisha imininingwane yomdlali ngqo kusuka kuseva yendawo.

data.name: Text.4CB636A73FAD7D71BC94
data.value: Ukuhlolwa kokuthembeka kukhanseliwe. Azikho izilungiselelo zesiphakeli ezishintshiwe.

data.name: Text.FE3F7B0A38B0EEDF20EB
data.value: Isampula ngokuphindaphindiwe inkumbulo ye-Synix, izibambo, izintambo, nokuhlolwa kwezempilo kweseva yokufunda kuphela. Akuqali, kuyeke, ukufaka, ukuvuselela noma ukushintsha iseva.

data.name: Text.88E68081C6F4A7C6EEE2
data.value: Funa iwindi lomphathi wesiphakeli lihlale libukeka

data.name: Text.9E09BE4B90E9259491DD
data.value: Izinkambu ezidingekayo zihlaziywa ngokuzenzakalelayo kumdlalo okhethiwe.

data.name: Text.AD654849FC9CF1C6D997
data.value: Amafayela adingekayo namathempulethi adalwe yi-Synix avumela isixwayiso ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: Text.B0DAEADE1B96AB9F8EB5
data.value: Kuyadingeka izici ezifana ne-Hyper-V ezingekho ku-Windows Home.

data.name: Text.5BA4DAF696F2453133A8
data.value: Izimpikiswano zokuqalisa ezidingekayo zifakwa ngamandla ngemininingwane yakho ethile ngaphambi kokuqala. Ungafaka noma yiziphi izibhengezo ezingeziwe zomugqa womyalo ezingahlanganisiwe ngentambo engazenzakaleli esigabeni sezingxabano ezengeziwe.

data.name: Text.5DC5CE2CCFBCC1F3AE31
data.value: Amafayela adingekayo anikezwe umsebenzisi (izindlela ezihlobene, eyodwa ngomugqa)

data.name: Text.A95511418E3B85D2CCA6
data.value: Isikhathi sokuqalisa kabusha usebenzisa iwashi lehora le-24

data.name: Text.2D41AABA41C2EF3FED5C
data.value: Qalisa kabusha izinsuku ezikhethiwe ngesikhathi esisungulwe ngenkathi kugcinwa idatha yesheduli yamanje.

data.name: Text.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Hlola indlela i-Synix eyakha ngayo imiyalo esetshenziselwa ukuqala le seva.

data.name: Text.FC0C7D5D72BB74B7579E
data.value: Hlola imigomo yelayisense ngaphambi kokuvumela ukuqaliswa kwesiphakeli sokuqala.

data.name: Text.A2CBC7E3EEB055BE8AFC
data.value: Hlola lezi zimfuneko zokufakwa ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.

data.name: Text.B38F7F9752C285B4B90B
data.value: Ukusebenza kwesakhiwo sephakeji, i-SHA-256, nokuhlolwa kwe-antivirus...

data.name: Text.5D719633D44DEE05A861
data.value: Ukucinga ngomdlalo, okuphunyezwayo, noma isimo sokusekela...

data.name: Text.4CDDB86B34725DFF943D
data.value: Ukubuyekezwa kwezokuphepha kuvimbele iphakethe. Azikho amafayela ashintshiwe.

data.name: Text.8C5A71A792CF70840F4B
data.value: Bona kahle ukuthi yini i-Synix engakwazi ukuyifaka, ukuyilungisa, ukuyiqapha nokuyibuza ngaphambi kokudala iseva.

data.name: Text.339761CAC4ADD79725CB
data.value: Bheka ukuthi iyiphi indawo ye-Discord ethola uhlobo ngalunye lwesaziso se-Synix salokhu kuseva.

data.name: Text.FFF9C013BFE465B863CB
data.value: Khetha umdlalo ukuze uvuselele ubufakazi bawo bokuqinisekisa.

data.name: Text.F576F35548B3364CBEDB
data.value: Khetha iseva efakwe bese uqinisekisa umyalo wayo.

data.name: Text.DA03B7F52F79500329AF
data.value: Thumela isimo, izipele, ukugcinwa nezinkinga eziteshini ezahlukene ze-Discord.

data.name: Text.A50A426E7FA853DA7584
data.value: Izindawo zokubhalisa ze-server (umzila owodwa noma iphethini yekhadi eliyinkimbinkimbi ngomugqa)

data.name: Text.D72917FA7B697BD4F0E1
data.value: Kuboniswa ukuze kube nokusobala ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi umyalo wokuqalisa awunazo izimpikiswano ezifihliwe.

data.name: Text.20C57F23AC717E8E040D
data.value: Ukuqalisa iseva nge-Synix. Ilinde umlaleli wayo omisiwe ukuba aphendule...

data.name: Text.091C22C7EE122D76DAE4
data.value: Iqala ukuqapha imvelaphi uma ungena ku-Windows. Ukuvala ideshibhodi ye-Synix kuhlale kuphuma i-Synix ngokuphelele kweseshini yamanje.

data.name: Text.AFC6E98203B42710D6D2
data.value: Gcina ama-backup wesiphakeli ezenzakalelayo nezesandla kufolda eyenziwe ngokwezifiso.

data.name: Text.A03EE332F98F4733802C
data.value: Shintsha ideshibhodi ye-Synix phakathi kwezindikimba ezibukwayo ezikhanyayo nezimnyama.

data.name: Text.1263E823649071566AFC
data.value: I-Synix yakha umyalo wangempela ngezilungiselelo ezigciniwe zale seva, ifihla wonke amaphasiwedi, iqale ngokujwayelekile, futhi ilinde ubufakazi bokuthi iseva yamukele ukuqala.

data.name: Text.030EBC77E93FA53151CE
data.value: I-Synix ayivuli isikhumulo somphakathi sokulawula iwebhu. Amaphasiwedi agcinwe yi-Synix avikelwe endaweni, futhi amanani anobuhlakani afihlwe kuma-logs ayo.

data.name: Text.69B1390848A4F53A80A2
data.value: I-Synix ifaka i-server loader ekhethiwe kanye ne-Java ephathekayo ehambisanayo. Faka ama-mod akho ngemva kokufakwa.

data.name: Text.93F24BC2C28FEF1DDC28
data.value: I-Synix yakhelwe ukwenza ukusingathwa kwe-server yomdlalo yomuntu siqu kuqondakalayo ngaphandle kokufihla lokho okuguqukayo kukhompyutha yakho.

data.name: Text.DB74849CCDF411527A63
data.value: I-Synix iqinisekisa ama-backups aneziqinisekiso zokungaguquguquki, ihlela ngokuphepha i-archive ekhethiwe, futhi ibuyele emuva ngokuzenzakalelayo uma ukubuyiselwa kwehluleka. Ukungena kweseva ye-Synix egciniwe nezilungiselelo zayo azishintshiwe.

data.name: Text.F283ABEE58C3C5919882
data.value: I-Synix iqinisekisa isenzo ngasinye ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemuva kokuphumelela kule PC.

data.name: Text.7083BACCFEE1C7E3CC47
data.value: Sitshele ukuthi yini oyichofozile, ukuthi i-Synix ibonisani nokuthi ungayenza kanjani iphinde yenzeke.

data.name: Text.D25BF1DE94C6CFCB40D4
data.value: Ukuhlola zonke izincazelo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi namathempulethi ngokuphepha...

data.name: Text.91657E9737A951B3ADA2
data.value: Hlola yonke imidlalo eyakhelwe ngaphakathi, ukubopha izilungiselelo ezilawulwayo, ithempulethi yokulungiswa okugcwele, ukubuyekezwa, indlela, indawo yologi, kanye nesenzo esivunyelwe ngemuva kokufakwa. Amaseva afakiwe awashintshi.

data.name: Text.849FF4D03C300A88F143
data.value: Ukuxhumeka kwasendaweni kususiwe. Vimbela i-Synix ekhasini le-GitHub elivuliwe.

data.name: Text.199AA28C30C28597C6E2
data.value: Umbiko ohlungiwe ubumfihlo ukopishwe futhi usukulungele ukunamathiselwa kuforamu ye-Discord.

data.name: Text.0117F5327FA39CD0DABB
data.value: Isheke lokukhululwa likhanseliwe. Azikho amafayela okudalula ashintshiwe.

data.name: Text.AB89F96B667CE80E48CB
data.value: Umbiko onokwethenjelwa uzovela ngemuva kokuphela komjikelezo ofunwayo.

data.name: Text.D9718558CFBB91F44CFF
data.value: Uhlelo lokusebenza lugcinwa ngezilungiselelo zaleli seva.

data.name: Text.44D8326D9590F71F8B1B
data.value: Iseva ekhethiwe idinga i-akhawunti ye-Steam ukuze ifakwe. Faka igama le-akhawunti okufanele lisetshenziswe yi-SteamCMD.

data.name: Text.D305131EE6798E1D30FA
data.value: Iseva kufanele ihlale imisiwe ngesikhathi sokubuyisela

data.name: Text.BCB4E85BFE366942E9D4
data.value: Iseva yayeka ngaphambi kokuba kuqinisekiswe ukuqala. Hlola imibhalo yakamuva nencazelo yayo.

data.name: Text.946FF9E0EB0FA926E2AF
data.value: Iseva yokuhlola ivinjiwe. Ubufakazi obugcwalisiwe bezimpikiswano buyalondolozwa.

data.name: Text.7B3AC1F3AD7BA73ED0CC
data.value: Lezi zindinganiso zivunyelwe kuphela uma ithempulethi yesiphakeli ekhethiwe izixhasa.

data.name: Text.7CB94F75343DF207439A
data.value: Lo mbono wolwazi ubonisa izimpikiswano ezizenzakalelayo ezisetshenziswa yi-Synix lapho kwakhiwa umyalo wokuqalisa.

data.name: Text.6440A1A6AB337CD371BA
data.value: Qalisa nsuku zonke lapho ukuqala kabusha okuhleliwe kufanele kusebenze.

data.name: Text.A8142050CBD33EE95F3F
data.value: Sebenzisa isivinini esigcwele noma uvimbele ukufakwa, izibuyekezo, ukulungisa nokuqinisekiswa kwe-game server.

data.name: Text.60ADFA0715E4E83522DF
data.value: Sebenzisa i-webhook eyodwa kule seva bese ukhetha imilayezo okufanele iyithole.

data.name: Text.4910EE68C0A14BD4AF19
data.value: Sebenzisa kuphela lapho ukuhlolwa kufakazela ukuthi iseva idinga amafayela we-Steam DLL avunyelwe. Umgomo kumelwe uhlale ngaphakathi ifolda iseva.

data.name: Text.1433E221238B95E942F7
data.value: Sebenzisa kuphela lapho iseva isetshenziswa ngokusebenzisa iziqukathi ze-Hyper-V noma ze-Windows.

data.name: Text.F2029FAFB53EFFEE6890

data.name: Text.229193F097F563A43177

data.name: Text.A7678DBAFBD9E2842236
data.value: I-hardware eqinisekisiwe kanye nezidingo ze-Windows ezihlolwe ngaphambi kokuba i-Synix ifake noma iqalise iseva.

data.value: Lapho kusebenze, ukususa iseva kucela imvume yomlawuli yokususa imithetho yayo ye-Windows Firewall. Vimbela lokhu ukuze ungakwenzi ukuhlanzwa okuzenzakalelayo ngesikhathi ususa.

data.value: Le nqubo iyasebenza. Ukulinda ukuhlolwa kokuqala kwe-30 okwesibili (

data.name: DynamicText.B83EC0A78559E32C96D2
data.value: Lo mdlalo usuvele unobufakazi bezimpikiswano ezivela kule nguqulo ye-Synix noma inguqulo entsha.

data.name: DynamicText.2B2D90F9562301F0CDFF
data.value: Le nqubo ingathatha isikhathi esithile kuye ngokuthi idatha idinga ukupakishwa kangakanani.

data.name: MessageText.53B01E5FCFDE56675C9A
data.value:
Ukuxhuma i-GitHub ku-Synix?
I-Synix izosusa ukuxhumeka okufihliwe okugcinwe kule khompyutha, bese ivula i-GitHub ukuze ukwazi ukuhoxisa imvume ku-akhawunti yakho.

data.name: MessageText.FD1FB8A609DE5750E995
data.value: Ukufakwa, ukuqala, ukumisa nokuqapha okufakazelwayo kuqoshwa ngokuzenzakalela yi-Synix yangempela yokusebenza kweseva futhi ayikwazi ukumakwa ngesandla.

data.name: MessageText.9B6050841590FD1BB10A
data.value: Sicela umise iseva ngaphambi kokuhlela izilungiselelo zayo.

data.name: MessageText.D955BE724373ACFC3AD2
data.value:
Buyisela isipele sakamuva se-Synix?
I-Synix izoqala igcine amafayela wamanje ukuze lokhu kubuyiselwa nakho kungenziwa.

data.name: MessageText.A36A8AE6C94D6549F743
data.value: Gcina noma ukhiphe izinguquko kumhleli ngaphambi kokuhlola amanani agcinwe ku-disk.

data.name: MessageText.3AA26503CC8EA0B171F1
data.value: Isixwayiso Sokuphepha: Omunye wemithombo yakho uqukethe izinhlamvu ezingekho emthethweni.

data.name: MessageText.9E4EAF41685A751D0C5D
data.value: Setha ukuziphatha kokwakheka komdlalo bese ufaka noma yiluphi ulwazi lwesampula oludingekayo ngaphambi kokuphawula ukwakheka kwalo njengokuqinisekisiwe.

data.name: MessageText.37D35536B29E5D04935F
data.value: Misa le seva ngaphambi kokusetha kabusha ukucushwa kwayo.

data.name: MessageText.96B14861829C994EDBFF
data.value: Misa le seva ngaphambi kokubuyisela isipele sokusetha.

data.name: MessageText.713E1363B1176FB2ABCE
data.value: Qeda le seva kuqala. Ukuhlolwa kufanele kugcine ukuqala okusha okwenziwe ngezizathu ezibonisiwe.

data.name: MessageText.6B5EDE5E1A10BF24CA11
data.value: I-Synix ayikwazanga ukuthola ifolda yephrojekthi. Qalisa lokhu kuhlolwa kusuka ku- Visual Studio Build noma Rebuild yephrojekthi ye-Synix.

data.name: MessageText.4AE453C9E5CBA09BFB92
data.value: I-Synix ayikwazanga ukuvula imininingwane egciniwe ye-Discord webhook. Vula Izilungiselelo Zeseva bese ugcina ama-webhooks futhi.

data.name: MessageText.1D7E8CD37BFCD097E6DA
data.value: I-Synix ayinayo ithempulethi ephelele yokusetha kabusha yalo mdlalo.

data.name: MessageText.AA9402AAA45447FCB9A8
data.value: I-Synix izokwakha kabusha ukuhlelwa okuphelele kusuka kusampula yayo ethembekile, iphinde isebenzise amanani wesiphakeli agcinwe, futhi igcine isipele. Ukuqhubeka?

data.name: MessageText.3679B9A889A4F6F470DA
data.value: I-add-on ifakiwe futhi yaqinisekiswa. Qalisa iseva uma usukulungele.

data.value: I-add-on ifakiwe futhi yaqinisekiswa. Lolu hlelo ngokuvamile lungalulayisha kabusha ngaphandle kokuqala kabusha ngokuphelele.

data.name: MessageText.21619FB57FA1E3D42E43
data.value: Umyalo kufanele uphumelele zonke ukuhlolwa kokuqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuba i-Synix ingaqala ukuhlolwa kwezingxabano.

data.name: MessageText.EA2CD9B6AE3E2608F49E
data.value: I-Game Definition Builder iyatholakala kuphela ekwakheni ukuthuthukiswa.

data.name: MessageText.2A2FCD5BFFF42E6401AE
data.value: Uhlu lwezimpawu ze-mod olwenziwe ngomyalo lungilungile. Umdlalo uzothwebula noma uvuselele okuqukethwe okungokwengxenye yomhlinzeki lapho iseva iqala.

data.name: MessageText.A570646762EA80624E34
data.value: Iphakethe lokudlulisa elikhethiwe alikwazanga ukutholakala. Phinda ukhethe.

data.name: MessageText.313E93838C2B67200EAB
data.value: Lesi sigcini sinemvume engekho emthethweni ye-SHA-256 futhi asikwazi ukubuyiselwa. Khetha enye indlela yokuxhaswa.

data.name: MessageText.379C1CF1A5975C5E0C37
data.value: Le folda ayinalutho. Ukufaka lapha kungase kubhale phansi amafayela. Ukuqhubeka?

data.value: Lo mdlalo uphathwa ngokuphelele ngokusebenzisa izingxabano zokuqalisa, ngakho-ke akudingeki ukuhlolwa okuhlukile kwefayela lokulungisa.

data.value:

Noma yiziphi ezinye izindinganiso zokwakheka ezenziwe ngokwezifiso zizosuswa.

data.value: Le nqubo ye-add-on isebenzisa ifayela noma ifolda exhunywe. Khetha ifolda evamile; I-Synix ngeke ilandele leso sixhumanisi.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileMissing
data.value: Iphutha ifayela lokwengeza elidingekayo ukuze kubuyiselwe. Azikho amafayela ashintshiwe. Buyisela ifayela lokululama elilahlekile noma usebenzise isipele se-server esiqinisekisiwe ngaphambi kokususa lesi sengezo.

data.value: Ukusebenza kwesengezo kwehluleka futhi ezinye izinguquko azikwazi ukubuyiselwa emuva. Amafayela okubuyiswa agcinwa ku-{0}. Gcina iseva imisiwe bese ubuyisela lawo mafayela noma isipele se-server esiqinisekisiwe ngaphambi kokuyiqala.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Inkambu yokwethula i-{0} ayikwazi ukudlula ngokuphepha ngalesi sikhulisi se-Windows. Izingcaphuno ezifakiwe eziphindwe kabili, izingcaphuno zemigqa noma izinkulumo eziguquguqukayo azisekelwa lapha. Inani alizange lishintshe.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Umyalo ogcwalisiwe we-batch uqukethe i-syntax yomyalo engaphephile noma ukwanda okuguquguqukayo. Hlola amanani okuqalisa kanye nezimpikiswano ezengeziwe; Akukho lutho olwaluqaliwe.

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: YAML umugqa {0} akuvumelekile noma isebenzisa isici lokhu umhleli ayikwazi ukushintsha ngokuphepha. Isekelwa: idokhumenti elilodwa elinamabalazwe / uhlu olunezinhlamvu kanye namagugu womugqa owodwa. Ukuqoqwa kokugeleza, amanani wemigqa eminingi, amathegi, ama-anchor nama-alias akusekelwa. Akukho lutho olwasindiswa.

data.value: Inombolo ephelele kusuka ku-{0} kuya ku-{1}. Ukuze izwe elikhona, gcina imbewu yalo yokuqala.

data.name: ServerSetup.World.Seed.Hint
data.value: Yakha imbewu yezwe elisha, noma ungene ezweni lakho. Ukuze izwe elikhona, gcina imbewu yalo yokuqala.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Lolu hlelo lwephakeji lusekelwa kuphela kumafolda okuqukethwe akhonjiswe yi-Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Sebenzisa igama lefolda lezinhlamvu ze-1–80, ngaphandle kwama-slashes, amagama e-Windows agciniwe, noma izikhala eziphambili / ezilandelanayo. Igama lesimo ngeke libe inombolo yeWorkshop kuphela.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Khetha isimo esiphelele esikhishiwe noma iphakethe le-mod server elihlanganisiwe, hhayi ukufakwa komdlalo, iqoqo le-Workshop, iphrofayili, noma i-source-code archive.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: Isimo kufanele sibe ne-gameoptions.yaml nezinsizakusebenza zayo Zokuqukethwe, Izinkundla Zokudlala, Imikhakha, noma Izinsizakusebenza Zokwakha ndawonye, kungaba kusisekelo se-ZIP noma ngaphakathi kwefolda yesimo esisodwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Le phakheji yesimo iqukethe ikhodi ye-DLL, i-C# noma i-JAR. Ngenisa ikhodi yeseva ngokwehlukana nge-Empyrion server mods ngemuva kokubuyekeza imiyalo yombhali.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Khetha iphakethe le-mod elihlanganisiwe eliphelele: Amafayela we-DLL namafayela awo okusekela kufanele abekwe empandeni yephakheji noma ngaphakathi kwamafolda e-mod ahlukene. Amafolda angaphezulu okupakisha kanye nemibhalo ephelele yesiphakeli ayamukelwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Leso simo asifakwanga. Thumela kuqala isimo esiphelele, bese usikhetha ohlwini olufakiwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Isimo noma izilungiselelo zokugcina zishintshile ngenkathi leli windi livulekile. Yivale bese ukhetha isimo futhi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Leso sivikelo sesivele sikhona. Isimo esihlukile sidinga igama elisha, elingasetshenziswanga. I-Synix ayizange ithathe indawo noma isuse umhlaba okhona.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: I-dedicated.yaml ayisekho, inkulu kakhulu, noma ayiqukethe isethingi esisodwa se-GameConfig.CustomScenario ne-GameConfig.GameName. Qala ngokulungisa iseva kuqala.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: I-Synix ayikwazanga ukulondoloza ukungena kweseva. Ukuhlelwa kwesimo sangaphambilini sekubuyiselwe; Ukugcinwa kwezikhali.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: I-Synix ngeke isuse isimo esikhethiwe noma izimpahla zesimo ngenkathi kukhona imihlaba egcinwe. Lawo mazwe angase ancike kumafayela. Azikho amafayela wesimo asusiwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.ImportedScenario
data.value: Kwakungeniswa amafayela wesikrini. Umhlaba wamanje nokukhethwa kwesimo akuzange kushintshe. Sebenzisa Ukukhetha Isimo ukuze ukhethe isimo negama lokulondoloza. Gcina igama lefolda elifanayo uma ungenisa isibuyekezo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ScenarioHelp
data.value: Bhalisela ku-Steam bese uvumela ukulanda kuphele, bese ukhetha ifolda yesimo ngaphansi kwe-steamapps\workshop\content\383120, noma ukhethe i-ZIP yesimo esiphelele. Lokhu kungenisa ikhophi yendawo; I-Steam ngeke ivuselele ikhophi yesiphakeli ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModHelp
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP yesiphakeli esiphelele noma ifolda evela kumlobi omethembayo. Gcina ama-DLL, i-_Info.yaml (lapho inikezwe), ukuxhomeka kanye nempahla ndawonye. I-Synix ayilandeli ukuxhomeka noma isebenzise ikhodi ye-mod ngokwayo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.FolderName
data.value: Igama lefolda yesimo kuseva (phinde usebenzise leli gama ukuze uvuselele)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Confirm
EmpyrionMods.Selection.Saved
data.value: Isikrini nokukhethwa kokulondoloza kwagcinwa. Qalisa iseva lapho ikulungele, bese uhlola ilogi yalo yomdlalo futhi uxhumane neklayenti. Kwagcinwa amafolda omhlaba akhona.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Help
EmpyrionMods.Selection.SaveName
data.value: Gcina igama (GameConfig.GameName ?? hhayi igama lokubonisa leseva)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.NewSaveNotice
data.value: Isimo esihlukile sidinga ukusindiswa okusha. I-Synix iphakamisa igama elisha futhi ayikaze isuse noma ibhale phansi umhlaba okhona.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Scenarios
data.value: Ngenisa ifolda elayishiwe noma i-ZIP. Sebenzisa Khetha Scenario kamuva; amasheya akhona avikelwe.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Support.Mods
data.value: Ngenisa amafolda we-mod aphelele noma ama-ZIP. Hlola ukuthi umlobi uncike kuphi; ikhodi isebenza ku-Empyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Remove.Confirm
data.value: Ukubuyisela emuva ukungeniswa okuqukethe i-{0}? Wonke amafayela afakwe yilelo phakeji elifanayo azosuswa noma abuyiselwe kumakhophi awo angaphambilini, kufaka phakathi amanye ama-modes ephaketheni. Amafayela ashintshiwe ngaphandle kwe-Synix azovimba ukubuyela emuva. Gcina isipele esigcwele se-server ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.FolderUnsupported
data.value: Lolu hlelo olungeziwe aluxhasi ukungeniswa kwamafolda. Khetha enye yamaphakeji ayo asekelwayo.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Khetha ifolda ephelele ye-mod noma yesimo equkethe amafayela ephakheji adingekayo, hhayi ukufakwa komdlalo noma iqoqo lokulanda okungahlobene.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Size
data.value: Iphakheji lidlula imingcele yokungenisa yalesi simiso esengeziwe, noma okuqukethwe kwalo kushintshiwe ngenkathi kukopishwa. Akukho lutho olwakhiwe.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.Help
data.value: Khetha i-mod ZIP ephelele noma ifolda yomdlalo nohlaka olukhethiwe. Gcina i-manifesto yayo edingekayo, ukuxhomeka kwayo kanye nempahla ndawonye. Hlola indawo oya kuyo bese uhlola imiphumela ngaphambi kokuyifaka.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.SelectFolder
data.value: Khetha ifolda ephelele ye-mod noma yesimo, hhayi ukufakwa komdlalo

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Import.ExistingScenario
data.value: Le folda yesimo sezulu isivele ikhona. Amafayela ahambisanayo ayothathelwa indawo, angathinta imihlaba esebenzisa lesi simo. Gcina isipele esigcwele se-server futhi usebenzise igama lefolda elihlukile esimweni esihlukile. Amafayela e-Saved World ngeke ashintshwe.

data.name: ModManager.Error.NewerInstallation
data.value: Ukungeniswa okusha manje kunamafayela kuleli phakethe. Qalisa ngokufaka okusha kuqala.

data.name: ModManager.Error.PreviousFileChanged
data.value: Ifayela lokuqala eligcinwe lishintshile. I-Rollback yayimisiwe ngaphambi kokushintsha amafayela wesiphakeli. Buyisela isipele esithembekile se-server ephelele uma kudingeka.

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Installing
data.value: Ukufaka iphakethe elibuyekeziwe nokugcina amakhophi angemuva...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Removing
data.value: Ukuhlola iphakethe eliphelele nokubuyisela amafayela adlule...

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Framework
data.value: Ukufaka isikhombimsebenzisi se-server. Sicela ugcine leli windi livulekile...

data.name: ModManager.Framework.SaveFailed
data.value: Amafayela esikhungo afakiwe, kodwa i-Synix ayikwazanga ukugcina izilungiselelo zesiphakeli. Hlola imvume yefolda bese ugcina kabusha ukwakheka kweseva ngaphambi kokuyiqalisa. Amafayela afakiwe awazange achithwe.

data.name: ModManager.Progress.Failed
data.value: Umsebenzi awuzange uqedwe. Hlola iphutha, bese uyavuselela ngaphambi kokuba uphinde uzame.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Wait
data.value: Linda kuze kube yilapho umsebenzi wamanje uqeda.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Phatha iseva ye-Minecraft ekhethiwe lapha. Yiyeke ngaphambi kokushintsha amafayela, imihlaba, amaphakheji, noma isikhathi sokuqalisa. Qala, uyeke futhi uqale kabusha ukusebenzisa ukuvikelwa okujwayelekile kwempilo ye-Synix.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Sebenzisa amashejuli okuqala kabusha nokugcinwa, kuhlanganise nokulinda abadlali nokwenza isipele esigcwele kuqala. Isikhathi sisebenzisa isikhathi sendawo se-PC. I-Synix kumelwe isebenze ukuze i-scheduler yayo isebenze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Vuselela ukuze ubuke amagama aku-inthanethi nezinhlu zokufinyelela ezigciniwe. Khetha noma uthayiphe igama lomdlali, bese uhlola isenzo. Imiyalo idinga iseva esebenzayo kanye nokuxhumeka kwekhonsoli yokusebenza. I-Bedrock ayisekeli imiyalo yokuvimbela i-Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Hlela i-server.properties namafayela wokwakheka we-mod/plugin. Amanani asetshenziswe yi-Synix ayavumelaniswa lapho kugcinwa i-server.properties. Igama elikhangisiwe / i-MOTD lihlukaniswe negama lendawo lale ndatshana. Ukuvuselela ukulayisha kabusha ukuhlela kwangaphandle kokumisa ngenkathi kuvinjelwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Ukugcina kudala amakhophi okubuyisela. Izinguquko kumachweba, umhlaba, imbewu, imodi yomdlalo, umkhawulo womdlali, nezilungiselelo zokulawula ze-Minecraft ezisekelwayo nazo zivuselela i-Synix. I-JSON, i-XML ne-YAML zihlolwe ngaphambi kokulondoloza; Amanye amafomethi adinga ukuhlelwa ngokucophelela. Gcina ama-credentials eyimfihlo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Ngenisa i-Java noma i-Bedrock world ZIP kufolda entsha, bese uyikhetha ukuyisebenzisa. Izwe elikhona alikwazi ukushintshwa. Izincwadi aziguqulwa. Ukuguqulwa akuphuculisi, kunciphise noma kuqinisekise ukuhambisana komdlalo / imodi yomhlaba; buyela emuva kuqala.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Hlola i-JAR metadata kanye nokuncika, ukuphatha izengezo ngabanye, noma ukubuyekeza iphakethe le-server eliphelele. Sebenzisa inguqulo yemidlalo eqondile yepakethe kanye nokwakhiwa kwe-loader. Ukuhlolwa kokuhambisana kuyiseluleko futhi akufakazeli ukuthi ikhodi iphephile noma ukuthi yonke imodi izosebenza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Izipele ezigcwele zihlanganisa ifolda yesiphakeli, imihlaba, izengezo nokulungiswa. Qeda iseva kuqala. Qinisekisa ubuqotho ngaphambi kokubuyisa. Ukubuyisela esikhundleni amafayela iseva; amakhuphoni aqinisekisa ubuqotho be-archive, hhayi ukuthi isipele siqukethe inkinga esevele ikhona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Zonke izinguquko zokuqukethwe zigcina amafayela angaphambilini nama-hashes. Khetha ushintsho olusetshenzisiwe noma oluphukile ukuze uluthole. Qala ngokulungisa izinguquko ezintsha eziphikisanayo. Amafayela aguqulwe ngaphandle kanye nezwe elingenisiwe elisebenzayo livikelekile. Gcina isipele esigcwele sokuphucula isikhathi sokuqalisa / umhlaba.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Bheka izinkinga ezivamile emibhalweni yakamuva yesiphakeli nombiko wokushaqeka. Lokhu okutholakele kuyizinkomba, hhayi izimbangela eziqinisekisiwe. Inqubo CPU/RAM akuyona i-Minecraft TPS/MSPT; Sebenzisa iphrofayili ehambisanayo yesiphakeli lapho kuhlolwa ukusebenza kwe-tick.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Ukuvimbela lokhu kuseva ngokusebenzisa i-Synix manje?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Qalisa kabusha le seva nge-Synix manje?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Faka inguqulo yomdlalo ekhethiwe, ukulayisha, nokwakha kusuka emithonjeni yabo esemthethweni? Lokhu kungalayisha i-Java futhi kusebenze umfakisicelo osemthethweni we-Forge / NeoForge. Amafayela wesiphakeli ahlelwe kuqala; amafayela ashintshiwe ngaphambili agcinwa ukuze alulame. Izwe nezithasiselo zigcinwe. Yenza isipele esigcwele ngaphambi kokushintsha izinguqulo zomdlalo. Ayikho iseva yomdlalo eqale ukusebenza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Thumela umyalo womdlali okhethiwe? Ukufinyelela komqhubi kunikeza ukulawula okubanzi kuseva yomdlalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Sebenzisa izwe elikhethiwe ekuqaleni okulandelayo? Umhlaba wamanje uhlala usendaweni yediski. Khetha kuphela izwe elihambisana nalolu hlelo lokusebenza, inguqulo, kanye nemodi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Ukungenisa leli phakeji le-server elithembekile? Iphakethe le-Modrinth lingalanda amafayela abhekiswe kuwo emithonjeni ye-HTTPS evunyelwe. Imodi nemibhalo yomdlalo isebenzisa ikhodi ngaphakathi kwesiphakeli somdlalo. Ukuhlelwa, i-hash, ukuhambisana nokuhlolwa kwe-antivirus akukhona isiqinisekiso sokuphepha. Hlola zonke izinguquko ngaphambi kokuzisebenzisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Amasheke afunda imethadatha ngaphandle kokulayisha ikhodi ye-mod. Izinhlobo eziyinkimbinkimbi zezinguqulo, ukuxhomeka okunemibandela, kanye neminye imethadatha ehlanganisiwe / eyindlalifa idinga ukubuyekezwa okuzenzakalelayo. Lokhu kuhlolwa akuqinisekisi ukuhambisana noma ukungabikho kwe-malware.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Hlola indawo yokusekela kanye nendawo ekhululekile.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Yenza isipele esiphelele salokhu kumiswa kweseva?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Ukubuyisela isipele esiphelele esikhethiwe? Amafayela asevele ekhona esiphakeli azothathelwa indawo. Qinisekisa imibhalo bese ugcina noma yimaphi amafayela wamanje osadinga ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Thola amafayela adlule alolu shintsho. Amafayela afakwe ngalolu shintsho asuswa kuphela uma engashintshiwe. Amafayela aguqulwe avimbela ukubuyiselwa. Ukugcinwa okugcwele kuyadingeka ukuze kubuyiselwe emuva noma yikuphi ukuguqulwa komhlaba okwenziwe ngemuva kokuqala inguqulo yomdlalo ehlukile.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Ayikho iphethini eyaziwayo etholakalayo emibhalweni yakamuva. Lokhu akuyona ukuhlolwa kwempilo okuphelele. Sebenzisa i- Readiness bese uhlola iphutha lokuqala eduze nesikhathi sokwehluleka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Ukubuyekezwa ngaphambi kokufaka isicelo: I- {0} entsha • I- {1} ithathwe indawo • I- {2} iyasuswa. Amafayela adlule agcinwa ukuze alulame. Ayikho iseva eqale ukusebenza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Ukwakhiwa kwesiphakeli esizinzile okuceliwe noma imethadatha yayo yokulanda ayitholakali. Vuselela ukukhetha inguqulo/ukwakha bese uzama futhi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Lokhu okuqukethwe kudlula umkhawulo wefayela osekelwayo, imethadatha, noma usayizi ophelele.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Idatha yokutakula ayisekho noma ayihambelani. Gcina ifolda yokutakula futhi usebenzise isipele esiphelele esiqinisekisiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Ukusebenza kokuqukethwe kwangaphambilini kudinga ukubuyiselwa. Vula ukubuyiswa kwe-Change bese uyilungisa ngaphambi kokwenza olunye ushintsho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Ifayela elishintshiwe kusukela ekubuyekezweni noma kusukela kulokhu kusebenza. Ukuvuselela nokubuyekeza futhi. Azikho izinguquko ezingahlobene eziyobhalwa ngaphezulu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Ukuhlelwa kwephakheji noma indlela akuphephile, ayicacile, noma ayisekelwa. Khetha iphakethe le-server elisekelwayo noma umlando womhlaba.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Leli izwe elisebenzayo elingenisiwe. Shintshela kwelinye izwe ngaphambi kokuqeda ukungeniswa kwalo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Leyo folda yomhlaba isivele ikhona. Khetha igama elisha lefolda; Izwe elikhona alisoze labhalwa phansi ngokungeniswa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Khetha i-archive equkethe umhlaba owodwa nge level.dat. Ama-archive ase-server egcwele nama-multi-world asebenzisa ukugeleza komsebenzi wokulondoloza / ukubuyisela esikhundleni salokho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Leli zwe alihambelani nenguqulo yesiphakeli noma alikho amafayela alo alindelekile esifunda/idathabase. Izwe le-Java ne-Bedrock aliguqulwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Sebenzisa igama lefolda elivikelekile lomhlaba, ngaphandle kwemikhondo noma amagama e-Windows agciniwe. Ezweni elithengisiwe, sebenzisa izinhlamvu, izinombolo, izikhala, ama-hyphen, noma amaphuzu aphansi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Lokhu ukuhamba komsebenzi kuyenzelwe i-Java server mods/plugins. Sebenzisa ukugeleza komsebenzi okungeziwe okusekelwa yi-Bedrock uqobo; I-Java JAR ayikwazi ukusebenza ku-Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Akukho okuqukethwe kweseva okusekelwayo okutholakale. Izikripthi zokuqalisa, amafayela amaklayenti, izikhathi zokuqalisa, imihlaba, nezilungiselelo zesiphakeli somthombo azingeniswa ngemisebenzi ye-modpack.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Uhlobo lokuqukethwe aluhambisani nesofthiwe yesiphakeli ekhethiwe. Mods udinga ukufanisa mod loader; Ama-plugin e-Bukkit/Paper adinga isikhathi sokuqalisa se-plugin.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Lena i-CurseForge client manifest, hhayi iphakethe eliphelele server. Landa i-ZIP yesiphakeli somlobi equkethe ama-mod nama-config angempela; amafayela angatholakali awaphunyuki buthule.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Inguqulo ye-Minecraft yephakethe kanye nomthwali / ukwakhiwa kufanele kuhambisane nale seva. Khetha bese usebenzisa isikhathi sokusebenza esiqondile kuqala. Ama-loader angasekelwayo awafakwa esikhundleni.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Ukulandwa noma ukuqondiswa kabusha akuyona umthombo ovunyiwe womphakathi we-HTTPS. Sebenzisa i-ZIP yesiphakeli sendawo esisekelwa umbhali esikhundleni salokho.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Ifayela elayishiwe alihambelani nosayizi walo ohlongozwayo noma i-hash ye-SHA-512. Akukho lutho olwakhiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Inani le-Minecraft elisetshenziswe yi-Synix alivumelekile noma liyaphikisana. Hlola iziteshi, umkhawulo womdlali, imodi yomdlalo nezilungiselelo zokulawula ngaphambi kokulondoloza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: I-Synix ayikwazanga ukulondoloza okufakiwe kweseva okubuyekeziwe. Umsebenzi awuzange wamukelwe; amafayela okubuyisela agcinwa lapho kudingeka khona.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Ukuxhumeka kokuphathwa kwe-Synix kwe-Minecraft kufanele kuhlale ku-host yendawo. Ungadaluli leli phuzu lokulawula ku-Internet.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: I-port ekhethiwe ingeyomunye iseva ye-Synix. Khetha itheku elihlukile ngaphambi kokulondoloza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Khetha isenzo esisekelwayo negama lomdlali elivumelekile. Ukuvinjelwa kwe-Java akuyona imiyalo ye-Bedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Iseva ayizange iqale. Hlola Ukulungele kanye ne-dashboard activity log ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: I-metadata ayikwazanga ukufundwa ngokugcwele. Hlola ifayela nezidingo zokuhambisana nomlobi walo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Ama-JAR angaphezu kwelilodwa aphezulu akhipha lesi siqinisekiso. Hlola futhi ususe inguqulo ephindwe kabili.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: I-JAR ithi ingamakhasimende kuphela. Ungayifaki kuseva enikeziwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: I-metadata yale JAR ayihambisani nomthwali / isofthiwe ekhethiwe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Ukuxhomeka okudingekayo okungatholakali kwimethadatha ehlaziywe: {0}. Ngaphambi kokufaka noma yini, hlola ukuxhomeka okuhlanganisiwe noma okunemibandela.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Hlola ukuxhomeka {0} ngesandla: kudingekile {1}, kuskena {2}. Lolu hlu / inguqulo ayiqondakali ngokugcwele.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: I-log iphakamisa ukungahambelani kwe-Java / isigaba-isigaba. Sebenzisa inguqulo ye-Java edingekayo kuseva ekhethiwe nomthwali we-mod.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Umlando usikisela ukuthi i-Java ayikwazanga ukuhlukanisa imemori eyanele. Hlola i-RAM etholakalayo, umkhawulo wesiphakeli, nokuthi amanye amaseva ayasidla yini.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Umlando ukhuluma ngezidingo zokuncika. Hlola iphutha lokuqala lokulayisha, bese uhlola i-mod ecacile, ukuxhomeka, inguqulo yomdlalo nokwakhiwa komlayishi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Umlando usikisela ukuthi isikhumulo sesivele sisetshenziswa. Hlola ezinye izinqubo kanye nezimbobo ezilungiselelwe salokhu kuseva; ungavuli izimbobo zomlilo ezingahlobene.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: I-log icela ukwamukelwa kwe-Minecraft EULA. Funda bese uyamukela ngokuhamba komsebenzi okujwayelekile kokuqala uma uvuma.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Umlando ubika ukuwohloka kwesimo sezulu noma isikhathi sokuqapha. Hlola ukulayishwa kwe-CPU, ukukhiqizwa komhlaba wonke, izinhlayiya, nemodi. I-RAM eyengeziwe iyodwa ingase ingayixazululi le nkinga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Iphutha le-mixin livame ukuhilela inhlanganisela ye-mod / loader engavumelani. Hlola imbangela yokuqala embikweni wenhlekelele kanye nezinguqulo ezifunekayo zepakethe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: I-log ibika amaphutha okufundwa kwedatha yomhlaba. Misa iseva bese ugcina amafayela akhona ngaphambi kokuzama ukufaka isipele esivumelanayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Lesi sikhungo esidala asinalo iphrofayili eqoshiwe yesikhathi sokusebenza. Sebenzisa isipele esiphelele se-server ukuze usithole; I-Synix ngeke iqagele ukulayisha kwayo kwangaphambilini kanye nenguqulo yayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Isikhathi sokusebenza esifakiwe asihambelani nesidingo se-Java esakhethiwe, inguqulo, umthwalo noma isidingo. Vula iSikhungo Sokulawula se- Minecraft bese usebenzisa Isikhathi Sokusebenzisa ngaphambi kokuqala.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Inani le-{0} alivumelekile. Lungisa lesi silungiselelo ngaphambi kokulondoloza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Azikho izinto zokubonisa. Vuselela ngemuva kokungeza okuqukethwe noma ukushintsha ukucushwa kwaleli seva.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: Izengezo ze- {0} ezichazwe • Ukutholakele kwe- {1} okudingeka kubhekwe. Leli sheke aliguquli amafayela.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Azikho izengezo ezitholakale kufolda ye-mods noma ama-plugins asebenzayo kulokhu kusethwa kweseva.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Azikho izinkinga ezitholakale ekuhlolweni kwemethadatha. Lokhu akuqinisekisi ukuthi yonke imodi noma i-plugin izosebenza ndawonye.

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP ye-ASA Windows-server elayishiwe noma ifolda ethathwe. I-Synix ithola ama-mod descriptors ngaphakathi kwamaphakheji aphansi, agcwele, noma amaningi futhi ilungiselela ukubuyekezwa kwama-ID abo e-CurseForge. Amafayela e-ZIP awakopishwanga noma awafakwanga. I-ASA idonsa futhi ibhalise ukwakhiwa kweseva yamanje yomhlinzeki lapho uqala iseva; Lokhu akuvumelani nenguqulo ye-ZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP noma ifolda ozoyihlola. Azikho izilungiselelo noma amafayela wesiphakeli azoshintsha uze uhlole futhi ugcine ohlwini lwe-ID ye-mod ngokuhlukile.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Imethadatha yephakheji ayithembekile. Ukuhlonza akuyona i-malware scan, ukuhlolwa kokuhambisana, noma ubufakazi bokuthi ungumshicileli.

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Ukufunda imethadatha yephakethe. Ayikho ikhodi ye-mod eyenziwe.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: I-{0} mods ekhonjiwe; {1} izitifiketi ezintsha ukufaka. Ama-ID akhona agcina ukuhleleka kwawo. Hlola uhlu oluphelele ngaphambi kokulondoloza.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Ukuhlolwa kwephakeji kwakhanselwa noma kwathatha isikhathi eside kakhulu. Khetha ifolda encane yephakheji bese uzama futhi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Khetha i-ARK server mod ZIP noma ifolda ye-mod ekhishwe. Amanye amafomethi e-archive awasekelwa yilo mfundi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Iphakethe lidlula imingcele yomfundi wemethadatha. Khetha ifolda encane noma i-ZIP enezincazelo ze-100 mod kuphela.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Iphakethe liqukethe izindlela ezingaphephile, izixhumanisi, izindlela eziphindwe kabili, amafayela angqubuzanayo noma amafolda amaningi kakhulu. Akukho lutho olushintshile.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Ayikho i- .uplugin mod descriptor eyatholakala. Khetha i-mod ZIP noma ifolda yayo ethathwe; imibhalo ehlanganisiwe kufanele ithathwe kuqala.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: I-mod descriptor ayivumelekile, i-JSON engacacile. Akukho lutho olushintshile.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Isichazamazwi asibonisi iphrojekthi ye-ARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge. I-Synix ngeke ikwazi ukuqagela umdlalo noma ukuhlonza imodeli.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: I-descriptor ayinayo i-ID eyodwa yephrojekthi ye-CurseForge (cf_ugcID). Sebenzisa i-Manage Mod IDs nge-ID evela ekhasini lomlobi le-CurseForge.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: I-mod ayinayo iphakethe le-WindowsServer elaziwayo noma ayinakho ifayela elihambisanayo le-.ucas/.utoc. Khetha i-Windows-server yokulanda, hhayi ukwakha iklayenti.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Iphakethe liqukethe incazelo engaphezu kweyodwa ye-ID efanayo yemodeli. Khetha inguqulo eyodwa ye-mod ngayinye uphinde uhlole.

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Khetha i-ARK: Survival Evolved mod ZIP noma ifolda equkethe i-.mod descriptor kanye nefolda yayo ye-mod ephekiwe ehambisanayo. I-Synix ifunda i-ID ye-Workshop kusuka kumchazi, hhayi igama le-ZIP. Amafayela awakopishwa noma afakwe: ngemuva kokubuyekeza, i-Synix ivuselela i-ActiveMods ne-ModIDS yomzila wokulanda othomathikhi we-ARK. Amamephu kanye nokuguqulwa okuphelele kungase kudinge ukumiswa kwesiphakeli okuhlukile. Amaphakheji e-ASA CurseForge awavumelani.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Lokhu akuyona ukuthekelisa okuphelele kwe-ASE. Faka incazelo ye-.mod kanye nefolda ye-mod ehambisanayo ne-mod.info kanye nezinsizakusebenza eziphekiwe. I-ID efakwe ngaphakathi kufanele ihambisane nanoma yiliphi igama lefayela le-numeric descriptor. Ukulandwa kwe-Raw Workshop .z ngaphandle kwefayela le-.mod elungiselelwe akusekelwa yilesi sifundo; Sebenzisa i- Manage Mod IDs esikhundleni salokho.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Leli phasela liqukethe incazelo yesinye isihloko se-ARC. I-ASA Steam Workshop mods ne-ASA CurseForge mods aziguquguquki. Khetha iphakethe leseva elikhethiwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Help
data.value: Setha ifolda ye-mod noma i-plugin bese wamukela izinhlobo eziyinhloko zamafayela usebenzisa imiyalo yalo mdlalo noma umthwali. Lokhu kusebenza kuphela kule seva. Khetha indawo ekhona ukuze uyivuselele; Ayikho amafayela we-mod ashintshiwe lapha.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Warning
data.value: Ukungenisa amafayela akufaki i-loader noma i-mods elawulwa umhlinzeki wokubhalisa. Hlola imiyalo yokufakwa komdlalo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Ready
data.value: Ukungenisa amafayela ngokwezifiso ?? Ukubuyekeza izidingo zokuhambisana

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Start
data.value: Sebenzisa izindawo zokungenisa ukuze usethe ifolda ye-mod noma ye-plugin yale seva. Ukungenisa amafayela akubonisi ukuthi umdlalo ungakwazi ukulayisha.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Help
data.value: Khetha ifolda ngaphakathi kwephakeji okuqukethwe kwayo kungokwendawo yesiphakeli ekhethiwe. Amafolda engezansi agcinwa. Ungasusa izembozo zokulanda ngokukhetha ifolda ejulile. Kuzokungeniswa kuphela amafayela akhonjisiwe; amafayela akhona athola amakhophi okubuyiselwa. Lokhu akusho ukuguqula mods ezingahambelani.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Reading
data.value: Ukufunda iphakethe nokulungiselela ukubuka kuqala kwendawo oya kuyo...

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Summary
data.value: Amafayela e-{0} akhethiwe; Amafayela akhona e-{1} azofakwa ohlangothini ngaphambi kokuwashintsha. Akukho okufakiwe kuze kube isiqinisekiso esilandelayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InvalidLocations
data.value: Izindawo zokungenisa ezigcinwe azivumelekile noma ziyingxenye yomdlalo wesiphakeli ohlukile. Azikho amafayela ashintshiwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InstallFolder
data.value: Faka le seva ngaphambi kokuhlela izindawo zokungenisa zendawo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationLimit
data.value: Iseva ingase ibe nezindawo zokungenisa ezizenzakalelayo ze-32.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationName
data.value: Faka igama lendawo lezinhlamvu ze-1–80 bese ukhetha iMod noma i-Plugin.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Extensions
data.value: Faka izandiso zefayela eziyinhloko ze-1–32, kufaka phakathi amaphuzu azo, njenge .dll noma .pak. Izinhlelo zokufaka nemibhalo yomyalo ayamukelwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Collision
data.value: Iphakethe linokungqubuzana kwefayela/ifolda. Khetha iphakethe eliphelele, elicacile.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.NoFiles
data.value: Ifolda yephakeji ekhethiwe ayinazo izinhlobo eziyinhloko zefayela kule ndawo. Khetha enye ifolda yokuqukethwe noma ubukeze izinhlobo ezamukelwe zendawo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.PackageRoot
data.value: Khetha ifolda evumelekile ngaphakathi kwephakeji. Izindlela ezingaphandle kwephakheji azamukelekile.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Done
data.value: Amafayela angenisiwe. Kwakugcinwa amakhophi ukuze kufakwe amafayela ayeshintshiwe. Hlola izidingo zokulayisha nokwenza lo mdlalo ngaphambi kokuqala. Ayikho iseva eyaqala ukusebenza.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Rollback
data.value: Ukubuyisela emuva lonke iphakethe elithunyelwe "{0}" (amafayela e-{1})? Lokhu kubuyisela amafayela ayo angaphambilini futhi kususe amafayela afakwe iphakethe. Ithinta wonke amaphakheji, hhayi kuphela ifayela elikhethiwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Help
data.value: Khetha i-ZIP, ifayela le-mod elayishiwe, noma ifolda ekhiphwe. I-Synix ifunda iphakethe le-{0} futhi ibonisa ukuthi izokwengezwa kanjani ngaphambi kokushintsha noma yini.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.File
data.value: Khetha ifayela le- ZIP noma le- mod

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Empty
data.value: Qala ngokukhetha i-ZIP noma ifolda oyilandile. Awudingi ukuhlela izindawo zokungenisa kuqala.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.DestinationHelp
data.value: Khetha ifolda ye-mod ngaphakathi kwaleli seva, ulandele imiyalelo yokufaka yomdlalo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Reading
data.value: Ukufunda iphakethe nokuhlola ukwakheka kwalo... akukho amafayela wesiphakeli ashintshelwayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Unknown
data.value: Funda amafayela e-{0}. I-Synix ayikwazanga ukuthola indawo yalo mdlalo. Khetha ifolda ye-mod yesiphakeli; izinhlobo zamafayela zigcwaliswa ngokuzenzakalela. Ungalindeli ukuthi liyini ifolda.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Ambiguous
data.value: Funda amafayela e-{0}. Izindawo ezingaphezu kweyodwa zingase zilungele. Khetha i-mod noma i-plugin ehambisanayo ngenhla ukuze uyibuke kusengaphambili.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Cancelled
data.value: Ukufundwa kwephakheji kukhanselwe. Akukho lutho olungenisiwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderDetails
UniversalMods.Wizard.ProviderWarning
data.value: Sithole izitifiketi {0}. Okulandelayo, hlola uhlu lweziqu. I-ARK ilanda ama-mods ekuqaliseni kwayo okulandelayo; Lokhu akuyona ifayela lendawo elayishiwe. Ayikho iseva eqala ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.LoaderMissing
data.value: Leli phakeji lidinga umlayisi ofanayo. Setha i-loader kuzilungiselelo zeseva, bese uvula kabusha i-Import. Amafayela awazange ashintshwe.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.Summary
data.value: Amafayela e-{0} azokungeniswa; Amafayela akhona e-{1} azofakwa ohlangothini ngaphambi kokuwashintsha. Hlola izindawo okuyiwa kuzo ngezansi. Ayikho iseva eqala ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Wizard.ManualWarning
data.value: Amafayela azokopishwa ku-{0}. Hlola ukubuka kuqala nemiyalo yomdlalo: ukukhetha ifolda akufaki umthwali noma kusebenze ama-mods aphethwe ngumhlinzeki. Lesi sikhala sizokhunjulwa kuphela ngemva kokuqinisekiswa.

data.name: ModSupport.ImportRules
data.value: I-Synix inezimiso zokungenisa kulo mdlalo. Iphakethe kufanele lifanelane nomthwali ofakiwe, inguqulo yesiphakeli nokuxhomeka.

data.name: ModSupport.ManualSetup
data.value: Ayikho imithetho yokufakwa okuzenzakalelayo etholakalayo kulo mdlalo okwamanje. Funda indlela engezansi ngaphambi kokukhetha indawo oya kuyo; amafayela angase adinge nokwenziwa kusebenze ekwakhiweni noma kumhlinzeki.

data.name: ModSupport.EvidenceNote
data.value: Ukusekelwa okuqinisekisiwe akuyona ukuhlolwa kokuhambisana kweseva ebukhoma. Ama-mods wesiphakeli, ama-mods wamaklayenti kanye nama-loader installer ahlukile. Ayikho into elayishiwe, efakwe noma eqaliswe yilesi siqondiso.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Ayikho indlela enokwethenjelwa yokufaka i-server-specific okwamanje eqinisekisiwe. Lokhu akusho ukuthi lo mdlalo awukwazi ukuguqulwa. Khetha i-ZIP noma ifolda ukuze uyihlole, bese usebenzisa imiyalelo yesiphakeli somlobi ukuze uqinisekise lapho uya khona nokuvuselelwa.

data.name: ModSupport.GuidedImport
data.value: Izindlela zokushintsha amaseva ziyatholakala. Sebenzisa ukusekelwa kwe-Mod & setup ukuze uthole imiyalo yokusebenza, bese ungenisa i-ZIP / ifolda ukuhlola iphakethe lakho.

data.name: ModSupport.UnverifiedImport
data.value: Khetha Import ZIP / ifolda ukuze uhlole iphakethe. Ukuqinisekisa izidingo zokusekelwa kweseva; Ukusekela & ukumisa Mod kuchaza imikhawulo.

data.name: ModSupport.InvalidCatalog
data.value: Ikhathalogi yokusekela imidlalo ye-mod ayikwazanga ukufundwa. Hlola ukuthi ukufakwa kwakho kwe-Synix sekuphelile yini.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.Changed
data.value: Lokhu kulungiselelwa kwashintsha selokhu kwavulwa. Phinda uyivule ngaphambi kokulondoloza.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.SaveEntry
data.value: Ukungena kweseva ye-Synix akukwazanga ukulondolozwa. Ukucushwa nezilungiselelo zesiphakeli sekubuyiselwe.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.Ambiguous
data.value: Isilungiselelo esabiwe "{0}" sinamanani aphindwe kabili noma aphikisayo. Lungisa lezi ngaphambi kokulondoloza ukuze i-Synix ingabuyekeza inani lesiphakeli elilungile.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.InvalidValue
data.value: Isilungiselelo esabiwe "{0}" sinenani elingavumelekile le-Synix. Lilungise ngaphambi kokuba ulondoloze.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.RollbackFailed
data.value: Ukugcina kwehlulekile futhi ukuhlelwa kokuqala akukwazanga ukubuyiselwa ngokuzenzakalela. Ungaqali iseva uze ubukeze ukucushwa nokulondoloza kwayo: {0}

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingCompatibility
data.value: Khetha iphakethe nendawo ehambisanayo ukuze ubone ukuthi yini i-Synix engayihlola.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingDestination
data.value: Ayikho indawo okuyiwa kuyo ekhethiwe. Azikho amafayela noma izilungiselelo zeseva ezishintshiwe.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingActivation
data.value: Ukungenisa akukaze kuqale ngokuzenzakalela iseva. Ukusebenza kuxhomeke kumdlalo nohlelo olukhethiwe.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.PendingRecovery
data.value: Yenza isipele iseva nezwe ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amamoda amasha. Umzila okhethiwe uyochaza ukuthi yini engenziwa.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LayoutRecognized
data.value: Ukuhlelwa/umzila wokulayisha owaziwayo. Izinguqulo zemidlalo, ukuxhomeka kanye nezidingo zamakhasimende akuqinisekisiwe ngokugcwele lapha; hlola izidingo zombhali.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualCompatibility
data.value: Ukuhambisana kwedivayisi yesikhala somkhumbi ?? akuqinisekiswanga. Isandiso sefayela elihambisanayo alibonisi ukuthi le mod iyasebenza kulo mdlalo noma umthwali.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.LoaderMissing
data.value: Ukungenisa kuvinjelwe: ayikho i-loader ehambisanayo noma iphakethe alihambelani ne-loader ekhethiwe. Hlola izilungiselelo zesiphakeli nokusekelwa kwe-Mod & ukumiswa.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderCompatibility
data.value: Izitifiketi zomhlinzeki kuphela. Izinguqulo ze-Mod, ukuxhomeka kanye nokuhambisana kwepulatifomu akuqinisekisiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi into ngayinye yomhlinzeki isekela le seva.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderDestination
data.value: I-Synix igcina uhlu lwe-ID ye-{0} ehleliwe, hhayi amafayela we-mod we-ZIP. Umdlali / umhlinzeki ulawula indawo yokulanda.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileChanges
data.value: amafayela e-{0} ohlelweni; Amafayela akhona e-{1} azofakwa ohlangothini ngaphambi kokuwashintsha.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FilePreview
data.value: Khetha ifayela ngakwesobunxele ukuze uthole indawo eligcwele. Ayikho into ekopishwa kuze kuqinisekiswe ukubuyekezwa okulandelayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderActivation
data.value: Gcina izitifiketi ezihleliwe, bese uqala iseva ngokwakho futhi uhlole ilogi yayo yokulanda / yokuqalisa. I-ZIP ekhethiwe ayigcini inguqulo elayishwe ngumdlalo / umhlinzeki.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualActivation
data.value: Ukukopisha amafayela akufaki i-loader noma ukubhalisa/ukuvumela i-mod. Landela ukusekelwa kwe-Mod & ukumisa nemiyalo yesiphakeli somlobi, bese uqala iseva ngokwakho futhi uhlole ilogi yayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioActivation
data.value: Ukungenisa akuguquli umhlaba osebenzayo. Sebenzisa Ukukhetha Isimo ukuze ukhethe lesi simo bese ugcina ngaphambi kokuqala. Ukugcinwa okukhona akuguqulwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileActivation
data.value: Umthwali/uhlelo olukhethiwe lufunda amafayela angenisiwe lapho uqala iseva. Qedela ukucushwa okwengeziwe komlobi nezidingo zeklayenti kuqala, bese uhlola ilogi yokuqalisa. I-Synix ayiqali iseva.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileRecovery
data.value: Misa iseva, khetha into engenisiwe bese usebenzisa Roll Back Import. Lokhu kubuyisela amafayela afakiwe futhi kususe amafayela amasha kulolo lwazi olungenisiwe; ukuhlela kamuva kungavimbela ukubuyela emuva. Akubuyisi izinguquko zomhlaba. Yenza isipele esigcwele ngaphambi kokuqala.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderRecovery
data.value: Misa iseva bese uhlela uhlu lwe-ID ukuze ususe izengezo noma ubuyisele ukuhleleka kwalo kwangaphambilini. Lokhu akususi amafayela omhlinzeki noma kubuyisele izinguqulo ezindala ze-mod/idatha yomhlaba. Gcina uhlu lwangaphambilini lweziqu kanye nesekela eligcwele le-server ngaphambi kokuqala.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioRecovery
data.value: Isimo esisebenzayo noma ukulondolozwa okukhona kungavimbela ukususwa.

data.name: Backup.Retention.Warning
data.value: Isipele esisha silondoloziwe, kodwa ukuhlanzwa kwesipele kudinga ukunakwa kwe-{0}: {1}

data.name: Backup.Creation.Failed
data.value: Isipele asizange siphele. Hlola i-Activity & Diagnostics ngesizathu ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.

data.name: ServerStart.Maintenance.BackupFailed
data.value: Ukuqalisa kukhanselwe: isipele esiceliwe asiqediwe. Azikho izibuyekezo noma ukuqaliswa kweseva okwenziwa. Hlola iphutha lokusekelayo bese uzama futhi.

data.name: ServerStart.Maintenance.UpdateFailed
data.value: Ukuqalisa kuhoxisiwe: ukuvuselelwa okuceliwe akuphothulwanga. Isiphequluli sivinjiwe. Hlola iphutha lokuvuselela ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.

data.name: ServerActions.Operation.RequiresStopped
data.value: Misa iseva futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izinqubo zayo ziphumile ngaphambi kokuvuselela noma ukuqinisekisa amafayela ayo.

data.name: Backup.Error.CustomFolderUnavailable
data.value: Ifolda yokulondoloza ekhethiwe ayitholakali. Phinda uyixhumanise noma ukhethe enye ifolda eyisipele. I-Synix ngeke isebenzise indawo ehlukile.

data.name: Configuration.Sync.TooLarge
data.value: Ukwakheka okubuyiselwe kukhulu kakhulu ukuba kuvumelaniswe ngokuphepha. Hlola ifayela ngaphambi kokuqalisa iseva.

data.name: Backup.Progress.Synchronizing
data.value: Ukuvuselela izilungiselelo ze-Synix kusuka ekwakhiweni okubuyiselwe...

data.name: Backup.Restore.SettingsPending
data.value: Amafayela okubhekabheka abuyiselwa, kodwa i-Synix ayizange ikwazi ukuqeda ukuvuselela izilungiselelo zayo zesiphakeli. Amafayela okubuyiswa agcinwe. Lungisa inkinga bese uzama kabusha Qalisa; Ukuqalisa kuhlala kuvinjiwe kuze kube yilapho ukuvumelanisa kuphumelela. Imininingwane: {0}

data.name: Backup.Error.RestartForRecovery
data.value: Ukuvuselelwa kwangaphambilini kwaphazamiseka. Qalisa kabusha i-Synix ukuze uyibuyisele ngaphambi kokuqala noma ukubuyisela le seva.

data.name: Backup.Restore.PreviousPending
data.value: Ukuvuselelwa kwangaphambilini kusadinga ukunakwa. Lokhu kubuyiselwa akukaqali. Imininingwane: {0}

data.name: Language.PreviewNotice
data.value: Isibuyekezo sangaphambilini: ukulawula okuyinhloko kuhunyushwe. Olunye usizo nokuxilongwa kusekhona ngesiNgisi.

data.name: GameText.Introduction
data.value: I-Synix yamukela umbhalo wamazwe omhlaba. Inkambu ngayinye engezansi inezinga layo lobufakazi; ukusekela isihloko akubonisi ukusekela iphasiwedi. I-unverified ayisho ukuthi ayisekelwa futhi ayibeki umthetho wesiNgisi kuphela. Idokhumenti akuyona ukuhlolwa bukhoma kuzo zonke izinhlobo zomdlalo, ifonti yeklayenti noma indlela yokungenisa.

data.name: GameText.SafetyNote
data.value: Gcina amaphasiwedi njengoba efakiwe: izinhlamvu ezifanayo zingaba nokukhishwa okuhlukile. Imingcele yokudlala ekhona kanye nezihlukanisi ezivinjelwe zisasebenza. Amathokheni okuqinisekisa, ama-ID, amagama amafolda namagama omsebenzisi womdlali anemithetho ehlukile.

data.name: GameText.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Ukusesha okuku-inthanethi akuzange kubonise ukusekelwa kwezwe lonke kulo mkhakha. Hlola imibhalo yamanje yomdlalo futhi uhlole izinhlamvu eziqondile ngaphambi kokuncika kuzo. Inkambu ekhubazekile ku-Synix akudingeki ukuba ingabi khona emdlalweni.

data.name: GameText.InvalidUnicode
data.value: I-{0} iqukethe uhlamvu lwe-Unicode olungaphelele. Phinda ungene; I-Synix ngeke ishintshe iphasiwedi noma izinhlamvu zamagama ngokuthula.

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: I-Euro Truck Simulator 2 kufanele ithumele amamephu ayo, amafayela we-DLC namaphakheji we-mod kusuka kumdlalo ojwayelekile ngaphambi kokuba iseva ezinikezele iqale. Landela izinyathelo zokumisa ezibonisiwe; I-Synix izokungenisa amafayela akhiqizwayo kule seva.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Kukhona ama-mod wekhodi eseceleni kweseva, kuhlanganise ne-mod yokuthuthukiswa kwe-stockpile eyabiwe. Ukuhlelwa kwephakeji, ukuxhomeka kanye nokusebenza komhlaba kuxhomeke kumdlalo / inguqulo yemodi; akucatshangwa ukuthi ayikho indawo ye-DLL ejwayelekile.

data.name: Content.027ABB3BADA8C0B33854
data.value: Khetha ama-mods wokulungiswa kwezwe / iseva esikhundleni sokukopisha i-ZIP ejwayelekile. I-Steam kanye nokutholakala kwe-crosssplay/mod.io kuyahluka. Ama-plugin we-server adinga ukusetshenziswa kwesiphakeli okufanele nokwakhiwa kwe-plugin.
