data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Sebenzisa lesi siqondiso ukuze udale iseva yakho yokuqala. I-Synix iyayisebenzisa kule PC, ngakho shiya i-PC ivuliwe ngenkathi abantu bedlala. Awudingi ukubhala umyalo wokuqalisa wokusetha okuvamile okusekelwayo.
1. Vula i-Synix bese uvumela ukuhlolwa kokuncika kwe-SteamCMD kuphele. 2. Khetha Engeza Iseva, bese udala iseva entsha. Uma amafayela wesiphakeli esevele ekhona, khetha Ukungenisa Isiphakeli Esikhona esikhundleni salokho. 3. Ku-General, faka igama le-server eliyingqayizivele bese ukhetha umdlalo. Khetha inguqulo, inguqulo yomdlalo noma i-loader uma lezo zinketho zivela. 4. Gcina izindinganiso eziphakanyisiwe ngaphandle uma udinga okuthile okuhlukile. Hlola amakhasi okusetha avumelekile bese uxazulula umyalezo ofanele wokusetha okudingekayo ngezansi. 5. Khetha ukulondoloza iseva. Lokhu kwengeza okufakiwe kudeshibhodi; akusho ukuthi umdlalo usuqedile ukufakwa. 6. Khetha lokho okufakiwe bese ukhetha Ukuqala. Vumela ukulanda nokulungiselela ukuqala kuqala kuphele, ulandele noma iziphi izikhombisi eziboniswa yi-Synix. 7. Qedela noma yikuphi ukusetha okuphethwe ngumdlalo, njengesivumelwano, ukubhalisa i-akhawunti, noma ukudala iseshini kumenenja yayo yeseva yomdlalo. 8. Joyina kusuka kule PC noma enye idivayisi kunethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya. Uma lokho sekusebenza, yenza isipele ngaphambi kokungeza amodi noma wenze izinguquko ezinkulu.
Uma Uthola Isikhwama Vula Ukulungela kweseva ekhethiwe bese ufunda i-Activity & Diagnostics. Landela iphutha elithile kunokuchofoza ngokuphindaphindiwe ku- Start. I-Minecraft noma i-Satisfactory, isigaba se-Game Guides sichaza izinyathelo ezengeziwe.
Ukusingatha abantu abangaphandle kwenethiwekhi yakho kuyisinyathelo esihlukile senethiwekhi. Okokuqala qinisekisa ukuthi iseva isebenza endaweni.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Indatshana ngayinye yedeshibhodi idinga igama layo nefolda yokufaka. I-Synix iguqula igama leseva libe yi-identity ephephile ye-Windows yamafolda asekelwayo nezilungiselelo zokuqalisa. Lokhu kugcina izibonelo zihlukile ekwabelaneni ngamafayela okungahlosiwe; akuyona imishini ebonakalayo noma umngcele wokuphepha.
Izindawo Ezingagciniwe • C:\Synix ?? eyinhloko Synix indawo yokusebenza yedatha. • I-C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? i-shared game downloader. • C:\Synix\Games\<game>\<server> ?? ukufakwa kweseva okuvamile. • I- C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? impande evamile yokulondoloza. • I-C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? amarekhodi ezicelo nemibiko yezinhlekelele.
Amafayela wesicelo se-MSI avame ukuba ngaphansi kwe- %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Ezinye izintandokazi namagugu avikelwe yi-Windows nazo ziyingxenye ye-akhawunti yakho ye-Windows.
Izindawo Zamakhasimende Sebenzisa Faka & Qalisa lapho ukhetha ifolda yeseva. Ukuze ufake okusha, khetha ifolda engenalutho ebhaliwe enesikhala esanele somdlalo nezibuyekezo. Ungabheki amaphrofayli amabili encwadini efanayo.
Ifolda ye-Open Server ibonisa indawo yangempela yeseva ekhethiwe. Vula Ifolda Yokusekelayo ibonisa indawo yokusekelayo yayo; Ungacabangi noma iyiphi indlela kusukela igama layo ukubonisa.
Izinsindiso Zingaphila Kwenye Indawo Umdlalo ungagcina imihlaba ku-AppData, amadokhumenti, enye idrayivu, noma uhlelo lwawo lokusebenza. Qinisekisa indawo yokugcina yangempela yomdlalo ngaphambi kokuyisekela noma ukuyihambisa.
Ukuqamba kabusha noma ukuhambisa amafolda ku-File Explorer akuqinisekisi ukuthi yonke indlela egciniwe izovuselelwa. Sebenzisa ukuhamba komsebenzi wokungenisa / ukudlulisa okusekelwa yi-Synix nezindlela zokubuyekeza ngaphambi kokuqala okulandelayo. Izibonelo ezahlukene nazo zidinga iziteshi zenethiwekhi ezingangqubuzani.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: I-Space Engineers isebenzisa i-Dedicated Server Manager yayo esemthethweni, okuyinto i-Synix okufanele ibonakale. Lapho uvula okokuqala, khetha i-Local/Console, khetha i-Continue to server configuration, faka izilungiselelo zesiphakeli nezomhlaba bese ukhetha i-Save & start. Sebenzisa umphathi ukuze uthole izilungiselelo eziphambili, imihlaba, ama-mods, abaphathi kanye nekhonsoli yayo. I-Synix igcina lesi sibonelo ngaphansi kwefolda ye-Instance yesiphakeli. Imodi yokuqala ye-Local/Console ayidingi amalungelo omlawuli; ukudala isevisi ye-Windows. Izidingo ezisemthethweni yi-.NET Framework 4.8 noma entsha, Visual C ++ Redistributable 2013 ne-2017, okungenani i-6 GB yesistimu RAM, kanye ne-UDP port 27016 evunyelwe nge-Windows Firewall bese idluliselwa ku-router yabadlali be-Inthanethi. Umhlahlandlela osemthethweni: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
I-watchdog iqapha izinqubo zesiphakeli ezaziwayo futhi ingaqala ukubuyisa okulungiselelwe ngemuva kokuphuma okungalindelekile noma inkinga etholakele.
INDLELA EJwayelekile Yokusebenza Sebenzisa ukulawula kwe- Synix's Stop and Restart ukuze wenze izinguquko ngamabomu. I-Synix ihlanganisa lezo zenzo ne-watchdog ukuze ukuvalwa okuceliwe kungabhekwa njengengozi.
Ukuvala iwindi lomdlalo, ukuwubulala ku-Task Manager, noma ukuwumisa komunye umphathi kungase kubonakale kungalindelekile futhi kuholele ekubuyiseni.
ISIQALO ESIPHINZEKILE Vimbela iseva ngokusebenzisa i-Synix, bese uhlola amarekhodi omdlalo wakamuva. Lungisa inkinga yesikhathi sokusebenza, ukumiswa, isikhumulo, inkumbulo noma i-mod ngaphambi kokuyiqala kabusha. Ukubuyiswa akukwazi ukulungisa i-mod engavumelani noma ukufakwa komdlalo okungaqediwe.
Ukuhluleka kwenqubo nombuzo ongatholakali kuyinkinga ehlukile. Isikhathi sokululama sincike emdlalweni nasesimweni samanje, ngakho-ke ungahlolisisi ukulibaziseka ngakunye usebenzisa isikhathi esisodwa esicatshangwayo.
IMIKhawulo I-Synix ilandelela iziqhumisi ezisekelwayo nezinqubo zezingane eziya kuseva. Imishini ebonakalayo ephethwe ngaphandle noma izinsizakalo zokuthumela zingaphila isikhathi eside kunesikhulisi futhi zidinga ukulawula okungokwemidlalo.
I-watchdog ayisithathi indawo yokulondoloza okuqinisekisiwe noma ukubuka iseva esisha esishintshiwe ngesikhathi sokuqalisa kwayo okokuqala ngempumelelo.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Sebenzisa izinkinobho zomjikelezo wokuphila ze-Synix ekusebenzeni okujwayelekile kweseva. Lokhu kuvumela umqaphi ukuba ahlukanise ukuyeka ngamabomu nokushayisana.
Qala Khetha okufakiwe bese ukhetha Ukuqala kanye. I-Synix ihlola izidingo ezidingekayo, izindlela, izibuko, nokugcinwa okuhlosiwe kwangaphambi kokuqala, ilungiselela amafayela asekelwayo alahlekile, bese iqalisa iseva. Linda umphumela ngaphambi kokuba uphinde uzame.
STOP Khetha i-Stop bese uvumela isikhathi somdlalo ukuba silondoloze bese sivala. I-Synix isebenzisa i-shutdown enhle esekelwayo lapho ikhona, bese i-fallback yokuqeda inqubo ngezigaba uma kunesidingo. Ukuqedwa okuphoqelekile kungabangela ukulahlekelwa intuthuko engalondoloziwe.
QALA kabusha Khetha Qalisa kabusha ukuze umise iqembu lezinqubo lamanje bese uqala isibonelo esisha. Ungaqali enye ikhophi ngesandla ngenkathi lokhu kwenzeka.
Uma Inkinobho Ingatholakali Omunye umsebenzi ungase usuvele ungumnikazi iseva, ukungena kungahle kube sesimweni sesikhashana, noma lowo mdlalo ungasebenzisa ukuthunyelwa kwangaphandle. Funda umyalezo womsebenzi namakhono eprofayili.
Gwema ukubulala iseva ku-Task Manager noma ukuyivimbela kusuka kuthuluzi elingahlobene nokugcinwa okuvamile. Lokho kungase kubonakale njengendlela engalindelekile yokuphuma futhi kuholele ekuvuselelweni.
Imidlalo elawulwa ngemishini ebonakalayo noma izinsizakalo zokuthumela zangaphandle idinga ukuhlolwa komjikelezo wayo wokuphila. Ukuvalwa kwe-launcher akubonisi ukuthi lezi zinsizakalo ziye zaphela.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
I-Satisfactory idinga ukusetha kokuqala ku-Server Manager yayo yomdlalo. I-Synix ingafaka futhi iqalise iseva ezinikezelwe, kepha ayithathi indawo yokufuna iseva noma ukudala iseshini yayo.
Qedela Isethulo Somdlalo 1. Dala okufakiwe kwe- Satisfactory bese uqala nge- Synix. 2. Linda kuze kube yilapho iseva enikezelwe iqeda ukulayisha. 3. Vula i-Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager bese ufaka noma ukhetha iseva. 4. Yisho, usethe iphasiwedi yomlawuli bese ungena ngemvume njengomlawuli. 5. Dala noma ulayishe iseshini ofuna ukuyisebenzisa.
I-Synix ilawula amanani okuqala / wokulungiswa asekelwayo, kufaka phakathi itheku lokuqalisa ne-MaxPlayers. Amafayela afanele atholakala ngaphansi kwe-FactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
I-CONNECT SYNIX 1. Gcina iseva isebenza nge -NewConsole. Hlola okufakiwe okungenisiwe noma okudala; uma ungeza le ngxabano, qala kabusha ngokusebenzisa Synix. 2. Sebenzisa izinga elifanayo lezimvume ze-Windows ze-Synix nesiphakeli, okungcono izimvume zomsebenzisi ezivamile. 3. Khetha leyo seva bese uvula Izinketho ze-Server → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Khetha Ukuxhuma ngokuzenzakalelayo kanye bese ulinda.
I-Synix ithumela i-server.GenerateAPIToken, ifunda okukhipha okusha okuphelele, iqinisekise i-API yendawo, bese igcina ithokheni elifihliwe le-akhawunti yakho ye-Windows. I-token inikeza umqondisi ukufinyelela, hhayi nje ukuqapha.
Imibiko yempumelelo Ithokheni iqinisekisiwe futhi igcinwe ngokuphepha bese ivula Ukubuka konke. Awudingi ukukopisha umugqa we-console noma unamathisele ithokheni ngesandla.
Uma umzamo uhluleka, i-Synix igcina noma yikuphi ukuxhumeka okugcinwe ngaphambilini futhi ayiphinde izame umyalo ngokuzenzakalela. Funda umphumela oqondile ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.
Lokhu kuxhuma kuseva ekhethiwe kule PC; ayidingi umthetho omusha womzila we-Synix. Ukuqala okuvamile, ukuyeka nokuqalisa kabusha kusasebenza ngaphandle kwe-API token.

data.value:
Khetha okufakiwe kwedeshibhodi bese uvula Izinketho Zeseva. Kunamathuluzi kuphela asekelwa yilelo phrofayili nesimo sayo samanje esinikezwayo.
Amafayela Nokugcinwa Kwawo • Ifolda evulekile ye-Server ne-Open Backup Folder zivula izindawo ezisebenzayo. • Umhleli wokulungisa uvula amafayela wokulungisa umdlalo asekelwayo. • Ukuvuselela Iseva ilanda ukuvuselelwa komdlalo osekelwayo. • Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kwe-Game Files noma ukulungisa amafayela aphethwe umfakisi. • Backup and Restore gcina noma ubuyisele ukufakwa okukhethiwe. • Yenza Ifayela le-Batch lithumela ngaphandle iskripthi sokuqalisa lapho iphrofayili isixhasa. • I-Delete isusa okufakiwe futhi inikeza kuphela izinketho zokususa amafayela eziboniswe ekuqinisekisweni kwayo.
Izixhumanisi Namathuluzi Omdlalo Ulwazi lokuxhuma lubonisa amakheli, izikhumulo nezenzo zokukopisha. Ukuhlolwa kokuxhumeka, iMod & Plugin Manager, amathuluzi we-Minecraft, neSatisfactory Control Center zivela lapho kusekelwa khona.
Hlola INceku Egijimayo Chofoza kabili emgqeni ukuze uthole imininingwane yeseva. Imininingwane yenqubo ebukhoma ibonisa iziqhumisi eziqinisekisiwe, iziphathimandla zekhonsoli nezinqubo zabasebenzi eziyingxenye yalolo cwaningo. Umdlalo wezinqubo eziningi ungaba ne-ID yenqubo engaphezu kweyodwa.
Sebenzisa isilawuli semithombo ukuze uhlole i-CPU yesofthiwe kanye nomlando wememori. Lezi zifundo zihlukile ekufingqweni kwe-PC ephelele kwedeshibhodi.
Ukuvala imininingwane noma iwindi lokuqapha izinsiza akuvimbi umdlalo. Sebenzisa inkinobho ethi "Yeka" uma lokho kuwumgomo wakho.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Khetha inguqulo ye-Minecraft ngaphambi kokukhetha ama-mods noma izilungiselelo zokuxhuma. I-Java ne-Bedrock zingamaseva ahlukene; I-Bedrock akuyona i-Java loader.
Faka i-Server 1. Dala okufakiwe kwe-Minecraft bese ukhetha i-Java noma i-Bedrock. 2. Ukuze uthole i-Java, khetha inguqulo ye-Minecraft, umthwalo kanye nenguqulo yomthwalo ehambisanayo enikezwa abakhethi. 3. Hlola izwe, imodi yomdlalo womdabu, umkhawulo womdlali, inkumbulo, izikhumulo, nezindawo zokuphepha ezivunyelwe. 4. Gcina bese uqala nge-Synix. 5. Funda noma yisiphi isivumelwano noma uqale ngokushesha ngaphambi kokuba usamukele. 6. Linda kuze kube yilapho umhlaba usuqedile ukulayisha, bese ujoyina inguqulo yeklayenti ehambisanayo nenguqulo. 7. Yenza isipele ezweni lokusebenza ngaphambi kokuthi ungeze amodi.
I-Java NE-BEDROCK Izinketho Java zihlanganisa Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, futhi Purpur lapho izakhiwo zitholakala. Sebenzisa inguqulo bese ukwakha abakhethi; I-Paper ne-Purpur zisebenzisa ama-plugins, kuyilapho i-Fabric, i-Forge ne-NeoForge zisebenzisa izindlela zazo ezihambisanayo. I-Synix ilanda isikhathi sokusebenza esikhethiwe kumhlinzeki wayo osemthethweni.
I-Bedrock isebenzisa iphakethe elisemthethweni le-Bedrock le-Dedicated Server futhi ayisebenzisi i-Java.
FANelana Nezitayela Khetha i-loader edingekayo kuma-mods akho. Hlanganisa inguqulo ye-Minecraft, umthwali, ukuxhomeka, kanye nanoma yiziphi izidingo ezivela ohlangothini lomthengi.
Amaphakheji e-Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, namaphakeji we-plugin-server awafani. Ukudala ifolda ye-mod noma ama-plugins akufaki i-loader edingekayo noma uhlelo lokusebenza lwesiphakeli. I-Browse Catalog akuyona i-modpack noma ukufakwa kokuncika okuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuhlelwa Lungiselela uphatha server.properties nezilungiselelo eziqondene noshicilelo. I-Java futhi inikeza imodi ye-Spectator. Amanani nezindinganiso zobuchwepheshe zigcina ifomu Minecraft ulindele.
Kusuka ku-Server Options, vula iMinecraft Control Center. Ikhasi layo le-Settings lifaka uhlu lwefayela lokuhlela elihlelwayo leseva. Hlela Ifayela inikeza ukuhlela umbhalo; I-Structured Editor inikeza umhleli okhona owaziyo ngefomethi. Bobabili bagcina izinguquko ngenkathi iseva imisiwe. Izindinganiso ezaziwayo ze-server.properties ezinjengezikhumulo, umkhawulo womdlali, umhlaba, imbewu, imodi, nezilungiselelo zomyalo-channel nazo zivuselela ukungena okugciniwe kwe-Synix. Igama elikhangisiwe/i-MOTD lihlukile kwegama lokungena lendawo. Izilungiselelo ze-mod ezingaziwa zihlala kumafayela azo.
I-Synix ifunda kabusha lezi zilungiselelo ngaphambi kokuhlela noma ukuqala ukufakwa, futhi lapho i-Refresh isetshenziswa ngenkathi imisiwe. Uma ukuhlela kwangaphandle kungasebenzi noma kuphikisana nokunye okufakiwe, lungisa inkinga enegama esikhundleni sokuqalisa ngokuphindaphindiwe iseva. Umhleli wenqaba ukubhala kabusha ifayela eliguqulwe selokhu lavulwa; uyivule kabusha ukuze ilayishe okuqukethwe okusha.
Ukushintsha Isikhathi Sokusebenza Kwe-Server Gcina isipele esigcwele se-server ngaphambi kokushintsha izinguqulo noma ama-loader. Khetha isikhathi esisha sokusebenza ku-Setup, gcina okufakiwe okubuyekeziwe, bese ukhetha Faka isikhathi sokusebenza ku-Minecraft Control Center. I-Synix ilungiselela isikhathi sokusebenza esisemthethweni ngokwehlukana, igcina amafolda e-server.properties namafolda omhlaba, futhi irekhoda amafayela wesikhathi sokusebenza ashintshiwe. Akuqali ngokuzenzakalelayo iseva. Ukuqala kuvinjelwe ngenkathi isikhathi sokusebenza esiqoshiwe nephrofayili ekhethiwe zingavumelani.
Ukuhlehliswa kwefayela akubuyisi izinguquko zomhlaba ezenziwe ngemuva kokuqala kwesiphakeli. Ungalokothi ucabange ukuthi izwe elivulekile nge-Minecraft entsha noma ama-mods ahlukene angafakwa ngokuphepha isikhathi esidala sokusebenza; ukubuyisa isipele esiphelele esihambelanayo esikhundleni salokho.
Misa ngaphambi kokushintsha amafayela adinga ukuqala kabusha. Ungashintshi izwe elikhona ngesampula elisha njengendlela yokulungisa.
Uma abadlali bengakwazi ukujoyina Hlola inguqulo, inguqulo yomdlalo / yokulayisha, ama-mods adingekayo, kanye ne-port / protocol yangempela yenguqulo ekhethiwe. Ukuze uphume kusenesikhathi, hlola ilogi yomdlalo ukuze uthole amaphutha okuvumelana, isikhathi sokusebenza, inkumbulo noma ukuxhomeka.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Vula i-Satisfactory Control Center ngemva kokuxhuma i-API yendawo. Khetha ithebhu yokusebenza oyidingayo.
ISIHLOKO SOMBONO Khetha Ukuvuselela ukuze ufunde igama leseshini, inani / umkhawulo wabadlali abaxhunyiwe, isimo somdlalo, isilinganiso se-tick, isikhathi sokudlala kanye nezinga lobuchwepheshe.
Isidlali sedeshibhodi sibala ukuvuselelwa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngenkathi uxhumano lusesimweni esihle; ithebula lesifinyezo livuselelwa uma kuceliwe. Le API inikeza izinombolo, hhayi uhlu lwabadlali abanamagama. Iseshini ephumayo noma iseva elinde iseshini akuyona inqubo emile.
Izilungiselelo Zeseva Khetha Ukuvuselela, hlela amanani asekelwayo, bese usebenzisa izinguquko. Hlola kabusha amanani alindile ngemva kokuvuselelwa. Ezinye izinketho zidinga ukuqala kabusha; ukufaka izinguquko akuqali kabusha umdlalo ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ukusetha izinkinobho kanye namanani avunyelwe kuhlala kusetshenziswa ulimi lobuchwepheshe lomdlalo.
Imidlalo Eyasindiswa • Gcina manje: Faka igama noma usebenzise igama eliphelelwe yisikhathi le- Synix. Ukuphinda usebenzise igama kungase kuhoxise ukulondolozwa okukhona. • Umthwalo okhethiwe: Hlola ukuqinisekiswa. I-Synix igcina inqubekela phambili yamanje kuqala lapho iseshini isebenza; ukulayisha kungaphazamisa abadlali. • Layisha ukulondoloza: Yengeza ifayela elikhethiwe futhi ingase ithathe indawo yokulondoloza enegama elifanayo. Ayithwali ngokuzenzakalelayo. • Ukukopisha okukhethiwe: Kugcina ikhophi kuleyo ndlela oyikhethayo.
Gcina isipele esizimele ngaphambi kokufaka noma ukulayisha umhlaba obalulekile. Ukudluliselwa kokonga kunomkhawulo wokuphepha we-512 MB. I-API ingase ingatholakali okwesikhashana ngenkathi iseshini ilayisha.
IKONSOLA EYINGENISEKILE Thumela umyalo owodwa womdlalo osekelwayo ngesikhathi bese ufunda isiqinisekiso. Izikripthi, imiyalo ye-token / iphasiwedi nezinguquko zokufinyelela ezingaphephile zivinjelwe lapha.
Imiyalo yokumisa esekelwayo iqondiswa nge-stop workflow ye-Synix. Ukuphuma komyalo kuhlala kuleli windi kunokufakwa kudeshibhodi noma kuma-logs wombhalo we-Synix; umdlalo usengabhala ama-logs awo.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705
data.value: Umthuthukisi uqopha amafolda angaphansi kwe-plugin ye-Java edition server plugins. Izinhlelo zamanje nezesikhathi esidlule zisebenzisa ama-API ahlukene; ukuqinisekisa inguqulo efakiwe kanye nefomethi ye-plugin ngaphambi kokusebenzisa indawo oya kuyo.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
Amafayela OMdlalo Wokuxhumana Angase Adingeke:
I-Synix ifaka iphakethe le-dedicated-server kodwa ayikwazi ukulanda, ukukopisha noma ukusakaza kabusha amafayela anelayisense kusuka kumdlalo ojwayelekile. Uma iseva ibika ukulahleka kokuqukethwe kwe-multiplayer noma ukuphazamiseka ngenkathi kulayishwa noma kushintshwa amamephu, faka i-Dark Messiah of Might & Magic Multiplayer nge-Steam usebenzisa i-akhawunti enayo. Kopisha okuqukethwe kwe-mpsrc yomdlali ovela kulokho kufakwa komdlalo kule folda yesiphakeli esinikezelwe, futhi uqiniseke ukuthi i-mapcycle.txt ne-maplist.txt iqukethe amamephu ofuna ukuwasebenzisa.
Lesi sinyathelo kufanele sigcwaliswe umsebenzisi ofaka iseva. Amanani ohlobo lomdlalo yi-0 Deathmatch, i-1 Team Deathmatch, i-2 Crusade, i-3 Capture the Flag, ne-4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B58E9F9AC7FE77A9E6C
data.value: Kudinga ukwakhiwa okuhambisanayo kwe-Metamod:Source ne-SourceMod yale nguqulo yeseva. Ama-plugins .smx aqoshiwe ahamba ku- tf/addons/sourcemod/plugins; izinguqulo ezihambisana nazo, idatha yemidlalo nezandiso zigcina amafolda abo abhalwe phansi.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Funda umphumela we- Connect ngokuzenzakalela ngaphambi kokuzama futhi. Umyalo obonakalayo ekhonsoli yomdlalo awufakazeli ukuthi ukubamba amathokheni, ukuqinisekisa nokugcina konke kuphumelele.
Hlola Ukwehluleka Okuqondile • Ikhonsoli ayitholakali: Qinisekisa i--NewConsole, iseva ekhethiwe, kanye nezinga lemvume elihambisana ne-Windows. • Umyalo ongaqediwe ku-input: Zisuse ngokwakho. I-Synix ngeke ibhale phansi. • Umyalo uyagijima kodwa awutholakali uphawu: Vumela ukuqala kuqedwe, hlola amarekhodi omdlalo abhaliwe, futhi uvumele okukhipha okusha okuphelele kufike. • Ukuphazamiseka kwezihlungi: Khipha izihlungi ezifakiwe/ezifakiwe bese uvumela ikhonsoli iphendule. • I-API port ingeyenye inqubo: Lungisa i-port yomdlalo ekhethiwe yesiphakeli esikhethiwe. Ungathumeli isibonakaliso salo kumlaleli ongahlobene naye. • I-token elahliwe noma ukuxhumeka okugciniwe ayikwazi ukuvulwa: Qedela ukusetha okuyingxenye yomdlalo, bese uphinda uxhumeke. • I-API ayitholakali: Linda ukuqala noma ugcine ukulayisha bese uhlola ilogi yomdlalo.
Impendulo entsha ingaqukatha inani elifanayo le-token njengempendulo yangaphambili. Ukubamba kusebenzisa okukhiphayo okwenziwe ngemva komyalo, hhayi ithokheni elidala elizenzakalelayo embhalweni.
Vikela Noma Uvimbele Ukufinyelela I-Satisfactory iphrinta amathokheni omlawuli kwikhonsoli yayo namalogi. Zigcine ziyimfihlo futhi ususe imigqa yethokheni kusuka kuzithombe zesikrini nemibiko.
I-Synix iqinisekisa ukuthi iphuzu lokuphela lasendaweni lingelaseva ekhethiwe bese ibopha isitifiketi sayo. Ungakhubazi ukuhlolwa kwesitifiketi ukuze ulungise ukwehluleka.
Susa amathokheni agciniwe asuse uxhumano olugcinwe lwe-Synix; akusihoxisi isigqebhezana kuseva.
Ukuze ususe amathokheni wesicelo akhona, sebenzisa i-server.InvalidateAPITokens kwikhonsoli yeseva ye-Satisfactory noma ikhonsoli ye-Server Manager. Lokhu kuthinta nezinye izinhlanganisela ezisebenzisa lawo makhophi.
Ukuze uthole enye i-akhawunti ye-Windows noma ukufakwa okudlulisiwe, phinda uxhumane uma uxhumano olugcinwe oluvikelwe lungasetshenziswa.

data.value:
Funda amarekhodi amasha omsebenzi nomdlalo wesiphakeli esikhethiwe. Funa ukwehluleka kokuqala okungokoqobo kunomyalezo wokugcina wokuvala.
UKUQALA NANGESIKHATHI NANGESIKHATHI 1. Qinisekisa ifolda yokufaka ekhethiwe, i-executable, inguqulo yomdlalo nomthwali. 2. Hlola amafayela adingekayo, isikhala samahhala se-RAM / disk, kanye namachweba athathwe. 3. Qedela noma yisiphi isivumelwano, ukubhalisa ku-akhawunti, imfuneko ye-token, noma ukusetha iseshini yomdlalo. 4. Ukuze uthole ama-mods, qhathanisa umdlalo, umthwali, ukuxhomeka kanye nezidingo zamakhasimende. 5. Qala ukuhlola i-Synix ngaphambi kokushintsha amafayela, bese uhlola kuqala.
I-launcher ebukhoma ingahlala ngemva kokwehluleka kweseva yangempela. Iseva enempilo ingalinda nokulayishwa kwezwe noma ibe nombuzo ongatholakali / API. Hlola la mazwe ngokwehlukana.
Ukuyeka Noma Ukuqala Kabusha Kuthatha Isikhathi Imidlalo idinga isikhathi sokonga nokuvala izinqubo zabasebenzi. Linda umphumela we-Synix bese ufunda umyalezo wayo wokuvala. Ukubuyela emuva okuphoqelekile kungalahlekelwa intuthuko engalondekile.
Musa ukubulala izinqubo ngasikhathi sinye, uqale enye ikhophi, noma usebenzise omunye umphathi ngokuqondene nokufakwa okufanayo.
Ithuluzi Noma Isethulo Silahlekile Hlola amakhono wephrofayela nesimo sayo samanje. Ezinye izinketho zivimbelekile ngoba umdlalo unazo noma awukho umzila wokuphatha osekelwayo. I-N/A idatha yomdlali akuyona ngokuzenzakalelayo ukwehluleka kweseva.
Uma le nkinga iqhubeka, bhala phansi isenzo, iphutha eliqondile, kanye nesiqeshana esifushane se-log esilungisiwe ngaphambi kokwenza ezinye izinguquko ezingahlobene.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
Faka noma uvuselele i-MODPACK ye-Server 1. Yenza isipele se-server ephelele bese uyimisa. Sebenzisa i-Synix ngemvume evamile ye-Windows. 2. Setha futhi usebenzise inguqulo ye-Minecraft eqondile yephakeji, ukulayisha nokwakhiwa kwe-loader kuqala. 3. Ku- Minecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, khetha i-Import Server Pack. Khetha i-Modrinth .mrpack noma i-ZIP yeseva ephelele equkethe ama-mods / ama-plugins wangempela namafayela wokulungisa. 4. Izimo zokusebenza zesiphakeli ezingavunyelwe ziyakhishwa ngaphandle kokuthi kuhlanganiswe izimo zokusebenza zesiphakeli ezingavunyelwe. Ukufakwa kwe-Modrinth kumakhasimende kuphela nokugqugquzelwa kwamakhasimende akungeniswa. 5. Hlola umphumela wokuskena, ukuhlolwa kwemethadatha, okuqukethwe okungekho, kanye nawo wonke amafayela okufanele afakwe, afakwe esikhundleni noma asuswe. Qinisekisa kuphela uma umthombo nezinguquko kufanelekile. 6. Qalisa ngesandla ngemva kokufakwa, funda ikhonsoli, bese uhlola ukuxhumeka kweklayenti elihambisanayo.
Umhlinzeki womthengisi akaqedi imibhalo yokuqalisa enikezwe iphakheji, esikhundleni sezwe, noma abhale kabusha i-root server.properties. Landa iphakethe eliphelele le-server lomlobi uma ukuthekelisa iklayenti le-CurseForge liqukethe kuphela imenyu yokulanda. Ukulandwa kwangasese, ama-host angasekelwa, noma abalayishi abangasekelwa badinga amafayela wesiphakeli asekelwa umbhali; I-Synix ayihambisani nemingcele yomhlinzeki.
Ukulandwa kwe-Modrinth kuhlolwe nge-hash. I-metadata ye-JAR esekelwayo iyahlolwa ukuthola i-loader, okuqukethwe kwamaklayenti kuphela, ama-ID aphindwe kabili, nokuxhomeka okubhalisiwe ngaphandle kokuqalisa i-JAR. I-metadata engaziwa kanye nezinga lezinguqulo eziyinkimbinkimbi zidinga ukubuyekezwa. Ukuhlolwa okuhlanzekile noma ukungabikho kokuphikisana okutholwe akuqinisekisi ukuthi i-mod iphephile noma iyahambisana. Ukuxhomeka okulahlekile akulayishwanga buthule.
Ukungenisa kabusha iphakethe elifanayo elinegama kungasusa ama-JAR alo aphethwe ngaphambilini angasekho, kodwa kuphela uma lawo mafayela esahambisana nama-hash awo aqoshiwe. Ama-JAR angalawulwa namafayela omhlaba awakhishwa. Amafayela wokulungiswa anikezwe iphakethe elisha angakwazi ukufaka esikhundleni samafayela amadala; ukubuka kuqala kuzobonisa ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa. Gcina igama elifanayo lefayela le-server-ZIP lapho uvuselela lelo phakheji ukuze laziwe njengephakheji elifanayo.
UMTHETHO WOMHLABA Sebenzisa imihlaba ukuze ubhale phansi imihlaba eyaziwayo. Ukungenisa World ZIP amakhophi eyodwa ehambisanayo-edition emhlabeni ifolda entsha enegama; ayibhali phansi umhlaba okhona noma iguqule phakathi kwe-Java ne-Bedrock. Khetha izwe elifakiwe bese usebenza umhlaba ukuze ushintshe igama lezinga kanye nesilungiselelo somhlaba se-Synix ndawonye. Isiqalo esilandelayo silayisha izwe elikhethiwe. Ukushintsha imbewu kuthinta ukukhiqizwa kwezwe elisha, hhayi indawo ekhona.
ISIFUNDO Ukubuyisela kuhlu izinguquko zefayela ezenziwe yile ndawo yokusebenza. I-Undo ibuyisela amafayela aqoshiwe angaphambilini noma isuse amafayela angeniswe yilolo shintsho. Shiya izwe elithengiswayo ngaphambi kokuqeda ukungenisa kwalo. Uma amafayela ahlelwe kamuva, i-Synix yenqaba ukuwabhala ngaphezulu; gcina ukuhlela futhi usebenzise isipele esiphelele esifanele uma kunesidingo.
Ukubuyisa okulindelwe kuvimbela Qala kuze kube yilapho ukubuyisa kuqediwe futhi okufakiwe okulondoloziwe kuvumelana namafayela abuyiselwe. Izinhlelo ezindala ngaphandle kwephrofayili eqoshiwe yesikhathi sokusebenza zidinga isipele esigcwele sokubuyisela isikhathi sokusebenza. Izipele zihlala ziyi-backup ephelele yefolda yesiphakeli, ezimele amarekhodi wokuguqulwa ngabanye.
Ngemva kokubuyiselwa okuphumelelayo kwe-backup ephelele, amarekhodi amadala okushintsha indawo yokusebenzela aphawulwa ngokuthi athathelwe indawo leyo backup. Zihlala zibonakala ukuze zikhonjiswe kodwa azikwazi ukuhoxiswa kumafayela abuyiselweyo. Ukungenisa noma ukuhlela okuqukethwe ngemva kokubuyisela kudala amarekhodi amasha okubuyisela.
I-DIAGNOSTICS NEZITHOMBE I-diagnostics ifunda izingcaphuno zakamuva zokubhalisa kanye nokubika ukuphazamiseka kwezinkinga ezivamile ze-Java, inkumbulo, ukuxhomekeka, isikhumulo, umhlaba nezinkinga ze-tick-time. Ayikho iphethini etholakele akubufakazi bokuthi iseva iphilile. Ukusebenza kuvula ukuqapha kwemithombo; Izilinganiso ze-CPU ne-RAM azifaki esikhundleni sokubekwa kwephrofayili ye-tick game.
I-Schedules ivula izilungiselelo ezikhona zokuqala kabusha nokugcinwa kwe-Synix. Khetha izinsuku ezifiselekayo, isikhathi, ukuziphatha kokulinda komdlali, izinketho zokusekelayo nezokuvuselela, bese uhlola futhi ugcine. Isikhala somsebenzi asenzi uhlelo lwesibili noma sishintshe uhlelo lwakho ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Khetha iseva ye-Minecraft, bese uvula Izinketho Zeseva → Minecraft Control Center. Amakhasi we-Console ne-Players agcina amathuluzi omyalo nawomdlali ndawonye. Amanye amakhasi anikeza izilungiselelo, imihlaba, izengezo, ukubhekabheka okuphelele kweseva, ukuhlelwa kabusha kokuqala kabusha, ukutakula nokuxilongwa.
Iziteshi ZOMTHETHO Izilungiselelo ezisekelwayo zingasebenzisa ikhonsoli elawulwa yi-Synix, isiteshi sokuphathwa kwe-localhost esisekelwayo, noma i-RCON engakhethwa. Isiteshi esitholakalayo sincike ekushicilelweni nasekumisweni kwesiphakeli.
Iwindi lokuzalwa elifihliwe lingashiya isiteshi somyalo sendawo esisekelwayo sikhona. Uma izilawuli zikhubazekile, hlola ukuthi iseva iyaqhubeka nokuthi izilungiselelo zayo zokuphatha zisebenza yini.
Izenzo Ezilungiselelwe Lapho kusekelwa khona, i-Synix inikeza izaziso, uhlu lwabadlali, ukulinganisela, ukushintshwa komsebenzisi nohlu lwemvume, ukulawula isikhathi / isimo sezulu nokonga.
Khetha umdlali ohlosiwe bese ufunda isenzo ngaphambi kokuqinisekisa. Ukunikeza opharetha ukufinyelela kunikeza izimvume zomdlalo ezinamandla. Ungayinikeli nje ukuze uxazulule inkinga yokuxhuma.
IMIKHONDO ENGAKHULU Sebenzisa inkulumo-mpikiswano eyayilindeleke kuleyo nguqulo. Imiyalo efana nohlu nokugcina konke kungukungena komdlalo futhi ayihumushiwe nge-interface ye-Synix. Hlola imithetho yomyalo womdlalo ngaphambi kokuthumela umyalo oshintsha imihlaba noma izimvume.
IZINHLOKO NAMagama Umbuzo unganikeza inani labadlali ngaphandle kohlu olubhaliwe olunegama. Ithebula lamagama elingenalutho ngokwalo alibonisi ukuthi akekho oxhumene.
Sebenzisa isenzo sokumisa noma sokuqalisa kabusha kwedeshibhodi ukuze wenze izinguquko emjikelezweni wokuphila ukuze umqaphi azi ukuthi ukuvala kuhloswe.
Gcina i-RCON noma ukuphela kokuphatha okukhethwa kukho kusendaweni ngaphandle kokuthi unecebo lokuphathwa okukude elivikelekile. Umdlalo womphakathi awudingi ukudalula lezo ziphakamiso noma amaphuzu okugcina.

Leli layisense lisebenza kwisofthiwe ye-Synix Control Panel, kufaka phakathi ikhodi yayo yomthombo, ama-binary ahlanganisiwe, isikhombimsebenzisi somsebenzisi, imibhalo, imisebenzi yobuciko, amalogo, nezinye izinto ezifakiwe (ngokuhlangene, i- ??Software ??).
Izigaba 13 futhi 14 zichaza nemikhuba yobumfihlo yewebhusayithi esemthethweni ye-Synix, ikhawuntara yomsebenzi, kanye nomphathi okude ongakhetha. zichaza inkonzo yamanje; azishintshi ilayisense lomuntu siqu, elingeyona eyezentengiselwano elingezansi.
1. Umnikazi
Isofthiwe inelayisense, ayithengiswa.
UJason Turner ugcina wonke amalungelo, izihloko kanye nezithakazelo ku-Software nakuyo, kufaka phakathi wonke amalungelo obunikazi namanye amalungelo empahla yengqondo. Awekho amalungelo obunikazi adluliselwa kuwe ngaphansi kwalesi sivumelwano.
2. Ukunikezwa Kwelayisense Elinganiselwe
Ngokuhambisana nayo yonke imigomo yaleli layisense, unikezwa ilayisense elinganiselwe, elingagciniwe, elingadluliseki, elingekho ngaphansi kwelayisense, nelingasuswa:
- Landa futhi usebenzise Isofthiwe ngezinjongo zakho siqu, ezingezona ezentengiselwano. - Bona futhi utadishe ikhodi yomthombo. - Yenza amakhophi asekelayo ukuze uwasebenzise. - Shintsha ikhodi yomthombo ukuze uyisebenzise wena. - Hlela futhi usebenzise izinguquko zakho siqu kumadivayisi onawo noma owazilawulayo.
Noma yimaphi amalungelo angavunyelwe ngokuqondile yileli layisensi agcinelwe umnikazi we-copyright.
3. Izinguquko Zomuntu Siqu
Ungashintsha Isofthiwe ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo zakho siqu.
Izinguquko zomuntu siqu kumelwe zihlale ziyimfihlo ngaphandle kokuthi uJason Turner akunikeze imvume ebhaliwe yokuqala yokuzisakaza.
Awukwazi ukushicilela, ukulayisha, ukwabelana, ukukhulula, ukusabalalisa noma ukwenza ikhodi yomthombo eguqulwe noma ama-binaries aguqulwe acatshangelwe atholakale emphakathini njengenguqulo ehlukile ye-Synix.
4. Imikhawulo
Awukwazi, ngaphandle kwemvume ebhaliwe kaJason Turner:
4.1 Ukusetshenziswa Kwezentengiselwano
- Ukuthengisa, ukuqasha, ukuqasha, ilayisense, ilayisensi engezansi, noma ukukhokhisa isofthiwe. - Thengisa noma usakaze ama-binary ahlanganisiwe aguquliwe noma angaguquki. - Sebenzisa Isofthiwe noma ikhodi yayo yomthombo njengengxenye yomkhiqizo noma insizakalo ekhokhelwayo. - Inzuzo eqondile noma engaqondile yokusabalalisa, ukunikeza amalayisense, ukuhweba kabusha noma ukunikeza ukufinyelela ku-Software.
4.2 Ukusabalalisa kabusha nokusingathwa komphakathi
- Layisha, ubonise noma ubambe iSoftware kwenye iwebhusayithi, indawo yokugcina izinto, isevisi yokulanda, ipulatifomu yokwabelana ngamafayela noma isitolo sezinhlelo zokusebenza. - Phinda usakaze ikhodi yomthombo noma amabinari ahlanganisiwe, noma ngabe alungisiwe noma alungisiwe. - Yakha noma ushicilele izixhumanisi ezingekho emthethweni zokufaka, amaphakheji aphathekayo, izibuko, noma zokulanda. - Shicilela amakhophi asuselwa ku- fork noma ekhophi elishintshiwe leSoftware. - Yethula i-fork, ukuguqulwa, noma inguqulo ye-derivative njengomkhiqizo ozimele noma oncintisanayo.
I-4.3 Ukuvuselelwa kwegama nokufakwa kabusha
- Susa, ufihle noma ushintshe igama le-Synix, izaziso zamalungelo obunikazi, izikweletu zomlobi, izaziso zamalayisense, amalogo, noma ukubhaliswa. - Hlela kabusha noma ushintshe igama leSoftware ukuze ikhishwe noma isatshalaliswe emphakathini. - Thola ukuthi wena wadala isofthiwe yokuqala. - Sebenzisa igama noma umkhiqizo we-Synix ngendlela engamanga ebonisa ukugunyazwa, ukwamukelwa, ukubambisana, noma isimo esisemthethweni.
4.4 Reverse Engineering and Protection Bypass
Ngokwezinga eliphakeme elivunyelwe umthetho osebenzayo, awukwazi ukubuyisa injiniyela, ukuhlukanisa, ukudiliza, noma ngenye indlela ukuzama ukugwema izaziso zamalayisense, ukufakwa, izici zokuphepha, ukuhlolwa kokuvuselelwa, noma ukufaka uphawu okuqukethwe kwikhasi elihlanganisiwe elisemthethweni.
Lokhu kunqunywa akuvimbeli noma yiliphi ilungelo elingaphunyuki elinikwe umthetho osebenzayo ngokucacile.
5. I-GitHub Ama-forks neminikelo
Isitoreji esisemthethweni se-Synix singabonakala esidlangalaleni ku-GitHub. Ipulatifomu ye-GitHub ingavumela abasebenzisi ukuthi babuke futhi baxhumane ne-repository yomphakathi ngokusebenzisa ukusebenza okufakiwe kwe-GitHub.
I-GitHub fork ayikuniki imvume:
- Shicilela ukukhululwa okungekho emthethweni kwe-Synix. - Hambisa ama-binary ashintshiwe noma angashintshiwe. - I-Rebrand Synix. - Sebenzisa ikhasi elihlukile lomphakathi lokulanda noma isibuko. - Yethula i-fork njengesofthiwe yakho. - Ukusabalalisa kabusha Isofthiwe ngaphandle kokusebenza okulinganiselwe okunikezwa yi-GitHub.
Ama-forks we-GitHub angasetshenziswa kuphela ukubuyekeza ikhodi, ukulungiselela umnikelo, noma ukuthumela isicelo sokudonsa ku-repository esemthethweni ye-Synix. Izinguquko zomuntu siqu ezingathunyelwa njengomnikelo kufanele zihlale zikhona futhi ziyimfihlo.
Ngokuthumela ikhodi yomthombo, imibhalo, imisebenzi yezobuciko, noma omunye umnikelo ku-repository esemthethweni ye-Synix, ubonisa ukuthi unelungelo lokuwuthumela futhi unikeze uJason Turner ilayisense elingapheli, lomhlaba wonke, elingekho ngaphandle, elingenakuhoxiswa, elingenayo imali yokusebenzisa, ukukhiqiza, ukuguqula, ukushicilela, ukusabalalisa, ilayisense elincane, nokufaka lowo mnikelo ku-Synix.
6. Synix Igama nomkhiqizo
Igama le-Synix, ilogo, ubunikazi obubonakalayo, nemikhiqizo ehlobene nayo ihlala iyimpahla kaJason Turner.
Ayikho uphawu lokuhweba noma ilayisensi yokubeka uphawu olunikezwa yileli layisense ngaphandle kokubonisa igama ne-branding ye-Synix engashintshiwe ngenkathi usebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza.
Ukusetshenziswa okungagunyaziwe komkhiqizo we-Synix kungaphikisana namalungelo obunikazi, uphawu lokuhweba, ukuncintisana okungenabulungisa, noma eminye imithetho.
7. Ukuqedwa
Amalungelo akho ngaphansi kwaleli layisense aphela ngokuzenzakalelayo uma wephula noma yimuphi umusho wale layisense.
Ngemva kokuqedwa, kufanele:
- Yeka ukusebenzisa noma ukuguqula isofthiwe. - Yekani ukusabalalisa noma ukubonisa noma iyiphi ikhophi engagunyaziwe. - Susa amakhophi, ukukhishwa, izibuko, noma okulandwayo okungagunyaziwe ngaphansi kokulawula kwakho. - Susa amakhophi akho uma kudingeka ngokomthetho.
Izigaba eziphathelene nobunikazi, imikhawulo, iminikelo, ukuhoxiswa kwemithwalo yemfanelo kanye nokuphoqelelwa kusinda lapho kuqedwa.
8. Ukuphoqelelwa
Umnikazi we-copyright angafuna noma yiziphi izindlela zokulungisa ezikhona ngaphansi komthetho osebenzayo zokukopisha okungagunyaziwe, ukusatshalaliswa, ukubamba esidlangalaleni, ukuthengiswa, ukuhweba kabusha noma okunye ukwephulwa.
Izindlela zokulungisa ezikhona zingase zihlanganise izicelo zokususa, izinqubo zokuqedwa kwepulatifomu, ukuncishiswa kokuvinjelwa, ukulimala nezinye izindlela zokulungisa lapho kufaneleka ngokomthetho.
Akukho lutho kuleli layisensi oluqinisekisa ukuthi noma yisiphi isenzo esithile sokuphoqelelwa noma isinxephezelo sizotholakala kuzo zonke izifundazwe.

Isofthiwe yomuntu wesithathu, imitapo yolwazi, amafayela amaseva womdlalo, izingxenye ze-SteamCMD, izimpawu zokuhweba nezinye izinto ziphethwe ngabanikazi bazo futhi zihlala zingaphansi kwamalayisense nemibandela yazo.

Imibuzo noma izicelo zemvume kufanele zithunyelwe ngokusebenzisa i-Synix GitHub yokugcina esemthethweni noma enye indlela esemthethweni yokuxhumana ne-Synix.
12. Imithombo Esemthethweni Yokulanda
Thola i-Synix kuphela ngale mithombo esemthethweni:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Amakhophi anikezwa amanye amawebhusayithi awaqinisekiswa nguJason Turner futhi angase angavikelekile, aguqulwe, aphelelwe yisikhathi, noma ahlanganiswe nesofthiwe engadingeki. Ukuphepha kwabo nobuqiniso babo akuqinisekiswa uJason Turner.
Ukufakwa kuhlu kwe-Synix, ukuxhumanisa ne-GitHub, noma ukunikela ngokulanda akusho ukudlulisa ubunikazi noma ukusho ukugunyazwa, ukuhambisana, ukwesekwa, noma isimo esisemthethweni. I-Synix ihlala iyimpahla kaJason Turner.
Ukusingatha, ukubukisa izibuko, ukufaka esikhundleni, ukupakisha kabusha noma ukupakisha okulandwayo kudinga imvume ebhaliwe kusengaphambili. Isixhumanisi somthombo osemthethweni asisinikezi lelo lungelo.
Isigaba se-4.2 asivimbeli ukuxhumana okujwayelekile okuqondile nale mithombo esemthethweni echaza ngokunembile i-Synix noJason Turner. Izixhumanisi ezinjalo aziwenzi iwebhusayithi yokuxhumanisa ibe umthombo osemthethweni.
Iphakethe le-WinGet ubidzz.Synix liyindlela yokufaka evunyiwe lapho ilanda umfakisicelo ongashintshiwe ngqo kusuka kumagazini osemthethweni we-GitHub. Lokhu akuvumeli ukusingathwa komuntu wesithathu noma ukuhlanganiswa kabusha.
13. I-Live Activity Counter and Privacy
I-Synix ifaka i-counter yokusebenza ebukhoma engakhethwayo elinganisa inani lezikhathi ze-Synix ezisebenza ku-https://synix.info. Lesi sici sinikwe amandla ngokuzenzakalelayo. Ungayivala nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ku- Izilungiselelo > Ubumfihlo Nokuphepha > Yabelana ngenani elisebenzayo ngaphandle kokunciphisa ezinye izici ze- Synix. Inketho eyalondolozwa ngaphambili iyahlonishwa.
Ngenkathi inikwe amandla, i-Synix ithumela isignali yobukhona be-HTTPS ku-https://synix.info/api/presence lapho iqala futhi cishe njalo ngemizuzu ye-10 ngenkathi uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenza, kufaka phakathi ngemuva. Isibonakaliso siqukethe ikhodi yeseshini yesikhashana engahleliwe kanye ne-generic Synix application identifier, ngaphandle komzimba womyalezo. Ikhodi yeseshini igcinwa kuphela enkumbulweni futhi iyashintshwa lapho kuqala iseshini entsha yokubika; akuyona i-ID yendawo eqhubekayo.
I-counter ayilayishi igama lakho, ikheli le-imeyili, amaphasiwedi, ulwazi lwesiphakeli noma lomdlali, amanani wokulungisa, amafayela, noma izikhombisi zomshini.
Isikhathi ngasinye, i-counter yewebhusayithi igcina kuphela i-hash yekhodi yeseshini nesikhathi sesiginali yakamuva. Iwebhusayithi yomphakathi ibonisa kuphela isibalo esiphelele sezikhathi ezisebenzayo, okuyisilinganiso kunokuba kube isibalo sabantu abahlukile. Iseshini iyeka ukubala ngemva kwemizuzu ye-15 ngaphandle kwesignali. Amadokhumenti we-counter angasebenzi ayafaneleka ukuhlanzwa ngemuva kwemizuzu ye-30 futhi ayasuswa lapho kwenziwa izicelo ezilandelanayo zokuhlanza. I-Synix ayixhumanisi la marekhodi okuphikisana nama-akhawunti okuphatha kude noma izimpawu zekhompyutha ezihlanganisiwe.
Ukucisha lesi sici kuvimbela ezinye izimpawu zokubakhona futhi kwenza isicelo esisodwa sokuzama ukususa iseshini yamanje. Ukuvala i-Synix nakho kuzama ukususa; uma ukususwa kungakwazi ukufinyelela kuwebhusayithi, iseshini iyeka ukubala ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemuva kwesikhathi sokungasebenzi.
Njenganoma yikuphi ukuxhumeka kwe-inthanethi, izinsizakalo zokubamba iwebhusayithi zithola imininingwane ejwayelekile yokuxhuma, njengekheli elivela ku-IP nesikhathi sokucela, futhi zingacubungula noma zibhalise ngaphansi kwezinqubomgomo zazo zobumfihlo. Lolu lwazi alugcinwanga etafuleni le-Synix lokulinganisa imisebenzi noma liboniswe ekubalweni komphakathi.
14. Ukufinyelela Okude Ubumfihlo Nokuphepha
I-14.1 Ukufinyelela Okuzithandela Nokungathengiswa Kwedatha
Ukuphathwa okukude ku-https://manager.synix.info kungokuzithandela futhi kuvinjelwe kuze kube yilapho uhlanganisa ikhompyutha futhi uvuma i-akhawunti eceliwe kuhlelo lokusebenza lwe-Synix kulokho kukhompyutha. Ungasebenzisa i-Synix endaweni yakho ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti yomphathi. I-counter yomsebenzi womphakathi ihlukile futhi ingasuswa ngokuzimela.
I-Synix ayithengisi, ayiqashi, ayihwebi noma idalule imininingwane ye-akhawunti yakho, imininingwane yamakhompyutha ahambisanayo, imisebenzi ekude, noma imininingwane yeseva kubakhangisi noma kubathengisi bedatha. I-Synix ayisebenzisi lolu lwazi ekukhangiseni okuhlosiwe noma ekwakheni amaphrofayli okukhangisa kuwo. Ulwazi lucutshungulwa ukuze lunikeze izici ozikhethayo, luqinisekise ukufinyelela, lusebenzise isevisi futhi luyivikele ekuhlukunyezweni.
Ukufinyelela okukude akuyona inkonzo yokugcina engenalutho. Idinga amarekhodi e-akhawunti alinganiselwe, okuhlanganisa, okusebenza nokuphepha achazwe ngezansi. Lezi zincwadi azishicilelwa ku-counter yomsebenzi womphakathi noma zivezwe kwamanye ama-akhawunti omphathi ngenkonzo.
14.2 Okuhlala Kwekhompyutha Yakho
I-Synix ayilayishi ngokuzenzakalelayo imihlaba yomdlalo, amafayela womdlali womdlalo, okuqukethwe kwefayela lokulungisa, okuqukethwe kwe-backup-archive, okukhiphayo kwekhonsoli eluhlaza, noma amaphasiwedi agciniwe womdlali womdlalo. Ukusekela kude nokubuyisela ukusebenza kukhompyutha ehlanganisiwe; amafayela okubhekabheka ahlala ezindaweni ezilungiselelwe lapho. Uma ukhetha ukuthayipha umyalo we-game console kuwebhusayithi, umbhalo wawo uyacutshungulwa futhi uthunyelwe kukhompyutha ehlanganisiwe, kuhlanganise nanoma yiziphi izindinganiso ezibucayi ozifake kulowo mbhalo. Umphathi akuyona isitoreji sokulondoloza ifu futhi ayinikezi ideskithophu ekude engenamkhawulo, ukufinyelela komyalo we-Windows, noma ukuphequlula amafayela jikelele.
I-Synix igcina izilungiselelo zayo zasendaweni, uhlu lwamaseva, umlando, ukubhekabheka, kanye nesimo sokubhangqa kukhompyutha yakho. Ukhiye wokusayina wangasese wekhompyutha ehlanganisiwe uhlala endaweni yokugcina ukhiye ye-Windows. I-Synix ithanda isitoreji esixhaswe yi-TPM uma sikhona futhi ngenye indlela isekela ukhiye wesoftware ovikelwe yi-Windows, kuhlanganise nama-VM ahambisanayo. Ukutholakala kwe-TPM akuqinisekisi ukuthi ikhompyutha ayinasici.
Lezi zitatimende zichaza ukuphathwa okukude kwe-Synix. Imidlalo, i-Steam, ama-mods, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Discord, ukuthekelisa, nemibiko yokusekela oyikhethayo ukwabelana nayo inezinhlelo zayo zokugeleza kwedatha. Ungafaki amaphasiwedi noma olunye ulwazi olubucayi kumagama wekhompyutha, amagama amaseva, noma amagama amafayela okubuyisela emuva, ngoba lawo mathebula angavela kumphathi.
I-14.3 Ukwaziswa kweMenenja Izinqubo Nezitolo
- I-akhawunti nokuqinisekiswa: Igama lomsebenzisi olikhethile, isazisi se-akhawunti, isikhathi sokudala, izintandokazi zokuphepha, i-hash yephasiwedi enosawoti, imfihlo yokuqinisekisa e-encrypted lapho inikwe amandla, izitifiketi zomphakathi ze-passkey lapho zinikwe amandla, kanye namarekhodi wokuqinisekisa okwesikhashana / weseshini. Amaphasiwedi namakhodi okuqinisekisa ayacutshungulwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukungena ngemvume; amaphasiwedi angunaphakade awagcinwa njengombhalo ofundekayo. I-Synix ayitholi iminwe yakho, isithombe sobuso, ukhiye wangasese wephasiwedi, noma ukhiye wangasese wokusayina wekhompyutha ehlanganisiwe. Ukubhalisa akuceli igama langempela noma ikheli le-imeyili. - Ukuhlanganiswa nokuxhumeka: I-tag yekhompyutha oyikhethile, i-identifier yedivayisi engahleliwe, ukhiye wayo wokusayina womphakathi, ukuhlanganiswa kwe-akhawunti, uhlobo lomhlinzeki wokhiye olubikiwe, isimo sokwamukelwa kokuhlanganiswa, nesikhathi sokuxhuma kokugcina. Isixhumanisi sokulandelela esiqinisekisiwe esithule singahlala sivulekile ngenkathi i-Synix isebenza ukuze iwebhusayithi ikwazi ukuvusa uhlelo lokusebenza oluhlanganisiwe ngokushesha. I-relay iqukethe izaziso zokuphaphama / zokuxhuma kanye nemethadatha yokuxhuma, hhayi amafayela womdlalo noma izithombe zesiphakeli. - Isimo esibonisiwe: Izikhombisi zesiphakeli ezilinganiselwe, amagama, amagama omdlalo, isimo sokusebenza, inani labadlali, isikhathi sokuphumula, izenzo ezitholakalayo, isikhathi sokulondoloza / isimo sakamuva, ukufundwa okuhlanganisiwe kwe-CPU ne-RAM kusuka ekusebenzeni kwezinqubo zesiphakeli somdlalo (kufaka phakathi iziqalo zabo nezisebenzi ezilandelwayo), kanye ne-CPU ekhethekile yekhompyutha yonke, i-RAM esetshenzisiwe / ephelele, nezinga lokuthumela / lokwamukela inethiwekhi. Izinga lenethiwekhi yekhompyutha lifaka ithrafikhi ye-LAN kuma-adaptha wesango asebenzayo; izikhombisi ze-adapter, amakheli e-IP, okuqukethwe kwamaphakeji, nezindawo zokuzulazula azithunyelwe ngalezi zifundo. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luthumela lezi zihlanganisi ngenkathi umbono womlawuli oqinisekisiwe usebenza. Izibuyekezo ze-CPU/RAM zihlanganisa amakhompyutha ahambisanayo; izibuyekezo zesiphakeli ezinemininingwane zihlanganisa ikhompyutha ekhethiwe. Izibuyekezo zivame ukuqhutshwa njalo ngemizuzwana ye-10 bese ziphazamiseka ngemuva kokuthi ukubukwa okusebenzayo kuvalwe, kuvinjelwe, kuphelelwe yisikhathi noma kufihlwe njengoba kufanele. Ezinye izikhathi zokusesha zesiphequluli ezisebenzayo zingagcina ukubukwa kwazo kusebenza. - Izinyathelo nezipele eziceliwe: Izikhombisi zesiphakeli / zesenzo, isikhathi sesicelo, inqubekela phambili / umphumela, futhi, lapho ucela izinketho zokusekelayo, izikhombisi zokusekelayo, amagama amafayela, izinsuku, usayizi namathegi obuqotho. Okuqukethwe kwe-backup kanye nezindlela eziphelele zendawo azithunyelwa kulolu phawu. - Imiyalo yekhonsoli yomdlalo: Isithonjana somdlalo esingabonakali, ukuvulwa kokuvalwa isikhathi esifushane, kanye nombhalo womyalo owuthumelayo. Umbhalo olindelekile ubhaliswa ku-database yesevisi futhi ususwe kulolo rekhodi lapho kuvunyelwa ukulethwa. Akufakiwe ohlwini lwezenzo zakamuva noma amarekhodi ezixwayiso ze-akhawunti. Umphumela wokulethwa usho ukuthi umbhalo uthunyelwe emdlalweni, hhayi ukuthi umdlalo uyamukela noma uyigcwalisile. Izimpendulo zomdlalo nesihlahla senqubo yendawo azilayishwanga. - Ukuphepha nokuvimbela ukuhlukunyezwa: Uhlobo lokungena ngemvume olungaphumelelanga, inani kanye nezikhathi zokuzama ukuqoqwa, uhlobo lomcimbi wokubuyisela / wokuphepha, kanye namathegi akhompyutha afanele. Imibhalo yesikhathi esifushane yomkhawulo wesilinganiso ingasebenzisa ama-hashes afakwe ukhiye wamakheli wokuxhuma we-IP nezikhombo ze-akhawunti. Amarekhodi okuxwayisa nge-akhawunti ye-Synix awaqukethe amaphasiwedi, amakhodi wokuqinisekisa, amakheli we-IP aluhlaza, noma iminwe yesiphequluli. Abahlinzeki bokusingatha bangacubungula imininingwane yokuxhuma ngokwehlukana njengoba kuchaziwe esigabeni se-14.6.
Iwebhusayithi ngokuyisisekelo icubungula izifinyezo nemiyalo evunyelwe ukunikeza ukuphathwa okukude. I-HTTPS nokuxhumeka kwe-relay okufihliwe kuvikela umgwaqo ohambayo; Lokhu akusona isimangalo sokuthi isevisi yokubamba ayikwazi ukucubungula idatha.
14.4 Ukugcinwa nokususwa
- Izitifiketi nezilungiselelo ze-akhawunti zihlala zikhona kuze kube yilapho i-akhawunti isuswa. Amarekhodi okuhlanganisa avunyelwe ahlala kuze kube yilapho ikhompyutha ingahlanganiswa noma i-akhawunti isusiwe. - Izithombe zesikhashana zesimo kanye nokufundwa kweCPU/RAM ziyabhaliswa ngokufundwa okusha futhi zifaneleka ukuhlanzwa ngemuva kwemizuzu ye15 ngaphandle kokuyifaka esikhundleni. Isikhathi sokuxhuma kokugcina sihlala siyingxenye yerekhodi lokuhlanganisa. - Amarekhodi omyalo okude, imiphumela, kanye nemethadatha ebuyisiwe yokukhetha isipele iyafaneleka ukuhlanzwa ngemuva kwamahora we-24. - Imiyalo ye-game console elindile iphela ngemva kwemizuzwana ye-30. umbhalo ongazange ulethe uyakufanelekela ukususwa uma uphelelwa yisikhathi noma uhoxiswa; ukulethwa okuvunyelwe kuyakuvumela ngokushesha. Ukuvunywa kwe-console kuphelelwa yisikhathi kungakapheli imizuzu emithathu. I-ID yesenzo nomphumela wokulethwa okuzinzile ulandela isikhathi sokurekhoda isenzo se-24 ihora. - Izenzakalo zokubuyisela / zokuphepha nezixwayiso zokungena ngemvume ezingaphumelelanga ziyafaneleka ukuhlanzwa ngemuva kwezinsuku ze-90. Ukubhalisa okungaphumelelanga kugcina okungenani amaqembu wakamuva we-100; Ukwehluleka okuhambisanayo esikhathini semizuzu ye-10 kuhlanganiswa ndawonye. - Izikhathi zesiphequluli ziphela ngemva kwemizuzu ye-30 ngaphandle kwezicelo zomphathi noma ngemva kwamahora we-8 jikelele. Imizamo yokuqinisekisa iphelelwa yisikhathi ngemuva kwemizuzu ye-5; Ukubuyiselwa kwephasiwedi yesikhashana kuphelelwa yisikhathi kungakapheli imizuzu ye-10 futhi kuyasetshenziswa kuphela. Amarekhodi okuqinisekiswa aphelelwe yisikhathi, ukubuyiselwa, ukuvikelwa kokuphindaphinda kanye nemikhawulo yezinga ayasuswa ngesikhathi sokuhlanzwa. Ukubhaliswa kwe-akhawunti okungaphelele kuba okufanelekile ukuhlanzwa ngemuva kwamahora we-24.
Ukuphelelwa yisikhathi kuvimbela imvume ngisho nangaphambi kokuba irekhodi lisuswe ngokomzimba. Ukuhlanzwa kwedatha okujwayelekile kuqhutshwa phakathi nezicelo zesevisi ezilandelayo, okungenani kanye njalo ngemizuzu ye-10 yokuhlanza umphathi, ngakho-ke izinkathi ezingenhla yizinkathi zokuphelelwa yisikhathi noma zokufaneleka kokuhlanza kunokuba zithembise ukususwa ngesikhathi esiqondile. Ama-logs omhlinzeki namakhophi okubhuka anezinqubo zokuphila ezihlukene.
Ukunqamula ukuhlanganiswa kususa ukuhlanganiswa okukhethiwe kanye namarekhodi akude ahlobene nakho ku-database yesevisi esebenzayo. Umlando wokubuyiselwa kwemali / wokulondolozwa kwemali ungahlala ku-akhawunti yesikhathi esingenhla. Ukususa i-akhawunti yomphathi kususa izitifiketi zayo, ukuhlanganiswa, izithombe zesikhashana, imiyalo, namarekhodi okuphepha/okuthola kabusha kwe-akhawunti ku-database yesevisi esebenzayo. Ayisusi amaseva womdlalo wasendaweni, imihlaba, izilungiselelo, noma amafayela okubuyisela emuva. Amarekhodi okuvimbela ukuhlukunyezwa okuhlala isikhathi esifushane kanye nemibhalo egcinwe umhlinzeki noma izipele azisusiwe ngokushesha nganoma yisiphi isenzo.
I-14.5 Ukulawula Nokuvikelwa Kokungena Kwakho
Ukungena ngemvume kudinga iphasiwedi yakho kanye nephasiwedi noma i-authenticator ekhona, njenge-Google Authenticator. Ama-akhawunti ahlelwe ukuba adinge zombili izindlela agcina zombili izidingo. Ukushintsha iphasiwedi, ukuhlukanisa ikhompyutha kuwebhusayithi nokususa i-akhawunti yomphathi kudinga ukuqinisekiswa okusha kwalolo shintsho oluthile.
Ukuvula okufakiwe komdlalo we-console ngokwezifiso kudinga iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yamanje nokuqinisekiswa okusha ngaphansi kwezidingo zendlela ekhona ye-akhawunti. Ukuvunywa kuhlotshaniswa neseshini eyodwa yesiphequluli, ikhompyutha ehlanganisiwe, iseva egciniwe nomdlalo obukhoma ophela kuze kube imizuzu emithathu. Ukumisa, ukuqala kabusha, ukuvala ikhonsoli, ukusetha ikhonsoli noma inqubo elahlekile kuvimbela imiyalo eyengeziwe. Ukuxhuma noma ukufihla ithebhu yomqondisi kuphetha ukuvunywa kwalethhebhu. Izinkinobho ezivamile zokusebenza kweseva zigcina izidingo zazo zokungena ngemvume ezikhona. Izixhumanisi zokufaka ezisekelwayo kuphela ezifanelekile; isazisi esiyingqayizivele sodwa asivumeli ukubhala ku-Windows command prompt.
Ikhompyutha ehlanganisiwe evunyelwe ngaphambili ingakhipha iphasiwedi yesikhashana uma ukhohlwa iphasiwedi yakho yewebhusayithi. Ayikwazi ukukhetha enye i-akhawunti. Iphasiwedi yesikhashana ayidluli noma isuse izidingo zakho ezikhona zephasiwedi / zokuqinisekisa, futhi kufanele ukhethe iphasiwedi entsha ngaphambi kokungena kumphathi. Ukuvuselelwa okuphelele kuhoxisa ezinye izikhathi zakho zesiphequluli.
Umphathi we-Synix ugcina ithokheni yakhe yokungena ngemvume yesiphequluli kwimemori yethebhu yamanje, hhayi kumakhukhi, isitoreji sendawo, noma isitoreji seseshini. Ukuvuselela noma ukuvala ithebhu kulahlekelwa ukungena ngemvume. Lokhu akuvimbeli isiphequluli sakho noma umphathi wamaphasiwedi ukuthi agcine izitifiketi uma ukhetha, futhi akuchazi amakhukhi abekwe ngokwehlukana ngabahlinzeki bokusingatha / bezokuphepha noma insizakalo yokuhumusha yewebhusayithi yomphakathi.
Ungasayina, ukhansele zonke izikhathi zesiphequluli, noma uhlukanise ikhompyutha. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwasendaweni lwe-Synix lungakwazi ukukhubaza nokuhlukanisa uxhumano lwalo olukude ngaphandle kokungena kuwebhusayithi. Lapho ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi, ivimbela ukufinyelela okukude endaweni futhi iphinde izame ukususa iwebhusayithi lapho kunokuxhumeka. Ukuqala kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza noma i-Windows akubuyiseli ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuhlanganiswa okususiwe ngokucacile. Ukusetshenziswa kwasendaweni kuphela kusekhona.
I-14.6 Ukubamba, Amakhasi Omphakathi Nemingcele Yezokuphepha
Iwebhusayithi esemthethweni isebenzisa i-OpenAI's Sites hosting kanye nezinsizakalo ze-Cloudflare zokulethwa, isitoreji, ukuphepha, nokuxhumana. Abahlinzeki laba bacubungula ulwazi oludingekayo ukuhlinzeka ngalezo zinsizakalo futhi bangathola amakheli e-IP, bacele izihloko, izikhathi kanye neminye imethadatha yokuxhuma, noma bagcine amarekhodi abo okusebenza namakhophi wokulondoloza. Izinqubomgomo zabo zobumfihlo zisebenza ekusetshenzisweni kwazo: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ futhi https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Ukuhumusha okuzenzakalelayo kwamakhasi omphakathi nokulanda kwe-GitHub kubandakanya abahlinzeki babo. Umphathi wangasese uhlukaniswe namakhasi omphakathi futhi akalayishi umhlinzeki wokuhumusha womphakathi noma imibhalo yokukhangisa. I-Synix ayenzi isimangalo esibanzi sokuthi ukuvakashela noma iyiphi iwebhusayithi akubangeli amakhukhi, amarekhodi, noma idatha egcinwe. Ulwazi lungadalulwa futhi uma kudingeka ngokomthetho; ukuzibophezela okungenhla kokungathengiswa akuvimbeli ukusingathwa okudingekayo noma ukudalulwa okusemthethweni.
I-Synix isebenzisa ukuhlanganiswa okuqinisekisiwe, izicelo zekhompyutha ezisayinwe, ukuxhumeka kwenethiwekhi okufihliwe, ukuhlolwa kokufinyelela kwe-akhawunti, nokuvunywa okunesikhathi esifushane ukunciphisa ukufinyelela okungagunyaziwe. Lezi ziqinisekiso azenzi ukufinyelela okukude kungabi nengozi noma kuqinisekise ukuvikelwa kunoma yikuphi ukuhlaselwa, ikhompyutha / isiphequluli esiphazamisekile, izindlela zokuqinisekisa ezebiwe, noma isevisi ephazamisekile. Gcina i-Synix ne-Windows zibuyekeziwe, uvikele i-akhawunti yakho nezindlela zokuqinisekisa, futhi wamukele kuphela amakhompyutha nama-akhawunti owalawulayo.
Lesi saziso sivulelekile ku-https://synix.info/license/ futhi sifakwe kusikhungo sosizo kanye nomfaki wesicelo. Imibuzo yobumfihlo ingaphakanyiswa ngezinketho zokusekela ezisemthethweni ku-https://synix.info/support/. Ungathumeli amaphasiwedi, amakhodi okubuyisela noma eminye imininingwane ye-akhawunti yangasese kumilayezo yokusekela yomphakathi. Ukubuyekezwa kwalesi saziso kunesikhathi esisha nesibuyekezo.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Vula Izilungiselelo → Bika Inkinga ukuze ulungiselele umbiko, noma usebenzise izindawo zokusekela ezisemthethweni ngezansi.
Yenza Inkinga Iphinde Ivele Faka indlela yokufaka, izinguqulo ze-Synix ne-Windows ozisebenzisayo, umdlalo / iphrofayili kanye nemininingwane efanele yokushicilelwa / yokulayisha.
Chaza: • Yini oyichofozile noma oyishintshile. • Lokho obekulindele nalokho okwenzeka. • Iphutha eliqondile nesiqeshana esifushane sombhalo osekuyisikhathi. • Ukuthi isethulo sasisebenza yini ngaphambili nokuthi yini eyashintsha.
Ukubuyekezwa Ngaphambi Kokuhlanganyela Susa amaphasiwedi, amathokheni, ama-URL we-webhook, izindlela zomuntu siqu, nolwazi lwenethiwekhi ongafuni ukuba lube lwendawo. Imodi Yobumfihlo ayihlanzi wonke amafayela ahlanganisiwe. Ungafaki amarekhodi aphelele noma ukwakheka komdlalo ngaphandle kokuwabuyekeza.
Uma ufuna ukuhumusha, faka ulimi olukhethiwe, igama lefasitela nombhalo ocacile. Uma kunenkinga yokuchazwa komdlalo, faka ukwakheka kokufakwa okuhleliwe kanye nedokhumenti yomdlalo efanele.
IZIKHATHI ZOKUFUNDA Imibiko yokukhishwa: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Umphakathi Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Indawo yokugcina impahla yomsebenzi: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Ukufaka noma ukwakha uhlelo lokusebenza oluphumelelayo akukwazi ukuhlola yonke imidlalo, imodi, kanye nemvelo yenethiwekhi. Izinyathelo ezicacile zokukhiqiza zisiza ukuhlukanisa inkinga ye-Synix nenkinga yomdlalo noma yokusetha umphathi.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Chofoza umugqa wesiphakeli ngaphambi kokusebenzisa izilawuli ezisezansi. Umugqa okhethiwe unquma ukuthi iyiphi iseva isenzo esithintayo.
Thola Iseva Sebenzisa ibhokisi lokusesha ukuhlunga ngegama lomdlalo noma le-server. Isihlungi sesimo sinciphisa uhlu ngokwengeziwe. Uma into ibonakala ingekho, susa kokubili izihlungi ngaphambi kokuthi ucabange ukuthi isusiwe.
Funda INCAZELO • Ama-Server afakiwe alinganisa ukufakwa kweseva okubhalisiwe. • I-Running Now ibonisa okufakiwe okwamanje okubikiwe njengokuqhutshwa. • Ukusetshenziswa kwe-CPU nokusetshenziswa kwe-RAM kuchaza yonke i-PC, hhayi i-Synix kuphela. • Idatha yomdlali itholakala kuphela uma umdlalo okhethiwe uveza umthombo osekelwayo.
Ukuhlolwa Kwansuku Zonke • Qalisa, Misa futhi Uqale kabusha ukuphatha iseva ekhethiwe. • Ukucushwa kuvula izinkambu zayo zokusetha. • Ukulungela kuhlolisisa izinkinga ezingase zivimbele ukuba isebenze. • I-Server Options iqukethe amafayela, ukugcinwa, ukuxhumeka namathuluzi agxile kumdlalo. • Chofoza kabili emgqeni ukuze uhlole leyo seva ngokuningiliziwe.
I-Activity & Diagnostics ibonisa inqubekela phambili nezixwayiso ezifanele. Funda umyalezo wakamuva ngaphambi kokuba uphinde wenze okuthile. I-CLEAR ihlanza indawo ebonakalayo yomsebenzi; akuwona umyalo wokususa wonke amafayela omlando.
Inqubo eqhubekayo akudingeki ilungele abadlali. Ukufakwa, ukulayishwa komhlaba wonke, izivumelwano, nokulungiswa okuyizinhlelo zemidlalo kungaqhubeka ngemuva kokuthi kuvele inqubo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukulungele embhalweni womdlalo futhi ujoyine.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Vula Izinketho Zeseva → Mod & Plugin Manager yephrofayili esekelwayo. I-Synix ithola okuqukethwe okufakiwe kanye nezindawo ezisekelwayo; akuyona ikhathalogi equkethe zonke izinguquko.
Faka Iphakheji Lendawo 1. Yenza isipele somhlaba, izengezo ezikhona, nokulungiswa okuphazamisekile. 2. Misa iseva ngokusebenzisa i-Synix bese ulinda iqembu layo lenqubo ukuba liphume. 3. Hlola uhlelo lokwengeza olutholakalayo, indawo yokufaka kanye nohlu lokuhlola ukuphepha. 4. Khetha ukufaka kusuka kufayela noma ukungenisa iphakeji ukuze uthole ifayela elisekelwayo, i-ZIP, noma ifolda ye-mod ephelele. Izinketho ezitholakalayo zincike ohlelweni lokwengeza lomdlalo. 5. Hlola lapho uya khona, imiphumela yesikena, izexwayiso nokuqinisekiswa. 6. Vumela ukuhlelwa, ukusekelwa, nokufakwa kuphele. 7. I-Synix ivuselela uhlu lapho ukufakwa kuqediwe. Qalisa kabusha uma kudingeka, bese uhlola ilogi yomdlalo nokuxhumeka kwamaklayenti.
Uhlu lubonisa indawo yokufaka ekhethiwe. Sebenzisa i-Search ukuze uthole isengezo ngegama, uhlobo, umthombo, noma indlela. Ukuvuselela kuskena futhi kugcine into ekhethiwe lapho isekhona. Umbono olula ufihla imininingwane ethile yezobuchwepheshe ngaphandle kokugwema ukuhlolwa.
Gcina iwindi livulekile ngenkathi kuskena noma kuguqulwa. I-Synix ikhubaza izenzo eziphikisanayo ize iphele. Uma isenzo sihluleka, funda iphutha laso bese uvuselela uhlu ngaphambi kokuzama futhi.
Izinhlobo Zokusebenza Izinqubo zokusebenza ezisekelwayo zihlanganisa amaphakheji we-Minecraft JAR, ama-plugin we-Rust Oxide / uMod, amaphakheji endawo we-7 Days to Die, izimo ze-Empyrion nezimo zesiphakeli, i-ID ye-ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop, ne-ID yomhlinzeki we-ARK: Survival Ascended. Amanye amasistimu atholakala kuphela noma adinga uhlaka lwawo kuqala.
Ukuze uthole ukuhlonza umhlinzeki, i-Synix ilawula ukwakheka okusekelwayo ngenkathi umdlalo / umhlinzeki enikeza okuqukethwe. Okuqukethwe okungakalandwa okwamanje akukwazi ukuskena kusengaphambili endaweni.
Lokho Amasheke Angakwenza Futhi Angakwazi Ukukwenza Ukungenisa ukuhlola ukuhlelwa kwephakheji nezindawo ezibhekiswe kuzo futhi kunqabe izindlela ezingaphephile, izixhumanisi, okuqukethwe okungavunyelwe ukusebenza, amaphakheji amakhulu kakhulu, izindawo eziphindwe kabili, nokuhlolwa kwe-malware okuqinisekisiwe.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-Defender okungatholakali noma okungaqondakali kuyisixwayiso, hhayi ubufakazi be-malware. Ukuhlolwa okuhlanzekile nokuqoshwa kwe-hash nakho akufakazeli ukuthi iphakethe lomuntu wesithathu lithembekile. Amamoda asebenza ngemvume ye-Windows yesiphakeli.
IKATALOG, UKUSUSUSUKA, NENKONZO I-Browse Catalog ivula iwebhusayithi yomhlinzeki. Akuxazululi ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuxhomeka noma ukufaka i-modpack ephelele.
Vimbela iseva ngaphambi kokungenisa kabusha. Lokhu kubuyisela emuva konke okuthengiswayo okukhethiwe, okungase kuqukethe izengezo eziningana. Ibuyisela imibhalo yokuqala egciniwe futhi isuse amafayela angeniswe yileso sithelo. Ukubuyisela emuva amazwe amasha kuqala lapho ehlanganyela amafayela; I-Synix yenqaba ukubhala phansi amafayela ashintshiwe ngaphandle kokungenisa kwawo okuqoshiwe noma ukusebenzisa ama-originals agciniwe ahluleka ukuhlola ubuqotho bawo obuqoshiwe. Amarekhodi amadala wokungenisa angase angahlanganisi ama-hashes ama-originals agcinwe.
I-ID elawulwa umhlinzeki, i-Remove Selected isusa leyo ID ekwakhiweni kwe-Synix okusekelwayo; akuyona ukubuyiswa kwephakheji lendawo. I-Synix iqopha izinguquko ezenziwa yiyo, hhayi ukuhlela konke ngesandla. Gcina izipele ezizimele zesiphakeli esigcwele: ukususa i-mod kungenza umhlaba ungalayishwa noma ususe okuqukethwe okungokuka-mod.
Ithebula elingenalutho lisho ukuthi azikho izengezo ezisekelwayo ezihambisana nendawo ekhethiwe yokufaka nokusesha. Sula Ukucinga bese uhlola iphrofayela, ifolda nohlaka ngaphambi kokucabanga ukuthi wonke amafayela ku-disk ayeshiwo.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Vula i-Add Server → Game Support Catalog ukuze uhlole ukuthi yini iSynix eyaziyo ngomdlalo ngaphambi kokudala okufakiwe. Ikhathalogi isebenzisa izincazelo ezifakwe kuhlelo lwakho lokusebenza olufakiwe.
1. Funa igama lomdlalo. 2. Sebenzisa ukucushwa, idatha yomdlali, ukudlala okuhambisanayo, ukuhambisana, noma izihlungi zokuqinisekisa ukuze unciphise uhlu. 3. Khetha umdlalo bese uvula imininingwane yawo, noma chofoza kabili emgqeni wawo. 4. Funda isethingi esisekelwayo, uhlelo lwe-server, imfuneko eyisisekelo nolwazi lokuqinisekisa.
Khipha izihlungi uma umdlalo ungekho ngokungalindelekile. Izinketho ze-Minecraft ze-Java ne-Bedrock ziyingxenye yokuhamba komsebenzi wokusetha esikhundleni sezinhlelo ezimbili eziguquguqukayo ze-mod.
Funda Amakhono Akho Ngokucophelela Iphrofayili inganikeza ukwakheka okuphathwayo, ukumiswa okuqondisiwe, izilungiselelo zokuqalisa, noma ukusekelwa okulinganiselwe / okusisekelo. I-Executable noma i-Steam AppID efakwe kuhlu ichaza ukuthi ukufakwa kusebenza kanjani; akuqinisekisi zonke izinguqulo zemidlalo.
Isidingo se-SteamCMD esiqinisekisiwe sisho ukuthi iphrofayili icela ukufinyelela ku-akhawunti. Umnikazi womdlalo nemithetho yomshicileli ingase ibeke izimfuneko ezengeziwe.
IMIPHUMO YENKULUNKULU AKUYONA Uhlu Lwezinhlobo Zomlilo Inani eligcinwe le-query-port alibonisi ukuthi umlaleli wombuzo ukhona noma ukuthi kufanele avezwe. Sebenzisa imfuneko yangempela yokwakheka komdlalo nemigomo yesivumelwano.
Ikhathalogi iyindawo yokuhlola izincazelo ezifakiwe. Amarekhodi okuqinisekisa endawo abonisa lokho okuye kwabonwa kule PC, hhayi imiphumela yendawo yonke kumshini ngamunye noma inhlanganisela yemodeli.

data.name: Content.4142CE901681A4929208

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Vula isithonjana se-gear kudeshibhodi ukuze uthole izilungiselelo zesicelo. Sebenzisa inkinobho ye- Configure yesiphakeli ukuze usethe izilungiselelo eziqondene nesiphakeli kuphela.
IJENERAL • Bonisa izilawuli ze-Server Console Window ukuthi amaseva asekelwayo abonisa yini i-console yawo yangempela. Iwindi elifihliwe alisho ukuthi iseva imisiwe. • Imodi emnyama ishintsha isihloko sesicelo. • I-SteamCMD Download Speed ikhetha isivinini esigcwele noma umkhawulo wokulanda osekelwayo. • Izinguquko zolimi zisekela amalebula esixhumanisi, izingxoxo nemiyalezo yesimo.
Amanye amakhasi aqukethe izindawo zokusekelayo nokudluliswa, izinketho zobumfihlo/zokuphepha, ukubika izinkinga, nezilungiselelo eziphambili/zemuva. Awudingi ukuvumela izinketho eziphambili ukuze udale iseva evamile.
INDLELA Yokuziphatha Ngolimi Khetha phakathi kwezilimi ezinikezwayo esikhetheni. Izilawuli ze-Synix, izihloko zosizo nemiyalezo eyenziwe uhlelo lokusebenza zisebenzisa ulimi olukhethiwe. Imiyalo yomdlalo, amanani wokwakheka, nokukhipha kweseva yokuqala akuhunyushwanga. Amafayela omlando wezobuchwepheshe agcina amagama awo okuxilonga okuqala.
Umbhalo obhekene nomdlalo awuhunyushwanga: imiyalo, izinkinobho zokwakheka namagugu, amagama amamephu, izindlela, amagama amafayela, izingxabano zokuqalisa, izikhombisi, kanye nombhalo wokukhipha kufanele uhlale ngendlela umdlalo olindele ngayo.
Ukushintsha ulimi lwe-interface akuguquli i-command syntax yomdlalo noma ukuhumusha okukhiphayo kwekhonsoli. Uma ilebula elijwayelekile le-Synix lingahunyushwanga ngendlela engalindelekile, yazisa indlela elibhalwe ngayo, iwindi kanye nolimi olukhethiwe.

data.name: Content.47162741BDEBFE950EB7

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Vula Izilungiselelo → Ubumfihlo Nokuphepha ngaphambi kokwabelana ngesikrini noma ukubuyekeza izinketho zokuphepha.
Indlela Yobumfihlo Izifihla-buso ze-Privacy Mode zisekela ukubonisa okubucayi, njengamakheli nezikhombo. Akuguquli i-IP yakho yomphakathi, ukubethela ithrafikhi yenethiwekhi, noma ukuhlanza wonke ama-log womdlalo namafayela wokulungisa.
Hlola isithombe-skrini ngaphambi kokuhlanganyela naso. Isenzo sokukopisha enkampanini efihliwe singakopisha inani langempela.
Amaphasiwedi Namathokheni Asindisiwe I-Synix ivikela amaphasiwedi, amathokheni, namagugu e-webhook agcinwe asekelwayo womsebenzisi wamanje we-Windows. Umdlalo ungase usadinga izitifiketi ezifundekayo ekwakhiweni kwawo noma ekuqaliseni.
Ikhophi yefolda elula kwenye i-akhawunti ye-Windows ayiqinisekisi ukuthi lawo malungelo avikelwe angavulwa. Sebenzisa ukugeleza kokusebenza kokudlulisa okufihliwe ukuze usebenzise ukufuduka kwamakhredithi okusekelwayo.
I-WINDOW'S Permissions Qhuba i-Synix namaseva emidlalo ajwayelekile ngemvume ejwayelekile ye-Windows. Ukushintshwa kwesistimu ethile noma i-launcher yomdlalo kungacela ukuphakama ngokwehlukana; akusona isizathu sokuphatha konke unomphela njengomqondisi.
Izinkinga zokuhlanzwa kwe-firewall ezingahleliwe zisekela imithetho endala ephethwe yi-Synix. Hlola imithetho ehlongozwayo ngaphambi kokuvuma ukususwa. Aliphathi wonke amafolda wangokwezifiso noma avumele ukususwa kwemithetho ye-firewall engahlobene.
Uma imfihlo idalulwa, yibuyisele noma uyihoxise enkampanini ekhiphe le mfihlo. Ukufihla inkambu noma ukususa ikhophi eligcinwe le-Synix akusho ukuthi leli lungiselelo alivumelekile kwenye indawo.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Ukuvala iwindi lomntwana, ukunciphisa i-Synix, nokushiya uhlelo lokusebenza ngokucacile yizenzo ezahlukene. Hlola ukuziphatha kwakho nokuphuma kwakho.
Ukuvula kabusha iphaneli yokulawula I-Synix ingakwazi ukubona izinqubo zesiphakeli ezisekelwayo ezisasebenza futhi ibuyisele ubunikazi bazo. Vumela ukuhlolwa kwenqubo yokuqala kuqedwe ngaphambi kokuqala esinye isenzakalo.
Ukuqashelwa kwenqubo kufanele kuhambisane nesikhungo esikhethiwe, hhayi nje igama elijwayele. Ama-wrappers angokwezifiso noma amasevisi aphethwe ngaphandle angase adinge ukunakwa okwengeziwe.
ISIZINYATHELO SESITHOMBE Izilungiselelo zokuqalisa/izilungiselelo ze-background-agent ezidingekayo zisekela ukuqapha ekubhaliseni kwe-Windows. Akudingeki ukuba zenze iseva yakho yokuqala.
Umsebenzi ohleliwe udinga inqubo efanele ye-Synix noma i-agent, iseshini ye-Windows etholakalayo kanye ne-PC evukile. Ukuqalisa ukungena ngemvume akusona isithembiso sokuthi umsebenzi uzosebenza uma umshini uvaliwe.
NGAPHAMBI kokuqala kabusha amafasitela Qedela ukulondoloza, ukulanda nokudlulisa. Misa imidlalo ngokusebenzisa Synix ukuze bakwazi ukulondoloza ngokujwayelekile, bese uphuma noma uqale kabusha Windows.
Ungacabangi ukuthi ikhonsoli yemidlalo efihliwe ime noma ukuthi ukuvala iwindi lokuqapha kuvimbela umdlalo wayo. Hlola ideshibhodi bese usebenzisa ukulawula okuqondile komjikelezo wokuphila.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Vula umphumela wokulungela we-server ekhethiwe ukuze ubone imfuneko engekho. Isikhathi sokusebenza esifakiwe ku-Synix asithinti izidingo ezihlukile zomdlalo.
Imiyalezo Elahlekile Ye-DLL Amaphutha okukhuluma nge-MSVCP140.dll noma i-VCRUNTIME140.dll ngokuvamile abonisa isidingo sesikhathi sokusebenza se-Visual C ++. Sebenzisa imiyalo yomdlalo kanye nokufaniswa okusekelwa yi-Microsoft ukusatshalaliswa kabusha.
Ulwazi olusakazwa kabusha lwe-Microsoft: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Musa ukulanda amafayela we-DLL ahlukile kumawebhusayithi angahleliwe noma ubeke ama-DLL ahlobene nawo eceleni kweseva esebenzayo.
Ezinye Izidingo Umdlalo ungadinga i-akhawunti, ilungelo lesiphakeli, isikhathi esithile sokusebenza seJava, isici seWindows, noma i-hardware esekelwayo. Qedela lezi zidingo ngaphambi kokushintsha iziteshi ezingahlobene noma ukusetha kabusha ukumiswa.
I-Minecraft Java, sebenzisa inhlanganisela ye-version / loader esekelwayo evela kuma-selectors we-Synix. I-Bedrock ayisebenzisi i-Java.
Ukuze usebenzise okudingayo i-Hyper-V noma ukufakelwa kwe-hardware, hlola ukuhlolwa kokulungela komdlalo. Ungavumeli izici zesistimu noma usebenzise wonke amaseva njengomlawuli ukuze nje ugweme isixwayiso.
Ngemva kokulungisa lesi sidingo, yenza isiqalo esisodwa futhi ubuyekeze iphutha lokuqala eliwusizo lomdlalo uma liphumelela.

data.name: Content.5C88F49381905FBD8C70
data.value:
KUDINGEKILE ukuhlolwa okubucayi:
1. I-Synix ivula umphathi weseva ozinikezele we-Space Engineers osemthethweni futhi ihlale ibonakala.
2. Khetha 'Local/Console', khetha 'Continue to server configuration', faka izilungiselelo zeseva nezomhlaba, bese ukhetha 'Save & start'.
3. Sebenzisa umphathi ukuze uthole izilungiselelo eziphambili, imihlaba, ama-mods, abaphathi kanye nekhonsoli ebukhoma. Idatha yesiphakeli igcinwa ngaphakathi kwale folda ye-Synix ye-Instance yeseva.
4. Imodi yangaphambili ye-Local/Console ayidingi amalungelo omlawuli. Imodi yesevisi ye-Windows iyasebenza.
5. Izidingo: .NET Framework 4.8 noma okusha, Visual C ++ Redistributable 2013 futhi 2017, okungenani 6 GB yesistimu RAM, futhi UDP port 27016 evunyelwe ngokusebenzisa Windows Firewall bese uthunyelwa abadlali be-intanethi.
6. Idokhumenti Esemthethweni: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5CA69EB89BDD805145B9
data.value: Vula i-Documents\Euro Truck Simulator 2\config.cfg bese usetha ukusetshenziswa kwe-g_console "1". Qalisa umdlalo ovamile we-Euro Truck Simulator 2, ulayishe iphrofayili yakho nebalazwe, cindezela ~ ukuvula ikhonsoli, bese usebenzisa i-export_server_packages. Vala umdlalo, bese uchofoza i-Start ku-Synix futhi. I-Synix izokhipha amafayela akhiqizwayo ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Sebenzisa lesi siqondiso lapho ukudlala kwe-LAN kusebenza kodwa ukuhlolwa kwekheli lomphakathi akunjalo.
IZINDABA ZAKHO ZOKUTHUMELA EMphakathini Amanye ama-routers awasekeli i-NAT loopback, ebizwa nangokuthi i-hairpinning. Ukuxhumeka okuvela ngaphakathi endlini kuya ekhelini layo lomphakathi kungaphazamisa ngisho nalapho abadlali bangaphandle bengakwazi ukujoyina.
Sebenzisa ikheli le-LAN ekhaya bese ucela othile onokuxhumeka kwe-inthanethi ukuhlola ikheli lomphakathi. Ukuhluleka kwe-PC WAN probe ngokwayo akubufakazi bokuphazamiseka kwe-intanethi.
UKUHAMBELA Phambili AKWENZI Umehluko Hlola omunye umzila upstream, double NAT, noma opharetha grade NAT (CGNAT). Qhathanisa ulwazi lwe-WAN lomzila nekheli lomphakathi bese ubuza i-ISP ukuthi izixhumanisi ezingenayo ziyaxhaswa yini.
Umthetho wokudlulisela ku-router yakho awukwazi ukuvula i-ISP elawulwa phezulu kwe-NAT. Ngokuya ngokuxhumeka, kungase kudingeke isevisi ye-address yomphakathi, i-VPN/umhubhe ofanele, noma iseva ebanjwe. Lezi yizilungiselelo zangaphandle, hhayi izici ze-Synix ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.
Ungaphambanisi ukuphathwa nokufinyelela komdlali Ukuxhumeka kwesilawuli esikude nokuxhumeka komdlali womdlalo kuyindlela ehlukene. Ukuvumela izaziso zendawo ze-API noma ze-Discord akusho ukuthi umdlalo ufinyeleleka ngokuzenzakalelayo kusuka ku-intanethi.
Gcina noma yikuphi ukuhlolwa kwenethiwekhi kunomkhawulo omncane wezibuko langempela lomdlalo neprotocol. Lapho ucela usizo, ungashicileli amaphasiwedi, amathokheni, izithombe zesikrini se-router noma imininingwane yenethiwekhi yangasese.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Sebenzisa i-log ehlobene nengxenye ehlulekile.
I-SYNIX YENZELO I-Activity & Diagnostics ibonisa inqubekela phambili nezixwayiso ezihlobene nomsebenzisi kudeshibhodi. Ukuhlanza leyo ndawo kuhlanza kuphela imiyalezo ebonakalayo; akucimi konke ukuxilongwa okugciniwe.
I-LOGS yesicelo Ama-logs wombhalo we-Synix nemibiko yokushayisana okubulalayo ngokuvamile: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Inkulumo-mpikiswano yokuxhumeka inganikeza igama lefayela elithile. Sebenzisa leyo ndlela nesikhathi sokwehluleka ukuthola okufakiwe.
Izimfuneko zokuxilonga eziphathwayo zingabhalwa ku-log yombhalo ngaphandle kokuvela kudeshibhodi. Ukwehluka okubhalwe phansi okuphathwayo akuyona ubufakazi obuzenzakalelayo bokushayisana kwesicelo.
I-GAME LOGS Sebenzisa i-log yangempela yomdlalo yesiphakeli esikhethiwe ukuze uthole amaphutha okulayisha umhlaba, ukumiswa, ukuguqulwa kanye nesikhathi somdlalo. Indawo yayo incike emdlalweni futhi ingase ibe ngaphandle kwezimpande zokufaka.
Funda EMBhalweni Phawula isenzo nesikhathi, bese uhlola imiyalezo ezungeze ukwehluleka kokuqala okunengqondo. Ukuvalwa komugqa ekugcineni kungaba umphumela kunokuba kube imbangela.
Ngaphambi kokuba wabelane nganoma yisiphi isiqeshana, susa amaphasiwedi, amathokheni, ama-webhooks, amakheli wangasese nezindlela zomuntu siqu. I-Satisfactory's own console/log ingaqukatha ithokheni lomlawuli. Gcina ilogi yangasese yokuqala ukuze uphenye wena.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Ukubuyisela kungathatha indawo yokuqukethwe kokufakwa kweseva ekhethiwe. Khetha iseva efanele bese ugcina noma yini entsha ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
1. Misa iseva bese wenza ikhophi ehlukile yamafayela wamanje ongase uwafune. 2. Vula i- Restore backup workflow ku- Server Options. 3. Khetha i-archive ehlosiwe bese uhlola iseva yayo, usuku, usayizi nesimo sayo sokuphepha. 4. Qinisekisa ngaphambi kokubuyisela. Amaphakeji we-Synix anezipheshana ze-SHA-256 angahlolwa kulezo zipheshana; imibhalo emidala ingakhonjwa njengefa. 5. Funda isixwayiso sokushintsha bese uqinisekisa kuphela ukuthi leli yindawo oyifunayo. 6. Vumela ukuhlelwa nokuvuselelwa kuphele ngaphandle kokuvala i-Synix noma ukukhipha isitoreji. 7. Qalisa iseva bese uqinisekisa ukuthi umhlaba kanye nezilungiselelo ezihlosiwe zibuyiselwe.
Lokho Okufakazelwa Ukuhlolwa Ukuhlola ubuqotho kuthola izinguquko maqondana ne-receipt. Akubufakazi bokuthi umhlaba wawuphilile lapho usindiswa noma bokuthi umlando womunye umuntu unokwethenjelwa.
Uma Indawo Yokudlela Iphazamisekile Gcina imibhalo kanye nanoma yimaphi amafayela okubuyisela emuva noma okubuyisela. Funda umyalezo wokubuyisela ngaphambi kokuzama enye indlela yokubuyisela noma yokususa amafayela.
Ungakhiphi i-ZIP phezu kwesiphakeli esisebenzayo. Uma umdlalo ugcina ukulondolozwa ngaphandle kwefolda yokufaka, zibuyisele ngokwehlukana ngenqubo yomdlalo esekelwayo.
Gcina isipele sokuqala uze uvivinye iseva ebuyiselwe nokuxhumeka kweklayenti.

data.name: Content.730545B3639C062E1741
data.value: Amamoda ahlanganisiwe ahambisanayo aya ku-Mods/UserCode. Ukufanisa inguqulo ye-Eco ne-API futhi ugcine izimpahla ezihambisana nazo ezidingekayo.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Ukungenisa i-Existing Server kubhalisa ukufakwa okusekelwayo okuvele ku-disk. Akuyona ukufakwa kabusha futhi kuhlukile ekungeniseni iphakethe eliphelele lokudlulisa le-Synix.
NGAPHAMBI Kokungenisa Yenza isipele esihlukile, kuhlanganise noma yikuphi ukulondoloza ngaphandle kwefolda yokufaka. Vimbela iseva futhi ukhubaze omunye umphathi noma umhleli wesikhathi ongakwazi ukuqala ngenkathi i-Synix iyiphatha.
Bhalisa ukufakwa 1. Khetha Ukungeza Iseva → Ukungenisa Iseva Ekhona. 2. Khetha ifolda yangempela yokufaka iseva, hhayi indlela emfushane, ifayela le-ZIP, noma ifolda yeklayenti lomdlalo. 3. Vumela uSynix akuhlole, bese uqinisekisa umdlalo otholakele, inguqulo, i-executable nezilungiselelo. 4. Nika okufakiwe igama eliyingqayizivele futhi ugcwalise noma yimaphi amanani alahlekile. 5. Qedela ukungenisa, vula Ukucushwa, bese uhlola izindlela kanye namatheku ayo. 6. Qalisa Ukulungela, bese wenza ukuqala okukodwa okulawulwayo. Hlola ukuthi izwe kanye nokwakheka okuhlosiwe kwakulayishiwe yini.
Yini EYEYashintsha? Ukubhalisa akusho ukuhambisa ukufakwa, ukulayisha kabusha, noma ukufaka esikhundleni amafayela okuhlela. Izenzo zakamuva ozikhethile ngokucacile, njenge-Update, Validate, noma ukulungisa ukucushwa, zingashintsha amafayela.
Ama-wrapper okuqalisa, ama-modpacks, amaphasiwedi nokugcinwa kwangaphandle kungase kungabonakali ngokuzenzakalelayo. Indlela efanayo yokufaka ayikwazi ukubhaliswa kabili.
Uma Ukuxilongwa Kuhluleka Qinisekisa ukuthi ukhethe ukufakwa kwesiphakeli esinikezelwe esisekelwa iphrofayili ekhethiwe. Ungashintshi igama le-executable engahlobene ukuze ucindezele ukufana. Bika umdlalo kanye nesakhiwo sefolda esihleliwe ukuze kuqinisekiswe incazelo yawo.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Sebenzisa lo mhlahlandlela lapho umhleli wokusetha ubika inkambu ephethwe engekho, isakhiwo esingasebenzi, noma ukungalingani kwesampula.
Qonda Izinketho • Ukugcina okujwayelekile kuvuselela amanani asekelwayo ekwakhiweni okukhethiwe. • Ukulungiswa kuxazulula inkinga ebikiwe esekelwayo. • Ukusetha kabusha kubuyisela izilungiselelo ezizenzakalelayo zesampula futhi kungasusa izilungiselelo ezenziwe ngezifiso.
Ukusetha kabusha akusona isinyathelo sokuqala sokuhluleka kweseva ngayinye. Izikhathi zokusebenza zomdlalo ezingekho, izikhumulo ezimatasa nezinguquko eziphukile azilungiswa ngokushintsha amafayela wokulungisa ngokuphindaphindiwe.
Ngaphambi Kokulungisa Yeka ukudlala, gcina ikhophi elingenalutho lamafayela athintekile, bese ufunda ushintsho oluhlongozwayo. Amanye amaphrofayli anezifanekiso eziphelele; Abanye balindele ukuthi umdlalo ukhiqize amafayela lapho uqala noma udinga ukusetha ngesandla.
I-Synix ibika ukulahleka kwamathegi adingekayo kunokucabanga ukuthi ingathatha indawo yomugqa ngamunye ngokuphepha. Ukusebenzisa ukubuyekezwa kwesampula okuphathwayo kungalondoloza ikhophi elilodwa elibizwa ngokuthi .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
NGEMVA Kokulondoloza Noma Ukulungisa Okungaphumelelanga Gcina noma yimaphi amafayela okubuyisela noma okubuyisela futhi ufunde umyalezo wokubuyisela. Qhathanisa ukwakheka kokuqala nokuguqulwa ngaphambi kokukhetha ukuthi uzokubuyisela ini. Ungasusi ubufakazi ngokuphindaphindiwe ngokuzama ukubuyisela kabusha.
Ngemva kokululama, qala kanye futhi uhlole ilogo yomdlalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ufunda indlela efanele nokuthi izilungiselelo ezidingekayo zisekhona.
