data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
I-Dune isebenzisa uhlelo lokuthumela lwangaphandle olunemishini ebonakalayo yemidlalo nesimo seqembu lempi. Akuyona iseva evamile yomdlalo oyedwa.
Izidingo Funda ukuhlolwa kokulungela kwe-Synix kwememori yesistimu, i-AVX2, i-hardware virtualization, i-Hyper-V, kanye ne-Professional- noma i-Windows edition esezingeni eliphakeme esekelwayo. Isidingo sememori sincike eqenjini lokulwa nasemaphethini owasebenzisayo.
I-Synix ayivumeli ngokuzenzakalelayo ukufakelwa noma ukufakwa kwe-Hyper-V. Qedela izidingo ezisemthethweni zomdlalo ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa.
Ukufaka nokuqalisa 1. Dala okufakiwe kwe-Dune: Awakening bese uhlola izidingo zayo nefolda yokufaka. 2. Gcina bese uqala. 3. I-Synix iqalisa ithuluzi elisemthethweni le-battlegroup.bat nge-prompt yomlawuli edingekayo kulokho kuthunyelwa. 4. Khetha i-initial-setup kuthuluzi lomdlalo bese unikeza i-Self-Host Token yakho. 5. Qedela ukuhlelwa kwe-VM, inethiwekhi namaqembu empi kulelo thuluzi.
Thola i-Self-Host Token ngokusebenzisa ingosi esemthethweni ye-akhawunti yeFuncom usebenzisa inqubo yayo yokufaneleka / ukusetha: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Gcina ithokheni liyimfihlo. Ukuphakama kwaleli thuluzi lokuthumela akusho ukuthi wonke amaseva e-Synix kufanele asebenze njengomlawuli.
Imingcele YENethiwekhi Nokulawula Sebenzisa ukwakheka kwenethiwekhi ye-host / VM kanye namachweba adingekayo. I-metadata yenkambu yombuzo ku-Synix imelela i-RMQ, hhayi umlaleli ojwayelekile wombuzo we-A2S.
Iwindi lokuqalisa elivaliwe alibonisi ukuthi ama-VM alo ayekile. Qinisekisa isimo sokusebenza futhi wenze imisebenzi yeqembu lokulwa ngezilawuli zokuthumela umdlalo.
I-Synix ingafaka, ivuselele, iqalise futhi ibuyekeze ifolda yokufaka ekhethiwe. Ungacabangi ukuthi ukuqedwa kwenqubo okuvamile, imibuzo yomdlali, noma ukubuyiselwa kwe-watchdog kulawula ngokugcwele ukuthunyelwa kwangaphandle. Ukuthekelisa ifayela lokuqalisa akuhlinzeki kule phrofayili.
Sebenzisa izinqubo zokuvala nokusekela okuxhaswe ngumdlalo kwedatha ye-VM / database eqhubekayo. I-ZIP yefolda yokuthumela ngokwayo akuyona isipele esiqinisekisiwe esihambisanayo sayo.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Lesi sihloko senzelwe abasebenzisi nabahlanganyeli abaphambili. Awudingi amathuluzi omthuthukisi ukudala iseva kusuka kuphrofayela esekelwayo.
INDLELA IZINcazelo Ezisebenza Ngayo Izincazelo zomdlalo ezakhelwe ngaphakathi zichaza okulandwayo, okuqhutshwayo, ama-Steam AppID kanye nezidingo zokungena ngemvume, izimpikiswano zokuqalisa, amachweba, ukuziphatha kokulungiswa, izidingo zangaphambilini, namakhono wesilawuli.
Izincazelo zikhethe ukuziphatha okusekelwayo. Azithwali ngokuzenzakalelayo iziphathimandla, imihlangano, noma imibhalo elayishiwe. Ukulahla ifayela le-JSON kufolda yesicelo efakiwe akufaki iphrofayili entsha yomdlalo ehlanganisiwe.
Lungisa noma ungeze iphrofayili 1. Qala ngemiyalo esemthethweni yesiphakeli esinikezelwe namafayela wokumisa wangempela akhiqizwayo. 2. Sebenzisa izindlela ezihlobene ne-server-root lapho kudingeka khona kanye nezihlonzi eziqondile ezibhekene nomdlalo. 3. Faka izifanekiso eziphelele ezisekelwayo ezindaweni zazo ezifakwe kahle. 4. Vuselela ukubuyekezwa okufanele kwencazelo / ukwakheka / ithempulethi. 5. Qinisekisa umtapo wezincwadi, wakhe nge-SDK edingekayo kuphrojekthi, bese uqhuba ukuhlolwa okufanele. 6. Ukuhlolwa kokufakwa, ukuqala, ukumisa nokuqapha ngomdlalo wangempela ngaphambi kokurekhoda ukuqinisekiswa.
I-Definition Builder iyithuluzi lokwakha ukuthuthukiswa, hhayi imfuneko ejwayelekile yokukhululwa kwesethulo.
I-SOURCE ORGANIZATION • I-UI: Amafasitela anezici. • I-ServerHandler: Izilawuli zemidlalo nokuhlanganiswa kweseva. • I-SynixEngine: Umjikelezo wokuphila wohlelo lokusebenza, ukugcinwa, ukuxhumana kwenethiwekhi, izipele nokuphepha. • Umklamo: Ukulawula okuhlanganyela, izingqikithi, nezinsiza zokuhlela. • I-Database/GameDefinitions: Amaphrofayili nemibono yemidlalo. • I-Database/ModSystems: Ukuhamba komsebenzi okungeziwe okusekelwayo. • Ukuhlelwa kwendawo: Amakhathalogi nezikhiqizi ze-interface. • Ukuhlolwa: Ukuhlolwa okugxile ezicini.
Uma kuziwa ekuhumusheni, hlela zonke izilimi ndawonye futhi ugcine izikhundla zazo. Faka phakathi izihloko zosizo, ukuxilongwa, umbhalo wokufinyeleleka, nezincazelo zokusekela imidlalo. Ungahumushi imiyalo, okhiye, amathokheni, amanani womsebenzisi, noma izimpawu zokukhipha. Amadokhumenti okuxilongwa kwangempela ahlala engashintshiwe.
Funda Imigomo Yelayisense Nobunikazi ngaphambi kokusakaza kabusha ikhodi noma ukwakha. Gcina izitifiketi zangempela namalogi wangasese ngaphandle kweminikelo nezixhumanisi.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Lungiselela isimiso sokugcinwa kweseva kuphela ngemva kokuhlola ukuziphatha kwayo okujwayelekile kokulondoloza, ukuvuselela, ukumisa nokuqalisa.
1. Vula izilungiselelo zayo zokuzenzakalela/zokwenza isimiso bese uvumela isimiso. 2. Khetha izinsuku nesikhathi. 3. Vumela Ukugcinwa Okuhlakaniphile bese ukhetha izinketho ezikhona zokulondoloza / zokuvuselela. 4. Nquma ukuthi uzolinda yini abadlali bese usetha ukubambezeleka okuphezulu. 5. Gcina futhi uhlole ngesikhathi sewindi lokulungisa ongaliqapha.
Izinhlelo zisebenzisa isikhathi sendawo se-PC. Gcina iwashi nesikhathi salo sinembile.
Lapho Uhlelo Lwesikhathi Luphothulwa I-Synix ingalinda abadlali abaxhunyiwe, bese ihlela ukumiswa kweqembu lenqubo eliqinisekisiwe, ukwenza isipele ngenkathi limisiwe, ukuvuselela nokuqalisa kabusha ngokuya ngezinketho ezikhethiwe.
Ukubambezeleka okukhulu kunomkhawulo, hhayi isithembiso sokulinda phakade. Ukugcinwa kungaqhubeka lapho kuphelelwa yisikhathi ngisho noma abadlali behlala. Ukubambezeleka okuncane akunikezi isikhathi sokulinda.
Imininingwane yomdlali inemingcele Ukulinda kuncike olwazini umdlalo okhethiwe onganikeza lona. Iseva ye-API exhunywe ku-Satisfactory iphatha izinombolo eziphelelwe yisikhathi noma ezingatholakali ngokulinganisela ngesikhathi sokulinda esilungiselelwe. Lokho akwenzi idatha yombuzo engasekelwa ithembeke.
Yazisa abadlali kusengaphambili futhi ufunde imilayezo yomsebenzi. Izaziso ze-Discord zingabika izenzakalo zesondlo ezisekelwayo lapho imigqa yazo ihlelwe.
I-PC kufanele ivuke futhi inqubo efanele ye-Synix noma i-agent yangemuva kufanele isebenze. Ikhompyutha evaliwe noma elele ayikwazi ukwenza ukulandwa nokuqalisa kabusha okuhleliwe.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Vula i-Windows Terminal noma i-PowerShell bese usebenzisa isibonakaliso esiqondile sephasela elingezansi. Le miyalo ilawula i-Synix uqobo, hhayi amaseva womdlalo ngamunye.
Faka winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Hlola Iphakethe Elifakiwe winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
I-UPDATE Vala i-Synix bese uqeda ukusebenza kwayo ngaphambi kokusebenzisa: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Susa Uhlelo Lokusebenza winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Gcina Imininingwane Yakho Ukufakwa kweseva, ukulondoloza nokwenza isipele kuhlukanisiwe nephakheji lesicelo. Ungasusi i-C:\Synix noma amanye amafolda wedatha angokwezifiso ngaphandle kokuthi ufuna ukususa leyo datha ngamabomu.
Uma Umyalo Wehluleka Funda isizathu esishiwo. Uma i-WinGet ibika ukungalingani kwe-hash yokufaka, yeka ukubika; ungadluli ukuqinisekiswa kwe-hash. Ukubuyekezwa okungekho kungasho ukuthi i-repository ayikashicileli iphakethe elisha okwamanje.
Ukuvunywa kwe-WinGet kanye ne-hash yokulanda ehambisanayo ayifaki ikhodi ye-Synix noma iqinisekise ukuthi isofthiwe yokuphepha ye-Windows izoyethemba.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Qala ngokufakazela ukuthi umdlalo usebenza kunethiwekhi yakho. Ukuguqulwa kwe-router akukwazi ukulungisa umdlalo ongazange uqale noma uqede ukufakwa kwawo kokuqala.
Khetha Indawo Efanele • Ku-PC yesiphakeli: Sebenzisa ukuxhumeka kwendawo noma okubuyela emuva komdlalo okusekelwayo. • Kwenye idivayisi yenethiwekhi yasekhaya: Sebenzisa ikheli le-LAN le-PC yesiphakeli. • Ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yakho yasekhaya: Sebenzisa ikheli lakho lomphakathi noma indlela yomdlalo yokutholwa/ukujoyina.
Vula imininingwane yokuxhuma yokungena okukhethiwe ukuze uhlole amaphuzu ayo okugcina. Ikheli langasese le-LAN alikwazi ukusetshenziswa ngokuqondile ngabadlali be-intanethi.
Ukuhlolwa Kwendawo 1. Linda kuze kube yilapho umdlalo usuqedile ukulayisha. 2. Hlola isiteshi esilungiselelwe nemiphumela yokulungela kweseva. 3. Joyina kusuka ku-PC yomnikazi, bese usuka kwenye idivayisi ye-LAN. 4. Uma ukufinyelela kwe-LAN kwehluleka, hlola ilogi yomdlalo nokufinyelela kwe-Windows Firewall ukuze uthole i-server esebenzayo yangempela.
Vumela Abadlali Be-Inthanethi 1. Nikeza umphathi ikheli le-LAN elizinzile, ngokuvamile elinendawo yokubhuka ye-DHCP. 2. Khomba iziteshi ezidingekayo kanye nezinqubo ze-TCP/UDP zokulungiswa komdlalo wangempela. 3. Thumela kuphela lawo maphuzu okugcina ekhelini le-LAN lomninikhaya. 4. Vumela ukuhambisana komgwaqo womdlalo ngeWindows Firewall kumaphrofayli enethiwekhi oyisebenzisayo. 5. Ukuhlolwa okuvela ekuxhumaneni kwe-Internet okuhlukile ngempela.
Ungavumeli umzila we-DMZ usebenze, ungalivali udonga lomlilo, noma uveze zonke iziteshi zokuphatha njengesixazululo esivamile. Gcina izitifiketi zomzila ziyimfihlo.
I-Synix ingumphathi wedeskithophu wendawo. Ayibandakanyi iphaneli yewebhu noma i-relay yomphakathi eyenza lezi zidingo zenethiwekhi zinyamalale.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
I-SteamCMD ilanda futhi ivuselele amafayela wesiphakeli esinikezelwe semidlalo ye-Steam esekelwayo. I-Synix ilungiselela ikhophi layo elihlanganyelwe ngokuzenzakalelayo; isethi ejwayelekile yesiphakeli ayidingi ithebhu ehlukile ye-SteamCMD.
LANDELA INDLELA EYENZEKAYO Khetha iseva bese ufunda i-Activity & Diagnostics. I-dashboard animation ibonisa ukuthi umsebenzi wokufaka uyaqhubeka. I-SteamCMD ingashintsha phakathi kokulanda, ukuhlukanisa, ukupakisha nokuqinisekisa, ngakho-ke ukukhipha kwayo akuhlali kunikeza iphesenti elizinzile noma isikhathi esinokwethenjelwa esisele.
Vumela ukusebenza kwediski kuphele ngisho nalapho ithrafikhi yenethiwekhi yehla. Funda umyalezo wokugcina wempumelelo noma wokwehluleka ngaphambi kokuqala omunye umsebenzi.
ULIMIT Ijubane Lokulanda Vula Izilungiselelo → Jikelele → SteamCMD Isivinini Sokulanda. Khetha imodi encishisiwe esekelwayo bese ufaka isivinini esibonisiwe, noma ukhethe isivinini esigcwele.
Lokhu kuthinta ukulayishwa kwe-SteamCMD, hhayi ububanzi bebhande labadlali, umlayishi womdlalo ngamunye ongeyena we-Steam, noma yonke ithrafikhi ku-PC.
I-SIGN-IN NE-FAILURES Amanye amaphrofayli womdlalo adinga i-akhawunti egunyaziwe ye-Steam nokuqinisekiswa kwe-Steam Guard. Sebenzisa i-Sign-in prompt ye-Synix; ungafaki ama-account credentials emibhalweni noma emibikweni yomphakathi.
Ukuze uthole ukulanda okungaphumelelanga, funda iphutha eliqondile le-SteamCMD bese uhlola isikhala sediski samahhala, ukufinyelela kufolda, ukufinyelela kwenethiwekhi, nanoma yisiphi isidingo se-akhawunti. Ukuqinisekiswa kungalayisha kabusha amafayela aphethwe umfakisi, ngakho gcina izinguquko ezenziwe ngezifiso ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisa.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Imibono ye-Empyrion ne-mods yekhodi yesiphakeli ihlukile. Ku-Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, khetha izimo ze-Empyrion noma i-Empyrion server mods. Misa iseva futhi ugcine isipele esigcwele se-server ngaphambi kokwenza izinguquko.
Faka Isimo 1. I-Browse Catalog ivula i-Steam Workshop. Bhalisela lesi simo bese ulinda kuze kube yilapho i-Steam iqeda ukuyilanda. Imidwebo ye-workshop neqoqo akuzona izimo zeseva. 2. Khetha iphakethe lokungenisa, bese ukhetha ifolda. Khetha ifolda yesimo ngasinye ngaphakathi kwefolda yezincwadi zakho ze-Steam ze-steamapps\workshop\content\383120. Ungase futhi ukhethe scenario ephelele ZIP. 3. Faka igama lefolda yesimo esibonakalayo. Ungasebenzisi kuphela i-ID ye-Workshop. Gcina igama lefolda elifanayo ukuze uvuselelwe kamuva. 4. Hlola ukuhlolwa kwephakeji kanye nendawo oya kuyo, bese uqinisekisa ukungeniswa. I-Synix ikopisha isimo esiphelele ibe yi-Content\Scenarios ngaphandle kokuyisebenzisa noma ukushintsha izwe. 5. Khetha iScenario uhlu lwezimo ezifakiwe. Khetha eyodwa bese uhlola igama elihlukile lokulondoloza. Ukushintshela esimweni esihlukile kudinga igama elisha elingasetshenziswanga lokugcina; I-Synix iphakamisa enye futhi ishiya ukulondolozwa okukhona kungathintwanga. 6. Sebenzisa ukukhetha, qala iseva, bese uhlola ilogi yayo nokuxhumeka kwamaklayenti. Ezinye izimo zinezilungiselelo noma izidingo ezengeziwe eziqinisekiswe umbhali wazo.
Igama le-scenario GameConfig.CustomScenario; Igama lomhlaba osindisiwe yiGameConfig.GameName. I-Synix yenza isipele se-dedicated.yaml ngaphambi kokushintsha lezi zinkambu futhi igcine ukufakwa kwesiphakeli kuvumelanisiwe. Ayibeki kabusha imbewu, amaphasiwedi noma izilungiselelo ezingahlobene.
Faka izindlela ze-Server Sebenzisa iphrofayela ye-Empyrion server mods kanye ne-Import Package ukuze ukhethe ifolda ye-mod ZIP ehlanganisiwe noma ephelele ye-mod. Faka ama-DLL ayo, izimpahla ezisekelayo, ukuxhomeka, kanye ne-_Info.yaml lapho inikezwe. I-Synix ifaka lezi ngaphansi kwe-Content\Mods; umdlalo ulayisha ikhodi lapho uqala. Ukulandwa kwekhodi yomthombo nokufakwa okuzimele akuxhasiwe amaphakheji.
I-Synix ayifaki i-mod loader noma inike amandla i-mod engavumelekile ngokuzenzakalela. Landela izidingo zomlobi, kuhlanganise noma yikuphi ukulayisha okungeziwe, ukumiswa, nokumiswa kweklayenti. Ukungeniswa okuphumelelayo akufakazeli ukuthi i-mod iyahambisana nomdlalo wamanje noma ezinye izindlela ezifakiwe.
I-UPDATES NE-RECUPERY I-Steam ivuselela ikhophi yayo yeWorkshop, hhayi ikhophi yesiphakeli elithunyelwe yi-Synix. Ukuze uvuselele, yima iseva bese ulanda iphakethe elibuyekeziwe usebenzisa igama lefolda yesimo esifanayo. Hlola ukuthi umbhali udinga ukulondolozwa okusha yini. Amafayela athathelwe indawo athola amakhophi angemuva; Ukungenisa isibuyekezo akuyona ukufakwa kabusha okuhlanzekile futhi akususi amafayela alahlekile ephaketheni elisha.
Ukuvuselela uhlu lwamaphakheji aphelele kunokuba kuhlanganiswe zonke izimpahla. Ukufakwa (okungaqinisekisiwe kabusha) kusho ukuthi ukungeniswa kwaqoshwa, hhayi ukuthi wonke amafayela afakiwe asanda kuhlolwa futhi. I-Roll Back Import iguqula konke ukungenisa okukhethiwe, kufaka phakathi ezinye izilungiselelo zephakeji elifanayo, futhi yenqaba ukufaka esikhundleni samafayela ashintshiwe ngaphandle kwe-Synix. Izitolo ezikhethiwe kanye nezinsizakusebenza ze-scenario ezidingwa umhlaba ogcinwe zivikelwe ekudlulisweni; ukuvuselelwa kwesimo esiqoshiwe kusengabuyiselwa kumafayela aso angaphambili.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Vula Ukucushwa → Inethiwekhi & RCON ukubuyekeza amaphuzu okugcina asekelwa umdlalo okhethiwe. Sebenzisa ukwakheka komdlalo, hhayi uhlu olujwayelekile lwezikhumulo.
I-PORT ROLES • Iphothifoliyo yomdlalo: Umgwaqo womdlali. • Iphothifoliyo yombuzo: Ukwaziswa kweseva noma ukutholakala, uma leyo protocol yombuzo isekelwa. • I-RCON/admin port: Isiteshi sokuphatha esingakhethwa. • I-App/API port: Isikhungo esihambisana nomdlalo noma isevisi yokuphatha.
I-TCP ne-UDP yizinqubo ezahlukene. Amaphrothokholi amabili ahlukene angasebenzisa inombolo efanayo yezibuko, kodwa amaseva amabili awakwazi ukwabelana ngendawo yokulalela ephikisanayo. I-Synix ibuye ihlolisise amaphrofayli agcinwe ukuze kutholakale izingxabano zezibuko, kufaka phakathi okufakiwe okuvinjelwe.
Gcina amaphuzu okugcina avumelekile ayingqayizivele ezimweni ezihlukile futhi alondoloze noma yibuphi ubudlelwano obudingekayo emdlalweni phakathi kwamachweba. Ungacabangi ukuthi wonke umdlalo we-gameplay yi-UDP noma ukuthi yonke inkambu yombuzo imelela umlaleli wangempela.
UMPHUMO AKUYINDLELA YOKUDlala Abadlali ngokuvamile abadingi ukufinyelela ku-RCON noma kwenye iphuzu lokuphela lomlawuli. Gcina ukuphathwa kusendaweni ngaphandle kokuthi ube nohlelo oluthile lokuphathwa okukude oluphephile.
Izibonelo ZEMidlalo Eyingqayizivele • I-Minecraft i-Java ne-Bedrock zisebenzisa ukuziphatha okuhlukile kokuxhuma; landela uhlelo olukhethiwe. • I-Satisfactory yasendaweni ye-API isebenzisa i-port yayo yomdlalo / i-API; Inani layo elidala lenkambu yombuzo aliyona imfuneko eyengeziwe ye-Synix. • I-metadata ye-Dune's query field imelela i-RMQ deployment port yayo, hhayi isevisi ejwayelekile yombuzo we-Steam A2S. • I-Rust+ isebenzisa iphuzu layo lokuphela elihambisana nalo ngaphezu komdlalo.
Amathempulethi okuzenzakalelayo amanani okuqala, hhayi uhlu lokuhlola lokuvula umzila jikelele. Hlola umlaleli wangempela ngaphambi kokushintsha umthetho we-firewall.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: I-Dune: Awakening isebenzisa uhlelo olusemthethweni lokuthumela amaseva anikezelwe. I-Hyper-V ne-hardware virtualization kufanele inikwe amandla, futhi i-Windows Pro noma i-Enterprise iyadingeka. Ekuqalisweni kokuqala, i-Synix iqala i-battlegroup.bat njengoMlawuli. Khetha i-initial-setup bese ulungisa i-Self-Host Token yakho. I-Synix ingakwazi ukufaka, ukuvuselela, ukwenza isipele nokuqalisa ukuthunyelwa, kodwa umdlalo ungumnikazi wemishini ebonakalayo nesimo sayo sokusebenza. Umhlahlandlela Osemthethweni: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
I-Discord webhooks ithumela izenzakalo ezikhethiwe zesiphakeli esiteshini. Ziyizindaba, hhayi i-bot ye-Discord yokulawula ukude i-Synix.
Beka Umgomo 1. Dala noma uthole i-webhook yesiteshi ovunyelwe ukusilawula. 2. Vula ikhasi le- Configure → Discord leseva elikhethiwe. 3. Faka i-webhook bese ukhetha izinketho ezitholakalayo zokuqondisa umcimbi. 4. Gcina ukucushwa. 5. Sebenzisa isenzo sokuhlola uma sinikezwa, noma uqinisekise ukulethwa ngesikhathi somcimbi ohleliwe.
Imilayezo yokuqalisa, yokuvala, yokutakula, yokulondoloza kanye nokugcinwa incike emikhondweni evunyelwe nokuthi ngabe ukusebenza kwenzeka ngempela yini.
Vikela I-URL I-URL ye-webhook iqukethe izitifiketi zokuthumela. Noma ubani oyitholayo angase akwazi ukuthumela imiyalezo kuleyo channel. Yigcine kude nezithombe zesikrini zomphakathi, izihloko, imibhalo, nezingxoxo.
I-Synix ivikela i-webhook yayo egciniwe yomsebenzisi we-Windows. Uma i-URL iveziwe, yijikeleze noma uyisuse ku-Discord, bese uvuselela indawo lapho i-Synix iya khona. Hlola amagama amaseva nemininingwane yomcimbi ethunyelwe esiteshini esabiwe.
Uma Imiyalezo Ingafiki Hlola umzila womcimbi okhethiwe, i-URL, ukutholakala kwesiteshi / i-webhook, nokuthi i-PC ingafinyelela yini ku-Discord. Hlola iphutha elibikiwe ngaphandle kokushicilela i-URL ephelele.
Izaziso zisebenzisa ukuxhumeka okuphuma ku-Discord. Azidingi ukuvulwa kwesiteshi sokulawula se-router engenayo.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Nquma ukuthi ususa kuphela iphaneli yokulawula noma ususa njalo yini amaseva owabamba. Lezi yizenzo ezahlukene.
Susa Uhlelo Lokusebenza Kuphela 1. Qedela noma yikuphi ukufakwa, ukudluliswa, noma ukusekela okuqhubekayo. 2. Vimbela amaseva akho ku-Synix, ulinde kuze kube yilapho eseqedile ukulondoloza, bese uphuma ku-Synix. 3. Gcina ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yezwe elibalulekile, amafayela wokusetha, namaphepha okugunyaza. 4. Khipha i- Synix ku- Windows Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakiwe noma umphathi wakho wamaphakheji.
Gcina i-C:\Synix, amafolda wesiphakeli angokwezifiso, ukulondolozwa komdlalo kwangaphandle, nezindawo zokugcina uma uhlela ukuwasebenzisa futhi. Ukufaka kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza akudingi ukususa la mafolda.
Susa i-server eyodwa Sebenzisa isenzo Susa se-server ekhethiwe ku-Synix bese ufunda isiqinisekiso. Ukususa okufakiwe kwedeshibhodi akufani nokuvuma ukususa amafayela okufaka noma okwenza isipele. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphi imininingwane ezosuswa.
Ungasebenzisi ukususwa njengendlela yokuxazulula izinkinga. Isipele esigcinwe kuphela ngaphakathi kwefolda oyisusayo asiyona ikhophi yokutakula.
Uma ushintshela kwenye iphaneli yokulawula, qinisekisa ukuthi ingaqala ukufakwa okufanele futhi ilayishe umhlaba ohlosiwe ngaphambi kokususa idatha yakho endala.

data.name: Content.B4F7813ACC4371C7ADEF
data.value:
Khetha isihloko ngakwesobunxele ukuze ufunde imiyalo yaso. Zonke izihloko zosizo zisebenza okungaxhunyiwe ku-intanethi ngolimi olukhethile.
Ingabe usanda kufika kuSynx? Vula isiqondiso sokusetha okokuqala ku- Getting Started & Setup.
UKUPHUMESA i-server? Khetha isigaba somsebenzi, njengokusetha, ukuxhumana, ukubhekisa emuva, noma ukulawula okuqondene nomdlalo.
Ufuna Iphutha? Cindezela u-Ctrl+F bese ufuna isici, umdlalo noma ingxenye emfushane yomyalezo. Ukucinga kuhlolisisa izihloko zezihloko kanye nombhalo ophelele futhi kubonise umbhalo ofanayo.
Sebenzisa inkinobho ethi "Clear-search" ukuze ubuyele kuzo zonke izihloko. Thwebula futhi usekele izixhumanisi ezivulekile kusiphequluli sakho kuphela uma uzikhetha.

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: I-ATLAS idinga inethiwekhi yeseva ethunyelwe kanye nedatha ye-Redis efakiwe ngaphambi kokuba i-ShooterGameServer.exe iqale ukusebenza. I-Synix izovimba ukuqala kuze kube yilapho i-ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json ne-ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json zikhona. Dala i-grid ngeGrapeshot Games ServerGridEditor esemthethweni, faka womabili amafayela kufolda ye-ShooterGame, bese uqala i-AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat ngaphambi kokuqala iseva ye-ATLAS. I-Redis kufanele ihlale isendaweni ye-127.0.0.1 futhi isikhumulo se-6379 akufanele sivezwe yi-Inthanethi.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Khetha iseva bese usebenzisa amathuluzi ayo okuhlola uxhumano noma omdlali lapho ekhona. I-Synix ikhetha ukuhlolwa ngokuya ngombuzo osekelwayo womdlalo, i-TCP / UDP / HTTP, i-API yendawo, namakhono wenqubo.
Lokho Okushiwo Umphumela Impendulo yokuxhuma esezingeni eliphansi ayibonisi ukuthi umdlali angaqinisekisa futhi ajoyine. Inqubo ebukhoma nayo ayibonisi ukuthi isevisi yayo yombuzo ilungile.
Ukubalwa kwabadlali namagama abadlali kungamakhono ahlukene. Iseva ingakwazi ukubika ukuthi bangaki abadlali abaxhunyiwe ngaphandle kokuveza uhlu olunegama. Uhlu olungenalutho aluyona i-zero player count eqinisekisiwe.
Amathuluzi Afihlakeleyo NOMA I-N/A Ezinye izindlela ze-EOS kuphela noma zokudlala ngokuhlanganyela azivezi umbuzo othembekile osekelwayo noma isiteshi sokuphathwa komdlali. I-Synix ingabonisa i-N/A noma ilahle ukuhlolwa esikhundleni sokubonisa umphumela okhohlisayo.
Hlola inguqulo ekhethiwe kanye nesiteshi sokuphatha esilungiselelwe i-Minecraft. Ukubalwa komdlali we-Satisfactory kuncike ekuxhumaneni kwayo kwe-API yendawo. Ungazenzi izitifiketi ze-EOS zabathuthukisi kuphela ukuze uphoqe ukuhlolwa.
ISERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS Imidlalo eminingi ye-Steam isebenzisa imibuzo ye-A2S, kodwa lokhu akuyona eyomhlaba wonke. Ukubhaliswa, izilungiselelo zomdlalo kanye nensizakalo yesiphequluli kuthinta ukubonakala, futhi asikho isikhathi esiqinisekisiwe sokufakwa kuhlu.
Uma iseva ingekho kusiphequluli, hlola indlela yomdlalo yokuxhuma ngokuqondile bese uhlola ilogi yayo. Ukushintsha iziteshi zemibuzo ezingahlobene ngokuphindaphindiwe kungaletha izinkinga ezengeziwe.

data.name: Content.BB037060CAFF94F24E5C

I-Synix ayilandeli, ifake, ivuselele noma ithembele kuma-plugins; Engeza futhi uphathe ama-plugins akho ku-oxide\plugins. Ngemuva kokuvuselelwa noma ukuqinisekiswa kwe-Rust, i-Synix iphinde isebenzise isikhathi sokusebenza sakamuva esisemthethweni se-Oxide ngaphambi kokuqala kweseva.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Sebenzisa Ukucushwa kwamasimu avamile aphethwe yi-Synix. Sebenzisa umhleli wefayela lokumisa ku-Server Options uma udinga ukuhlola noma ukushintsha ukwakheka kwangempela komdlalo.
1. Yimisa iseva uma ifunda ifayela lapho liqala noma lilibhala kabusha ngenkathi lisebenza. 2. Yenza isipele bese uqinisekisa iseva nefayela elikhethiwe. 3. Funda amanani namazwana akhona. 4. Shintsha kuphela izilungiselelo ofuna ukuzishintsha. 5. Lungisa amaphutha okuqinisekisa umhleli bese ubuyekeza izixwayiso zakhe. 6. Gcina, qala iseva nge-Synix, bese uhlola ilogi yakamuva yomdlalo.
Amafomethi Asekelwayo I-Synix inikeza ukuphathwa okwaziyo ngefomethi ye-INI/izakhiwo ezisekelwayo, i-JSON, i-XML, i-YAML, namanye amafomethi akhethekile amaphrofayili. Akuwona wonke amafayela noma izinketho ezinomhleli olawulwayo. Ukuhlela kwe-YAML kusekela izilungiselelo ezihlanganisiwe, uhlu oludonswayo, namagugu womugqa owodwa ngenkathi kugcinwa ukuphawula nokudonswa. Izici eziyinkimbinkimbi ze-YAML ezinjenge-anchor, ama-alias, amaqoqo angaphakathi nomugqa, namagugu we-multiline wenqatshelwa ngaphandle kokulondoloza.
Gcina izinkinobho zokuhlela, amanani avunyelwe, amagama amamephu nemiyalo njengoba umdlalo ulindele. Ungazihumushi ukuze zihambisane nolimi lwe-interface.
Ukuqinisekiswa Akusona Isivivinyo Somdlalo Ifayela elenziwe kahle lingase liqukethe izilungiselelo ezingahambelani. Ama-mods noma izibuyekezo zemidlalo zingangeza izinketho umhleli angaziboni. Hlola ukuthi umdlalo ulayishe ifayela elihlosiwe nomhlaba ngemuva kokuqala kabusha.
Uma omunye umhleli noma umdlalo ushintsha ifayela ngenkathi livulekile, phinda ulayishe bese uqhathanisa ngaphambi kokulondoloza. Amafayela womdlalo angahlanganisa amaphasiwedi afundekayo noma amathokheni; ukubuyekeza nokuhlela ngaphambi kokwabelana.
Izinketho ze-Satisfactory ezibukhoma ze-API ziyingxenye ye-Control Center yayo futhi zihlukile ekuhleleni amafayela ayo wokumiswa kwediski.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Khetha Ukucushwa kweseva ekhona, noma usebenzise iwindi lokusetha ngenkathi udala eyodwa. Shintsha kuphela amasimu asebenza emdlalweni wakho.
Izindlela Zokuqala Nezithuthukile Imodi yabaqalayo igcizelela izilungiselelo ezivamile kanye nomyalo wokukhipha okunconywayo. Imodi ethuthukile yembula ukulawula okungeziwe kwezobuchwepheshe, kuhlanganise ne-RCON esekelwayo nezinketho zokuqalisa ezingavuthiwe. Ukushintsha imodi akususi amanani agciniwe. Izimemezelo ze-Discord ziyatholakala kuzo zombili izindlela.
Lokho Ikhasi Lonke Elikulawulayo • Okujwayelekile: Igama leseva, umdlalo, inguqulo / inguqulo, kanye nokukhethwa kwephrofayili yomdlalo osekelwayo. • Ukuphepha: Amaphasiwedi nezinye izilungiselelo zokufinyelela ezisekelwa ithempulethi. • Isizukulwane Somhlaba: Igama lomhlaba, imbewu, ubukhulu, nezinketho zomhlaba ezikhona. • Inethiwekhi & RCON: Gameplay asekelwayo, imibuzo, umngane / API, futhi ukuphela administrative. • Ukuzenzakalela: Isipele/ukubuyekezwa kokuqala nokugcinwa okuhleliwe. • I-Discord: Izindawo zokunikeza isaziso nokuqondisa umcimbi. • Faka & Qalisa: Ifolda yokufaka nezinketho zokuqalisa ezisekelwayo.
Izinkambu ezikhubazekile eziqondene nomdlalo ziyizinhloso. Umdlalo ungazitholela lowo mshini noma ungaxhaswa; Ukuphoqa izimpikiswano ezengeziwe emyalweni akuyona into ephephile.
IZINTO EZINE Zokuhlola Imininingwane yeseva → Izilungiselelo Ezidingekayo → Ukubuyekeza → Gcina iseva
Lokhu ukulandelela ukulungela ukwakheka, hhayi ukulanda noma ukufakwa inqubekela phambili. Uma izilungiselelo ezidingekayo zidlulisa ukuqinisekiswa, i-Synix ivula isinyathelo se-3 ukuze ubuyekeze izinketho zakho, bese uvula i-Save Server. Ukushintsha isethingi kukhiya Gcina kabusha kuze kube yilapho izinketho ezibuyekeziwe ziboniswa ku- Ukubuyekeza. Kumelwe ukhethe ukusindisa wena; ukuvula Ukubuyekezwa akulondolozi ngokuzenzakalelayo. Funda umyalezo ongenhla uma kukhona okudinga ukunakwa.
Lapho uhlela iseva, yeka kuqala uma ushintsho luthinta amafayela noma izinketho ezifundwa lapho kuqaliswa. Londoloza Izinguquko uvuselela iphrofayili yayo; ayithembisi ukuthi umdlalo wokugijima usebenzise lawo maqiniso. Qalisa kabusha nge-Synix lapho umdlalo uyidinga.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Vula ukucushwa → Ukuzenzakalela ukuze iseva ekhethiwe ikhethe umsebenzi owenziwa ngaphambi kokuqalisa okusekelwayo.
Ukubuyela Ekuqaleni Yenza lokhu ukuze udale isipele se-stop-server ngaphambi kokuqala okufanele. Setha ingcambu yokulondoloza nokugcina kuzilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza → Izipele.
Ukuphulukiswa kwe-crash kuqala ngokuqondile ukweqa isimiso esivamile sokusekela. Izipele zokuqalisa ezizenzakalelayo azifaki esikhundleni sokugcina amaphuzu okubuyisela ezimele ngaphambi kwezinguquko ezinkulu.
I-UPDATE KUQALA Yenza lokhu ukuze wenze ukuhlolwa kokuvuselelwa komdlalo osekelwayo ngaphambi kokuqalisa. Ivuselela amafayela omdlali womdlalo, hhayi isicelo se-Synix.
Ukuhlola izibuyekezo akusona isithembiso sokuthi zonke iziqalo zilanda amafayela. I-SteamCMD nomfaki womdlalo banquma ukuthi yini edingekayo.
I-VALIDATION NE-Customs FILES Isenzo sokuqinisekisa ngesandla singalungisa noma sidubule kabusha amafayela aphethwe umfakisicelo. Gcina izinguquko ngaphambi kokuzivuselela noma ukuqinisekisa; ungacabangi ukuthi amafayela wangokwezifiso ahlale engathintwanga.
Hlola Okukhethayo Gcina izilungiselelo bese wenza ukuqala okuhlanganisiwe. Funda imiphumela yomsebenzi ukuze wenze isipele, uvuselele futhi uqale. Ukulanda okuphelele akubonisi ukuthi lo mdlalo ulayishe umhlaba wawo ngokuphumelelayo.
Vumela indawo yamahhala eyanele yemibhalo, okulandwayo, amafayela esikhashana nomdlalo ofakiwe. Uma umsebenzi ngaphambi kokuqala ubika ukwehluleka, funa isizathu esishiwo kunokuba uqale iseva efanayo ngaphandle kwe-Synix ukuyigwema.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Vula i-Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg bese usetha i-g_console "1". Qalisa umdlalo ovamile we-American Truck Simulator, ulayishe iphrofayili yakho nebalazwe, cindezela ~ ukuvula ikhonsoli, bese usebenzisa i-export_server_packages. Vala umdlalo, bese uchofoza i-Start ku-Synix futhi. I-Synix izokhipha amafayela akhiqizwayo ngokuzenzakalelayo.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Vula Ukulungela kweseva ekhethiwe ngaphambi kokuqala kwayo noma lapho okuthile kwehluleka. Iqoqa ukuhlolwa okusekelwa yilelo phrofayili, njengamafayela, izikhathi zokuqalisa, ukwakheka, isikhala sediski, izimbobo, isimo senqubo, namarekhodi afanele.
Qonda Umphumela • Isilungile: Azikho izinkinga zokuvimbela ezitholakalayo. • Ukubuyekezwa: Funda okutholakele bese unquma ukuthi kunesidingo yini sokwenza okuthile. • Kuvinjelwe: Yixazulule inkinga ngaphambi kokuba uqhubeke.
Ukulungiswa akusebenzi ngokuzenzakalela kunoma yikuphi ukulungisa okuhlongozwayo. Hlola isinyathelo esihlongozwayo nokuqinisekiswa kwaso.
NGEMVA KOKUGcina iphrofayili entsha I-Start yokuqala ingalanda amafayela, ifake isikhathi sokusebenza esisekelwayo, ikhiqize ukumiswa, bese ilinda ukuqala komdlalo. Landela ukuqondiswa kokuqala kanye ne-Activity & Diagnostics kunokuba uphathe okufakiwe kwedeshibhodi okulondoloziwe njengomdlalo ofakiwe.
Eminye imidlalo idinga isivumelwano, ukuqinisekiswa, noma ukufakwa kwesicelo / iseshini yomdlalo ngaphambi kokuba noma ngubani angene. Qedela leso sinyathelo endaweni edingeka kulo mdlalo.
Ukuqinisekiswa kokuhambisana Faka, Qala, Misa, futhi Ukuqapha imiphumela irekhodi imisebenzi Synix uye waphawula. Akukaqinisekiswa okwamanje kusho ukuthi awukho umphumela oqoshiwe; akusho ukuthi umdlalo uyaziwa ukuthi uphelile.
Umphumela olungile noma ukuqinisekiswa kwendawo okuphumelelayo akuyona isiqinisekiso sokufinyelela ku-inthanethi, ama-mods anempilo, noma ukuhambisana nawo wonke amaklayenti. Qedela ngokuhlola ukuxhumana okuhlosiwe nomhlaba.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
I-backup yesiphakeli esikhethiwe igcina amafayela kufolda yokufaka yaleso sikhungo. Hlola ukuthi umdlalo usindisa kuphi umhlaba wawo ngaphambi kokuba uthembele kuwo.
Yenza Ukubuyisa 1. Vimbela iseva ukuba idlule ku-Synix bese ulinda izinqubo zayo ziphume. 2. Khetha isenzo sokusekelayo ku-Server Options. 3. Hlola umthombo, indawo oya kuyo, ubukhulu obulinganiselwayo nendawo yediski etholakalayo. 4. Qinisekisa futhi ulinde ukuqedwa. 5. Khetha ifolda evulekile yokusekelayo ukuze uthole i-archive. Gcina isitifiketi sakhe sokuthembeka naso.
ISIFUNDO Isipele sihlanganisa ifolda yokufaka, hhayi nje ifolda encane yokugcina. Imidlalo emikhulu ingadinga isikhathi nesitoreji esiningi.
Ukugcina ku-AppData, Imibhalo, enye idrayivu, noma umshini we-virtual womdlalo ungaphandle kwale folda. Zisekele ngokwehlukana usebenzisa indlela yomdlalo esekelwayo.
ISIKHATHI NENKONZO Impande evamile yokusekelayo yiC:\Synix\BackupGames. Amasethingi → Amaseva akuvumela ukuthi ukhethe enye impande bese usetha umkhawulo wokusekelayo ogciniwe.
Indawo okuyiwa kuyo kufanele ibe ngaphandle kwefolda yesiphakeli somthombo. Ukushintsha ingcambu yokusekelayo akuhambisani noma kususe ama-archive akhona; Hlola indawo yakudala ukuze uthole izipele ezindala.
Ukugcinwa kususa ama-archive amadala lapho umkhawulo okhethiwe udlula ngesikhathi sokudala isipele. Gcina amaphuzu okuvuselela angaphandle kwendawo yokulondoloza.
Gcina enye ikhophi eqinisekisiwe yezwe elibalulekile endaweni ehlukile. I-disk engaphumelelanga ingonakalisa kokubili iseva namakhophi okubhekabheka agcinwe kuleyo disk efanayo. I-ZIP yefolda yokuthumela yangaphandle ayiyona ngokuzenzakalelayo i-VM ehambisanayo noma isipele sedatha.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Funda umyalezo we-Windows ngaphambi kokuba unqume ukuthi yini okufanele uyishintshe. I-executable evinjiwe, iphutha lokufinyelela amafayela, nesikhathi sokudlala esilahlekile yizinkinga ezahlukene.
I-SYNIX AYI KUFUNDISWA NANGOKUVULWA Sebenzisa ukukhululwa okusemthethweni noma iphakethe eliqondile le-WinGet ubidzz.Synix. Uma ukubuyisela ifayela kubika ukuthi ukufinyelela kwenqatshelwe, vala isenzo se-Synix usebenzisa leyo ndlela ngokujwayelekile bese uzama futhi. Hlola ukufinyelela kwefolda nemiyalezo yesofthiwe yokuphepha uma inkinga iqhubeka.
Ungasusi idatha yesiphakeli noma ukhubaze ukuvikelwa njengokulungiswa okujwayelekile.
ISIMARTSCREEN Isixwayiso sedumela singanikeza ulwazi oluthe xaxa → Qalisa noma kunjalo, kuya ngenqubomgomo ye-Windows. Ukuba khona kwaleyo ndlela akubufakazi bokuthi ifayela liphephile. Qinisekisa umthombo osemthethweni futhi uphenye isixwayiso ngaphambi kokuthatha isinqumo sokuthi uyaqhubeka yini.
I-SMART APP CONTROL Lokhu kungavimbela uhlelo lokusebenza lapho i-Windows ingakwazi ukusungula ukwethenjwa okwanele. Noma kunjalo, ayinayo i-bypass ye-app eqhathaniswa ne-SmartScreen's Run. Ungakhubazi izici zokuphepha ze-Windows ukuze usebenzise i-Synix kuphela.
I-ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAIL Hlola ukubonwa kanye nefayela eliqondile. Ungacabangi ukuthi isaziso sinemiphumela engamanga ngoba ifayela libizwa ngokuthi i-Synix. I-hash ye-SHA-256 ehambisanayo ikhomba ifayela elayishiwe; akubeki ukwethenjwa noma ukusayinwa kwekhodi.
Yisho indlela eqondile yokuxwayisa nokufaka ngemininingwane yangasese esusiwe. Gwema ukukhipha okujwayelekile noma ukugwema ukuqinisekiswa kwe-hash yokufaka.

data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Sebenzisa Izilungiselelo → Izipele zokuthekelisa/ukungenisa i-Synix ephelele. Lokhu kuhlukile ekubhaliseni ifolda eyodwa esevele ikhona.
Hlola Okufanele Kuhanjiswe Iphakethe lokuthekelisa lifaka isihlahla esikhulu se-C:\Synix. I-server yangokwezifiso noma amafolda okubhekabheka angaphandle kwayo kanye nokugcinwa komdlalo kwangaphandle kudinga ukuphathwa okuhlukile. Bhala phansi izindlela zabo ngaphambi kokuqala. Izintandokazi ezijwayelekile ze-Windows zingase zidinge ukubuyekezwa endaweni yokuya kuyo.
I-EXPORT 1. Vimbela amaseva bese uqeda ukugcinwa okusebenzayo, ukulandwa nokwenza isipele. 2. Khetha ukuthekelisa okufihliwe noma okuvamile. 3. Khetha indawo oya kuyo ngaphandle komuthi womthombo bese uhlola ubukhulu nezidingo zesikhala sesikhashana. 4. Uma ufuna ukuthekelisa nge-encrypted, khetha iphasiwedi eqinile yokudlulisa bese uyigcina ngokwehlukana. 5. Linda kuze kube yilapho iphakethe le-.synixbackup seliphelile, bese uliqinisekisa.
Khetha Ukuvikelwa Okufanele Ukuthekelisa okufihliwe kuvikela iphakethe futhi kusekela ukudluliswa okuphathekayo kwama-credentials asekelwayo ku-akhawunti ye-Windows lapho uya khona.
Ukuthekelisa okujwayelekile akubhalisiwe. Amafayela nomlando womdlalo ongaphakathi kwawo angase aveze izimfihlo. Ukukopisha amanani afakwe ku-Windows akuzenzi zisebenze kwenye i-akhawunti.
Ukungenisa 1. Qala ngokwenza isipele idatha yamanje ye-Synix. 2. Vula ukulawula kokungenisa/ukuqinisekisa bese ukhetha iphakethe elihlosiwe. 3. Nikeza iphasiwedi yokudlulisa uma uceliwe bese uqinisekisa iphakethe. 4. Hlola indawo oya kuyo, izidingo ze-disk, futhi ubhale phansi izexwayiso. 5. Vumela ukuhlelwa, ukuqinisekiswa nokuvuselelwa kuphele. 6. Hlola izindlela zesiphakeli, iziteshi, amashejuli, izindawo zokulondoloza, namagama ngaphambi kokuqala noma yini.
Xhuma kabusha i-Satisfactory uma ubunikazi bayo bendawo noma uxhumano oluvikelwe lungasafani. Gcina iphakethe lokuqala nedatha endala kuze kube yilapho amaseva angenisiwe evivinywa.
Ukufuduka kwedatha okusekelwayo kugcina ikhophi yedatha yangaphambi kokufuduka. Uma ukungenisa noma ukufuduka kwehluleka, gcina leyo khophi nomyalezo wokubuyisela esikhundleni sokushintsha i-database esebenzayo ngenkathi i-Synix isebenza.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
I-Install & Launch iqukethe ifolda yesiphakeli ekhethiwe nezinketho zayo zokuqalisa ezisekelwayo. Gcina umyalo onconyiwe ngaphandle uma uqonda inkulumo-mpikiswano yomdlalo.
IZINQUMO ZOKUFUNDA Sebenzisa imodi ye-Advanced lapho kudingeka izimpikiswano ezingavuthiwe. Hlola izingcaphuno, izindlela ezisetshenziswayo, namagama okukhethwa kukho okudingwa umdlalo. I-Synix isivele inikeza izimpikiswano ezilawulwayo ezisekelwayo; ukufaka enye ikhophi kungadala izilungiselelo eziphikisanayo.
Musa ukuhumusha ama-switches noma ukufaka ilebula elihunyushwe esikhundleni senani lobuchwepheshe elilindelekile. Ungalokothi ungeze izitifiketi emyalweni ukuze nje kube lula ukukopisha.
Amafayela Wokuqalisa Athunyelwe Amaphrofayli asekelwayo, Izinketho Zeseva → Dala ifayela le-batch ubhala umyalo wokuqalisa oxazululwe kumbhalo.
Leli fayela lingaba namaphasiwedi afundekayo noma amathokheni enkonzo ukuze lisebenze ngokuzimela. Yigcine iyimfihlo futhi uyihlole ngaphambi kokuyihlanganyela noma ukuyihambisa.
Ukuqhuba iskripthi ngaphandle kwe-Synix akunikezi konke ukuvalwa kokusebenza kwe-Synix, ukuxhumanisa inja yokubheka, izipele, noma ukugcinwa okuhleliwe. Ungayisebenzisi kuyilapho i-Synix isivele inesiphakeli esisebenzayo.
IZINTSHAZELO ZANGaphandle Amanye amaphrofayli womdlalo aqalisa amathuluzi awo wokusebenzisa esikhundleni senqubo eyodwa ejwayelekile yesiphakeli. Lawo mathuluzi angadinga ukugunyazwa okuhlukile futhi angase angasekeli ukuthekelisa ifayela lokuqalisa. Landela umhlahlandlela womdlalo wephrofayili esikhundleni sokushintsha i-executable noma i-wrapper ehlukile.

Sebenzisa iphakethe lokukhulula elisemthethweni. Ihlanganisa isikhathi sokusebenza se-.NET esidingwa yi-Synix; amaseva womdlalo angase adinge izidingo zawo zangaphambili.
Khetha Indlela Yokufaka • MSI: Landa i-SynixSetup.msi, uyisebenzise, bese uvula iphaneli yokulawula ye-Synix kumenyu yokuqalisa. Indawo ejwayelekile yesicelo ngomsebenzisi yi %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Sebenzisa iphakethe eliqondile ubidzz.Synix. Isihloko se-WinGet Ukufakwa Nokuvuselelwa siqukethe imiyalo. • I-standalone executable: Beka ukulandwa okusemthethweni okuzenzakalelayo kufolda ebhaliwe bese uyisebenzisa lapho. Ukuhambisa leyo executable akuyona ukudluliselwa ephelele amaseva akho.
Ukulandwa okusemthethweni: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
Lungisa Uhlelo lokusebenza 1. Qedela ukulayisha okusebenzayo, ukwenza isipele nokugcinwa. 2. Vimbela amaseva wakho womdlalo nge-Synix bese uvala i-Synix ngokujwayelekile. 3. Sebenzisa i-updater noma isifaki sendlela oyikhethile yokufaka. 4. Vula kabusha i-Synix bese uhlola ukuthi ukufakwa kweseva yakho nezindlela zilungile yini.
Uma ufaka isicelo esidala se-EXE esikhundleni se-MSI, susa uhlelo lokusebenza oludala kuqala. Gcina idatha yayo yesiphakeli namafolda ayisebenzayo. Ungasusi i-C:\Synix ukuze uvuselele uhlelo.
Ukuvuselelwa kohlelo lokusebenza akuvuseleli imidlalo oyibambayo. Sebenzisa isenzo sokuvuselela se-server ekhethiwe ukuze wenze lokho.
Uma i-Windows ibika ukuthi ukufinyelela kwenqatshelwe ngenkathi kushintshwa i-executable, hlola ukuthi ikhophi elibuyiselwayo alisasebenzi. Musa ukubhala ngaphezulu uhlelo lokusebenza olusebenzayo noma ususe idatha yesiphakeli ukuze ulungise iphutha.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
I-Synix ihlola ingcindezi yemithombo ngaphambi kokuqalisa okuthile ukuze inciphise amathuba okuthi i-host idlule umthwalo. Uma ukuqala sekwephuzile noma kuvinjelwe, funda inkinga yesisetshenziswa eshiwo.
Gcina Igumbi LOMBONISI Vumela inkumbulo ye-Windows nezicelo zangemuva kanye nomdlalo. Gcina isikhala sediski sikhona ukuze uthole izibuyekezo, amafayela esikhashana, ukulondoloza nokwenza isipele.
Umkhawulo wememori we-Minecraft olungiselelwe uthinta isikhathi sayo sokudlala/sokusebenza. Akuyona umkhawulo onzima ovamile kunoma iyiphi inqubo eqalwa umdlalo ngamunye.
Ukuhlolwa kwemithombo akufaki iseva esitsheni se-CPU/RAM noma kuqinisekise ukuthi i-Windows ngeke iphele izinsiza. Sebenzisa isilawuli semithombo kanye nezifinyezo zedeshibhodi yonke ye-PC ukuze uqonde umthwalo wangempela.
I-NETWORK GUARD Isici sokuxwayisa ngenethiwekhi sokuhlola siqapha izimo ezingavamile zobubanzi bomkhawulokudonsa / izinsiza futhi sibuke umsebenzi owaziwayo we-SteamCMD ukunciphisa izexwayiso ezingamanga.
Akuyona i-firewall, isihlungi somgwaqo noma isevisi yokuvikela i-DDoS. Isixwayiso asibonisi ukuthi ubani owahlaselayo noma ukufakazela ukuthi kwenzeka ukuhlaselwa.
Lapho uxwayiswa, qhathanisa umsebenzi owenziwayo nezinhlelo zokusebenza eziye zaqanjwa, ezenza isipele nezinye. Hlola amarekhodi afanele ngaphambi kokushintsha izilungiselelo zokuphepha noma zenethiwekhi.

data.name: Content.F797B7FAAA8293240799
data.value:
KUDINGEKILE ukuhlolwa okubucayi:
1. Hlela 'server-settings.json' ukuze ufake izitifiketi zakho zomsebenzi weFactorio ezisemthethweni kanye ne-token yomsebenzisi wokusetshenziswa kwe-Space Age.
2. Idokhumenti Esemthethweni: https://wiki.factorio.com/Multiplayer#Server_settings

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Khetha iphrofayili ye-Rust bese uhlola umhlaba wayo, ubunikazi, umdlalo, imibuzo nezilungiselelo zomngane ngaphambi kokuqala kokuqala.
I-IDENTITY YESERVER I-Synix inikeza inani le-+server.identity elisekelwayo kusuka kumuntu wesiphakeli. Gcina izakhiwo ezahlukene kanye nobunikazi bezenzakalo ezahlukene ukuze zingahlanganyeli ngamabomu imihlaba noma ukwakheka.
I-RUST+ Lungiselela i-App Port eyingqayizivele esekelayo yensizakalo ehambisana nayo, bese ulandela izidingo ze-Rust zokubambisana nenethiwekhi. Iphuzu layo lokuphela lihlukile kumdlalo womdlali kanye nokuphathwa okungahleliwe kwe-RCON.
Hlola iziteshi zangempela ezilungiselelwe kunokuba ukopishe umthetho kusuka kwenye iseva ye-Rust. Vikela izitifiketi ze-RCON futhi ungazishicileli ukuze usize abantu bajoyine.
IVANILLA NE-OXIDE I-Vanilla isebenzisa amafayela asemthethweni. Ukukhetha i-Oxide kwengeza uhlaka olusemthethweni oluxhaswe ngemuva kwamafayela e-Steam. Ukufakwa kohlaka akusho ukukhetha noma ukuhlola ama-plugins ngamunye.
Sebenzisa ukuhamba komsebenzi wendawo okusekelwa yi-Mod & Plugin Manager yokufakwa kwe-Oxide/uMod okutholakele. Ama-plugin asadinga izinguqulo ezihambisanayo nemithombo ethembekile.
I-Synix iphinde isebenzise isikhathi sokusebenza se-Oxide esisekelwayo ngemuva kokuvuselelwa kwe-Rust noma ukuqinisekiswa lapho kukhethwa leso simiso. Ukuze ubuyele kumafayela e-Vanilla asemthethweni, shintsha ukukhethwa kohlaka bese usebenzisa i-Update noma i-Validate workflow esekelwayo.
Ngaphambi kokuguqulwa kohlaka noma umdlalo, gcina idatha yezwe, ukucushwa, ne-plugin. Hlola zombili umdlalo kanye ne-Oxide log ngemuva kokuqala kabusha; ukulandwa kwesikhungo ngempumelelo akubonisi ukuthi wonke ama-plugins afakwe kahle.

data.name: Content.F89E75BB7B8DECBE4C2B
data.value: ServerModSetup okufakiwe dedicated_server_mods_setup.lua download Workshop mods; i-modoverrides.lua yenza bakwazi kanye nezinketho zabo zomhlaba/i-shard. Sebenzisa ukufakwa kweseva esebenzayo nezindlela ze-cluster. Amamoda we-Client kuphela ahlukanisiwe; gcina ama-backup we-cluster ngaphambi kokushintsha amamoda wesiphakeli.

data.value: Hlola imigomo yelayisense ngaphambi kokuvumela ukuqaliswa kwesiphakeli sokuqala.

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: I-ATLAS iyiseva ehlanganisiwe futhi ayikwazi ukudala la mafayela ngokuqala iseva. Sebenzisa i-Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor esemthethweni ukudala nokuthekelisa igridi. Kopisha i-ServerGrid.json ne-ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json kufolda ye-ShooterGame yeseva. Ngaphambi kokuqala i-ATLAS, sebenzisa i-AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat bese ushiya i-Redis isebenza. Gcina iRedis iboshwe ku-127.0.0.1; ungavezi i-port 6379 ku-LAN, i-router noma i-intanethi. Umhleli Osemthethweni: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor

data.value: I-Synix idala ukwakheka okugcwele kwe-serverconfig.xml eyenziwe iseva futhi ilawula igama leseva, iphasiwedi, itheku, umkhawulo womdlali, umhlaba, imbewu nosayizi womhlaba. Amanye amanani womdlalo ahlala ehlela ku-editor yokumisa.

data.name: Language.Description
data.value: Khetha ulimi olusetshenziswa yi-Synix. Imiyalo yomdlalo kanye namagugu agciniwe awahunyushwanga.

data.name: Uninstall.AppOnly
data.value: Susa uhlelo lokusebenza kuphela (gcina amaseva nedatha)

data.name: Uninstall.Everything

data.name: Uninstall.Keep
data.value: Isusa izintandokazi zohlelo lokusebenza lwe-Synix, i-cache, amafayela esikhashana nokufakwa kokuqala kohlelo lokusebenza. Igcina yonke i-C:\Synix, amaseva womdlalo, ama-backup namafayela okubuyisela. Uhlu lwamaseva nezilungiselelo ku-SynixData\servers.json zigcinwa futhi zilayishwe kabusha lapho ufaka kabusha iSynix.

data.name: RemoteManager.Description
data.value: Hlanganisa leli khompyutha ukuze ubuke, uqale, ume, uqale kabusha futhi wenze isipele kumaseva avela kuwebhusayithi ye-Synix. Ukufinyelela okukude kuvinjelwe kuze kube yilapho uvuma ukuhlangana lapha.

data.name: RemoteManager.Heading
data.value: Lalela le khompyutha kusuka kuwebhusayithi ye-Synix

data.name: RemoteManager.Instructions
data.value:
Ngena ngemvume kuwebhusayithi bese ufaka le khodi. Vuma igama lakho lomsebenzisi kuphela lapha.
Gcina i-Synix ivulekile noma incishisiwe. Ukuxhumeka okuzolile kulalela ukungena ngemvume. Imininingwane yesiphakeli ivuselelwa njalo ngemizuzwana ye-10 ngenkathi ibukwa. Ukunqamula ukuhlanganiswa kukhubaze ukufinyelela okukude ngaphandle kokumisa amaseva.

data.value: Ukulinda i-akhawunti yakho ukuze ucele ukuhlanganiswa...

data.name: RemoteManager.CodeExpired
data.value: Ikhodi isiphelile. Yenza ikhodi entsha yokufanisa.

data.value: Ukulawulwa kokucela i-akhawunti: {0} Vuma kuphela uma leli igama lakho lomsebenzisi.

data.value: Ayikwazi ukuhlola ukuhlangana. Hlola uxhumano lwakho lwe-intanethi.

data.name: RemoteManager.Unavailable

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Dala iphasiwedi yesikhashana lapha. Ngena kuwebhusayithi ngayo kanye nendlela yakho ekhona ye-2FA noma ukhiye wokungena (passkey), bese ukhetha iphasiwedi entsha. Uma kudingeka zombili izindlela, zombili zihlala ziyimpoqo. Iphasiwedi yesikhashana isebenza kanye kuphela futhi iphelelwa isikhathi ngemva kwemizuzu engu-10. Iphasiwedi yakho yokuqala ihlala isebenza kuze kuqedwe ukubuyiselwa kwe-akhawunti.
